arlecchino-yelan-sucrose-bennett.desc: Arlecchino-sucrose vape. No Arlecchino Q. 7N2C N2 combo. Bennett hold E setup. KQMS stats.

xilonen-arlecchino-yelan-bennett.desc: Arlecchino Vape. 7N2C N2 combo. Instructor Bennett is approx 3k dps lower and a lot easier / more consistent. 18s 1 Xilonen E 1 Yelan E rotation.

arlecchino-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: Arlecchino Overload. Tight rotation. The first rotation is different. KQMS stats.

lyney-chevreuse-yaemiko-bennett.desc: Lyney Overload. Teammate builds focused on giving lyney as many buffs as possible. Lyney does 4CA + Burst + skill per rotation or 5CA when Burst isn't available. 15s rotation.

lyney-furina-xilonen-bennett.desc: Lyney Vape. Furina and Lyney Burst every other rotation. Very Precise.

arlecchino-kaeya-xilonen-bennett.desc: Arlecchino Melt. Only works with c6 Kaeya. 15/16s rotation. С2+ Arle can't consistently melt in this team. Petra buffs are considerably stronger than instructor on kaeya

lyney-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: Lyney without interrupt resist. On the last rot, Lyney ends with aim, aim, skill instead of aim, skill, aim so that all of his Hat damage happens, instead of the last Hat damage disappearing due to the sim ending. Bennett doesn't E if he's at full energy.

diluc-furina-xianyun-bennett.desc: diluc xianyun furina bennett with 12-3 icewind suite energy drops, diluc uses his Es after the first plunge and uses 4cwof, 66% collision rate. Tries slight delays for Hydro aura before plunging.

arlecchino-rosaria-xilonen-bennett.desc: Arlecchino with Rosaria melt. No Arlecchino Q. 18s rot. Tight rotation: Arle CD 3[N3D] N1 > Rosa E > Arle 2[N3D] N1

gaming-xianyun-furina-bennett.desc: Gaming Vapes around 93% of his plunges. Uses Q N1 7EPD. Assumes that dashing after plunge will reduce Manchai return time by at least 13f. Pyro VV and Vapes are sensitive to timing. Gaming needs more ER than when not dashing due to how his particle ICD works.

lyney-furina-kazuha-bennett.desc: Lyney vape first rotation with sustainable Bennett and Furina ER for indefinite rotations.

neuvillette-xilonen-sucrose-xiangling.desc: Neuv vape with Xilonen and Sucrose. 26s~ rotation with Xiangling burst enabling vapes on first half and Guoba+Sucrose burst enabling vapes on second half. Xilonen gets Hydro Scroll for both halfs, but VV is only up for Neuv's first field time.

neuvillette-furina-lisa-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Lisa Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Assuming 2nd Xilonen E gets hydro scroll. Lisa without hold E. Lisa is used for A4 DEF shred and prototype amber's healing. Lisa pickup the hydro shard for 4AP. Energy based on lv100 icewind suite.

neuvillette-furina-kazuha-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Xilonen. 4CA 28s rotation. Both Xilonen and Kazuha using Q every rot, 2Es per rot.

gaming-furina-xianyun-bennett.desc: Press Gaming E as soon as possible, but plunge only when Man Chai is extremely close to u midair such that u catch it while ur plunging. Always dash to the enemy closest to Man Chai before pressing E so u have a higher likelihood of catching Man Chai midair instead of autotargetting onto a faraway enemy and becoming unable to do so. 7 skill plunges.

raiden-fischl-xingqiu-nahida.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Fischl Xingqiu Nahida

gaming-xianyun-furina-chevreuse.desc: vape gaming without circle impact. chev provide her c6 buff, pyro energy, and pyro application for easy and consistent vv setup. sodp and noblesse are close for chev.

arlecchino-chevreuse-yaemiko-bennett.desc: Arle Overload with Yae. 16-17s rotation. No Arle Q, No Yae Q, 2N2C 4N3D N3. KQMS stats.

neuvillette-furina-lisa-kazuha.desc: Neuv Furina Lisa Kazuha. 4CA 25s rot. Lisa without hold E. Lisa is used for A4 DEF shred and prototype amber's healing. She only needs high ER and A4. Energy based on lv100 icewind suite

neuvillette-xilonen-kazuha-xiangling.desc: Neuvillette Vape with Xiangling Petra. 4CA Per Rotation

xilonen-navia-furina-yelan.desc: Navia double hydro. 2 Xilonen and Yelan skills. 22s rotation. No Archaic Petra Navia isn't good.

hutao-yelan-furina-xilonen.desc: Hu Tao C0 Vape, 2 Yelan E and 2 Xilonen E per rotation. Focused on the Hydro DPS

neuvillette-furina-sucrose-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Sucrose Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Sucrose provides 20% Hydro DMG Bonus with her C6 on the first half.

xilonen-lyney-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Lyney Mono pyro 16s rotation. Chevreuse used for her c6 only. AP chev is approx 5kdps higher than SODP

neuvillette-xilonen-nahida-xiangling.desc: neuvi burnvape with xilo+nahida. pretty consistent to get hydro back at the end of rotation for xilonen refresh. No xilonen bursting

lyney-chevreuse-raiden-bennett.desc: Lyney Chevreuse Raiden Bennett. ~15s Rot. Lyney without interrupt resist. On the last rot, Lyney ends with aim, aim, skill instead of aim, skill, aim so that all of his Hat damage happens, instead of the last Hat damage disappearing due to the sim ending.

xilonen-furina-yelan-xingqiu.desc: Mono hydro on field Yelan. 2 Yelan skill 2 Xilonen skills. AP Xingqiu is a big difference.

neuvillette-furina-faruzan-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Faruzan Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Faruzan wanted to join the party. Don't ask what she does here.

gaming-furina-xilonen-bennett.desc: Gaming vape. 20s rotation. 2 Bennett skill rotation. 9 Gaming skill plunges with delays.  1E Xilonen. AP Bennett can be a small dps increase with rotation change.

lyney-chevreuse-kuki-bennett.desc: Lyney Overload with Kuki. 15s rotation. Kuki's C4 is ~1.5% DPS loss due to the extra Electro application disabling Lyney's A4 Passive. Lyney does 4 or 5 CAs depending on Burst availability.

arlecchino-raiden-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Arle Raiden Chev Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q, 6N3D. Raiden provides long lasting electro app and Overloaded damage.

lyney-furina-sucrose-bennett.desc: Lyney vape with Sucrose. Sucrose burst every other rotation for more consistent hydro app. Sucrose only gets pyro VV

xianyun-hutao-yelan-furina.desc: Hu Tao Double Hydro Plunge. 2 Yelan E rotation. Xianyun applies VV debuff twice per rotation. Hu Tao 6 N1CJP. Noblesse and Emblem Yelan are comparable due to her proccing her burst less than non plunge teams . First rotation is slightly different

neuvillette-xilonen-lynette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Vape with Xiangling Xilonen Lynette. Gets 4pc Scroll refresh, but only gets Hydro VV for Neuv's first field time. Neuv starts with E N1 first rot, then does N2D N2 second rot onwards to let Lynette's Burst run out and ensure Hydro VV.

alhaitham-furina-nahida-kuki.desc: alhaitham quickbloom with furina. split 30s rotation with 2 kuki skills.

neuvillette-furina-jean-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Jean Xilonen. 4CA 25s rot. No Xilonen Q, Jean heals instead. See Jean using her Q every rot with only 1E per rot here.

neuvillette-furina-kazuha-ororon.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Ororon. 4CA 26s rot. [ Ororon > Kazuha > Furina Q > Neuv ] to maximize Kazuha and Furina buff uptime on Neuv. You can run damage oriented weapon on Ororon but not that worth doing it. Favmen.

mualani-furina-nahida-xiangling.desc: Mualani burn vape. 20s rotation Mualani bursts every rotation. Prototype Amber as the only healing source can cause team to die easily. Energy based on lv100 icewind suite.

neuvillette-furina-lynette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Lynette Xilonen. 4CA 27s rot. Using Xilonen Q. Lynette contributes to Fanfare stacking with her HP fluctuation. Providing taunt with her Q.

neuvillette-furina-sayu-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Sayu Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. No Xilonen Q, Sayu heals instead. See Sayu using her Q every rot with only 1E per rot here.

arlecchino-yelan-xilonen-bennett.desc: Arle Yelan Xilonen Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q N3C 2[N5D] N4. Pyro scroll setup Arle E (feed Bennett) > Bennett E > Xilonen > Yelan > Bennett Q dash(4AP) > Arle combo

clorinde-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: Clorinde Chev OL w/ C6 Bennett, which allows Clorinde to refresh Chev's A1 with a Pyro NA in between her Burst and Skill combo.

neuvillette-furina-ororon-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Using Xilonen Q. She can utilize 4AP. Technically Ororon doesn't need field time to trigger 4Scroll since Xilonen deals Nightsoul aligned damage.

raiden-yelan-xingqiu-baizhu.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Double Hydro and Baizhu

neuvillette-furina-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Xianyun Xilonen. 4CA 25s rot. No Xilonen Q, Xianyun heals instead. See Xianyun using her Q every rot with only 1E per rot here.

neuvillette-furina-fischl-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Fischl Xilonen. 4CA 28s rot. Trying to get Hydro Scroll as much as possible. Check out the samples to see how scroll setup works, noting that Oz has ~12s duration. Reaches 89k with 4AP Fischl.

mualani-yelan-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Mualani vape. Yelan doesn't interfere with Mualan's ability to vape all dmg. Very high energy requirements on Xiangling. 12-3 icewind suite energy drops.

neuvillette-furina-kuki-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Kuki Xilonen. 4CA 27s rot. Kuki picks up the shard before Neuv field time. Kuki's 2nd field time for that is DPS neutral, so you can skip it.

gaming-furina-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Gaming plunges 8 times. To do this ingame, Press E immediately after Q and each plunge. Wait till Man Chai is extremely close to you, then plunge.

mualani-sucrose-xilonen-xiangling.desc: Mualani Sucrose Xilonen Xiangling, 16s~ rotation with Xiangling burst every other rotation, Guoba enable vapes otherwise, supplemented by Sucrose burst. no Xilonen burst. Sucrose refresh her buff between Mualani combo to her burst. AP Xiangling picking up the crystal made by Xilonen.

neuvillette-furina-nahida-kuki.desc: 2 Kuki skill 30s rotation. Nahida fills some downtime on fielding.

neuvillette-furina-xiao-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Xiao Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Xiao sweeps the battlefield with his E. Enemies won't survive after he uses E.

neuvillette-furina-lumineanemo-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina AMC Xilonen. 4CA 27s rot. AMC provides 20% Hydro RES Shred with her C6 on the first half. AMC 1E per rot.

arlecchino-kaeya-kazuha-bennett.desc: Arlecchino with C6 Kaeya Melt. 6N3D combo. KQMS stats.

neuvillette-furina-venti-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Venti Xilonen. 28s rot. Venti & Xilonen 2E+Q each rot.

arlecchino-yelan-kazuha-bennett.desc: Arle Yelan Kazuha Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q. N3C 2[N5D] N3. Kazuha N1 hEP for double VV.

furina-neuvillette-kazuha-fischl.desc: Neuvillette Electrocharge with no Interruption Resistance - Hyperoptimised sim

clorinde-fischl-kazuha-kirara.desc: Clorinde TF Kirara doing 2 E's per rot and sapwood blade. KQMS Stats

lyney-furina-zhongli-bennett.desc: Furina sees the field every other rotation to keep rotation time low

neuvillette-furina-heizou-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Heizou Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. No Xilonen Q. Heizou Q twice in a rot with Prototype Amber healing the team.

alhaitham-nahida-yelan-kuki.desc: Alhaitham hyperbloom 2 Yelan e split uptime rotation. 8 swap delay to allow Kuki to N1 Q in Alaitham Burst window. Tech requires lower ping or canceling n1 before dmg instance.

sethos-fischl-nahida-xilonen.desc: Sethos Nahida Fischl Xilonen. ~15-16s Rot. Sethos Aggravate. Different first rotation so that Electro Crystallize can be generated. Xilonen never bursts. Nahida dashes for crystallize.

alhaitham-raiden-xingqiu-nahida.desc: Alhaitham raiden hyperbloom with pos and radius

neuvillette-xilonen-emilie-xiangling.desc: Neuvillette Burnvape with Xilonen, Emilie, and Xiangling.  ~26s rotation. Ensure that enemy has Hydro aura before trying to proc Scroll with Xilonen. Emilie does not Burst. Xilonen only Bursts to fill time as otherwise Neuv's skill will be on cooldown after C Q.

lyney-xiangling-xilonen-bennett.desc: Lyney Monopyro with Xilonen. No RES. Interruption else than the Crystallize shields.

neuvillette-furina-kazuha-zhongli.desc: Neuvillette Guide Weapons (with Furina) R5 Sacrificial Jade

neuvillette-furina-kirara-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Kirara Xilonen. 4CA 27s rot. Xilonen using Q. Kirara short hold E before each Neuv field time while picking up the shard generated from Xilonen.

alhaitham-raiden-xingqiu-kirara.desc: Alhaitham Hyperbloom with kirara. High dps hyperbloom team with great defensive utility and no Nahida

neuvillette-furina-navia-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Navia Xilonen. 4CA 29s rot. Navia hold E to collect the shard, activating 4AP buff. 4pc Nighttime on navia is ~5% team DPS loss.

nilou-kaveh-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Kqmc kaveh nilou bloom with  N8W-N4E-N4 string

neuvillette-furina-kuki-kazuha.desc: Furina catches Neuv particles, Kuki E N1 before Furina to let Neuv have more Furina Q uptime as well as make Kaz Q's DoT swirl electro. Neuv does 4 CA's.

navia-xilonen-furina-xianyun.desc: Navia Plunge. 2 Xilonen skills, one funneled to Navia. Rotation gives TTDS to Navia for both skills and all plunges. C0 Xilonen doesn't give resistance shred but provides energy and Scroll set.

xilonen-wriothesley-bennett-xiangling.desc: Wrio melt, ▶ONE ROTATION◀, with sustainable energy for multiple rotations, damage drastically falls off after the first rotation due to widsith cd, wrio bursting every other rotation,and the need to battery xl on next rot.

arlecchino-chevreuse-xilonen-bennett.desc: Arle Chev Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q, N3D combo. Chev used for C6 buff and 4AP

clorinde-kirara-fischl-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Kirara Fischl Xilonen. ~25s Rot. TF Clorinde Aggravate, shielded. Clorinde, Kirara, and Xilonen do not burst. Kirara builds for shield. Ins Kirara is -3K DPS. Clorinde takes the sapwood leaf.

neuvillette-furina-charlotte-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Charlotte Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. No Xilonen Q, Charlotte heals instead. Chalotte triggers 4AP twice(1st/2nd half).

arlecchino-fischl-yaemiko-chevreuse.desc: Arle Fischl Yae Chev. 16s rot (very tight). No Arle Q. 6[N3D] N1. also not using yae Q, just 3[E]. there is no burst reliant teammates so chev can reach 40k HP relatively easier, by not using fav lance

kuki-yelan-furina-nahida.desc: double hydro hyperbloom. With more of a focus on non transformative damage Nahida N2E/N2CD combo on field. 2 Yelan E rotation. Kuki bursts every rotation separate from her e cast for higher electro app uptime . Nahida only bursts first rotation

arlecchino-yelan-ororon-bennett.desc: Arle Yelan Ororon Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q. N3C 5[N3D] N1. Scroll setup: Yelan EQ N1 > Ororon E N2 > Bennett Q E > Ororon Q N1

neuvillette-furina-ororon-lynette.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Lynette. 4CA 25s rot. EM build Lynette. If Lynette is Pre-C4, put Lynette EQ before Furina Q to manage E cd.

neuvillette-furina-baizhu-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Baizhu Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. No Xilonen Q, Baizhu heals instead. Baizhu triggers 4AP twice(1st/2nd half).

lyney-chevreuse-bennett-kazuha.desc: Lyney Mono Pyro with C6 Chev and no interrupt resistance: Lyney, Chevreuse, Bennett, Kazuha. 15s 4CA rotation. Not having C6 Chev is around a 14% dps loss.

neuvillette-furina-dori-kazuha.desc: Neuv+Furina with dori as healer, as well as to let kazuha swirl ec.

neuvillette-furina-zhongli-kazuha.desc: Neuvillette Hypercarry with resistance to interruption. 4CA rotation

arlecchino-navia-xilonen-bennett.desc: Arle Navia Xilonen Bennett. 19s rot. No Arle Q, Arle deals the main damage, Navia occasionally enters the field to perform a skill, Xilonen increases the damage of both.

clorinde-fischl-nahida-xilonen.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (FoHW) w/ Fischl Nahida Xilonen. 16s rotation w/ modified opening rotation to maximize Clorinde field time. Xilonen and Nahida alternate using their bursts. Nahida picks up the Electro shard generated by Xilonen.

gaming-furina-bennett-xilonen.desc: Gaming Furina Bennett Xilonen. ~20s Rot. Gaming Vaporize with Xilonen. Gaming does Q7EP with a delay before every skill, intended to catch Man Chai in midair. Bennett C6 is wanted to improve Pyro Scroll reliability.

navia-xilonen-bennett-furina.desc: Navia-Xilonen with 2 Xilonen Es per rotation. Have to be careful of the Geo application which isn't abundant.

gaming-furina-sucrose-bennett.desc: VV setup is ping dependent. Make pyro aura on enemy by Ben QE or QEN1, swirl using N1 on Sucrose. Press Gaming E as soon as possible, but plunge only when Man Chai is extremely close to u midair such that u catch it while ur plunging. Always dash to the enemy closest to Man Chai before pressing E so u have a higher likelihood of catching Man Chai midair instead of autotargetting onto a faraway enemy and becoming unable to do so. 8 E plunges.

hutao-yelan-bennett-furina.desc: Bennett on full healing build (HP HP HB). Rotation distributes healing to everyone for fanfare generation and survivability. Ocean Hued Clam and Song Of Days Past are interchangeable Bennett sets.

hutao-yelan-furina-lisa.desc: Furina ed q > Lisa hE q > Yelan q n1 e > Hu Tao e combo > q (when available) > Yelan e aim

sethos-fischl-sucrose-kirara.desc: Sethos does 8N2W N1 combo. The last N1 is physical and fills rot time. Sethos picks up the Sapwood leaf. 2.5k DPS loss if Kirara is on fav and the ER is reoptimized.

hutao-fischl-yelan-bennett.desc: Hu Tao overvape. 18s 1 Yelan E 2 Bennett E rotation.

xilonen-furina-yelan-kazuha.desc: Yelan on field carry. Swaps to Xilonen and Kazuha to refresh buffs and generate energy multiple times per rotation.

neuvillette-furina-zhongli-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Zhongli Xilonen. 4CA 28s rot. Xilonen using Q every rot. Zhongli can simply pickup the shard for 4AP generated from Xilonen in-game, buffing both of Neuv's field time.

baizhu-xingqiu-fischl-raiden.desc: Raiden ED > Baizhu EQ > Fischl EN1 > Xingqiu EDQN2 > Baizhu N2D 2N3D E > Fischl N2Q > Baizhu 5N3D N2D > Raiden N1

clorinde-fischl-kazuha-nahida.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (4TF) w/ Fischl Kazuha Nahida. 25s rotation to maximize Oz uptime; Clorinde does not burst.

clorinde-fischl-sucrose-kirara.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (TF) w/ Fischl, Sucrose and Kirara. ~25s rotation. Sucrose uses her burst when available.

clorinde-fischl-sucrose-nahida.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (4TF) w/ Fischl Sucrose Nahida. ~25s rotation. Clorinde uses her Burst to fill downtime. Sucrose uses her Burst when available.

neuvillette-chiori-furina-xilonen.desc: Neuv Furina Chiori Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Neuv pickup the hydro shard for Geo Resonance.

navia-furina-yelan-xilonen.desc: Navia Furina Yelan Xilonen. Yelan 2E 21s rot. Navia 3rd E if available. Navia ATK Goblet due to high DMG%. Slingshot Yelan + Festering Desire Furina is ~1k higher. See the config for that weapons.

lyney-furina-kokomi-bennett.desc: Lyney vape with Kokomi. Kokomi gives more reliable AOE hydro app for Lyney to vape than just Furina.

neuvillette-furina-ororon-sayu.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Sayu. 4CA 26s rot. Furina Q > Sayu EQ > Neuv

neuvillette-furina-yaemiko-kazuha.desc: variation of the standard neuv - furina - kaz hyper team with burstless yae as flex. widsith is better than hakushin. includes rot without yae totem refresh for slower players, only ~400 dps worse.

clorinde-sara-xiangling-chevreuse.desc: Overload Clorinde w/ Kujou Sara, Xiangling and Chevreuse. 16s Rotation. Hyper-optimized. Clorinde makes use of her Skill movement to extend Sara's buff from her Burst and pick up Xiangling's pepper. Chevreuse's hold Skill is slotted between Sara's Aimed Shot and Clorinde's Burst in order for Sara and Chevreuse to funnel particles to Clorinde.

neuvillette-furina-ororon-jean.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Jean. 4CA 26s rot. Furina Q > Jean EQ > Neuv

alhaitham-xingqiu-yelan-raiden.desc: Deepwood XQ; Option to weave NAs during setup (on); Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite; KurtC except the LoFI; Random frame delays with min and max - swap: 6-18, mean 10.5, stddev 1.5; other actions: 0-6, mean 3, stddev 1.

neuvillette-furina-albedo-kazuha.desc: Albedo can provide some minor interrupt resist with Crystallize. DPS-wise, Albedo is similar to Zhongli, making up for the loss of Res Shred with his personal DMG. 4GT Albedo is around a 2k DPS loss.

kokomi-furina-yelan-xingqiu.desc: On field Kokomi 21s 2 Yelan E rotation Kokomi alternates Walk and Dash cancels

arlecchino-xilonen-yunjin-bennett.desc: Arle YunJin Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q C 6[N3D]. 4Husk (instead of 4AP) Yunjin is 6k loss.

mualani-chiori-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Mualani double Geo vape. Xiangling burst every other rotation (note that guoba might be insufficient in AoE or against mobile enemies), Chiori and Xilonen alternate burst use. Xiangling uses AP and pick up the shard created by the Geos.

clorinde-fischl-emilie-xiangling.desc: TF Clorinde Quickburn. 25s rotations. High Quicken uptime with lots of Overloads.

klee-furina-yelan-xilonen.desc: Klee 2Hydro Vape with Xilonen. Klee does 5N1C first rot and 6N1C after, vaping ~75% of her CAs. Yelan 2E and Xilo burst + 2E rotation makes ER reqs relatively low. Pyro scroll on 1st rotation only.

lyney-furina-diona-bennett.desc: Lyney vape/melt with Diona. Diona provides 200 EM buff at c6 as well as a shield and healing for more fanfare generation and some melts. Team doesnt work very well against unfreezable enemies

arlecchino-candace-xilonen-bennett.desc: Arle Candace Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q C 6[N3D]. Candace can trigger 2pc scroll thanks to Xilonen, using only 1E per rot, reducing rot length

arlecchino-furina-kazuha-bennett.desc: Arlecchino-Furina vape. Furina sees the field every other rotation. KQMS stats.

neuvillette-furina-kazuha-diona.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Diona. 4CA 26s rot. Use Diona hE Q before Furina Q.

neuvillette-furina-kazuha-xiangling.desc: Neuv Furina with Xiangling. Xiangling+pyro absorb Kazuha burst enable some vapes, but not much. Amount of vapes can increase significantly with double hit Xiangling. 27s 4CA rotation.

hutao-yelan-jean-furina.desc: Double E Yelan rotation. First rotation does not VV pyro

clorinde-fischl-xiangling-chevreuse.desc: Clorinde Chev OL w/ Fischl and Xiangling. 16s rotation. Xiangling burst every other rotation to keep rotation length short and reduce ER needs.

arlecchino-chevreuse-ororon-bennett.desc: Arle Chevy Ororon Bennett. 16s rotation. Ororon is a significant downgrade over Fischl in this team due to overall worse damage and energy production that scroll buff doesn't make up for. Arle E > Ororon EQ > Bennett EQ > Chevy Q hE N1 > Arle CA 6N3d.

neuvillette-furina-xilonen-sigewinne.desc: Neuv Furina Xilonen Sigewinne. 4CA 25s rot. No Xilonen Q. Sigewinne pickup the hydro shard for 4AP twice. Due to low field time of the teammates, sigewinne could enter the field to pickup the shard for 4AP again.

kinich-xiangling-bennett-emilie.desc: 5 Quickscope Scalespiker Cannon Combo. Kinich, emilie and Xiangling burst every other rotation. KQMS Stats.

arlecchino-yelan-fischl-bennett.desc: Arle Yelan Fischl Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q, N1 C 3[N5D] N3. uncancelled CA can remove excessive electro from fischl's burst to vape arle's NAs.

arlecchino-rosaria-layla-bennett.desc: Arlecchino Melt. 17s rotation. This rotation is somewhat reliant on C6 Layla for cryo application

arlecchino-sucrose-xilonen-bennett.desc: Arle Sucrose Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q. N1C 5[N3D] N4. Xilonen and Sucrose comes after Bennett Q. Sucrose Q every 2rots. TTDS proc every 2rots.

neuvillette-furina-ororon-xianyun.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Xianyun. 4CA 26s rot. Xianyun EPQ > Furina Q > Neuv C E C Q. You can instead build more ER on Xianyun and do Furina Q > Xianyun Q > Neuv C Q E C.

arlecchino-emilie-kazuha-bennett.desc: Arle Emilie Kazuha Bennett. No Arle Q 16s rot. Both Emilie and Kazuha on Bennett Q. Emilie Q if ready and if she didn't use her Q, use Kazuha Q.

hutao-xianyun-yelan-furina.desc: Hu Tao Plunge. Combo is 5N2CJP with High Plunges and 50% collision. Less consistent vapes than N1CJP but still a great team.

kazuha-yaemiko-fischl-nahida.desc: Yae Fischl Agg 25s Rot. Yae does higher dmg than Fischl first rotation and in AOE situations. Swaps to Nahida 3 times per rotation for near 100% hakushin ring and instructor uptime.

clorinde-fischl-nahida-furina.desc: Clorinde Fischl Furina Nahida. 4TF 25s rot. w/o using clorinde burst. assuming you use her E when over 100% BoL not spamming N3E and Fischl can steal hyperbloom with small enemy size. 4TotM on furina is slightly better

alhaitham-xingqiu-fischl-raiden.desc: Deepwood XQ; Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite; KurtC; Customized random frame delays. Options for LoFI & HoD and Deepwood Alhaitham in config.

neuvillette-kazuha-zhongli-xiangling.desc: Neuv vape, 28s 4CA rotation. Xiangling burst provides pyro for first half of the rotation and Guoba+Kazuha burst for the second half. Timings might be tight for Hydro swirl on second half. Xiangling picks up crystallize twice for AP. Second crystallize might be unreliable and depends on Zhongli pillar hitting.

xilonen-lyney-xiangling-bennett.desc: Lyney mono pyro 15/16s rotations. Lyney aims to burst every rotation but it's not 100% reliable. Xiangling burst about 1 in 3 rotations

gaming-furina-yelan-bennett.desc: Yelan does not do 2 E's. Gaming does 6 Ep N1. Ingame, press Skill after attacking and catch or almost catch Man Chai before plunging.

arlecchino-kaeya-lynette-bennett.desc: arle melt with C6 kaeya. very precise. works with C0 lynette

arlecchino-kazuha-xilonen-bennett.desc: Arle Kazuha Xilonen Bennett. No Arle Q C 6[N3D] N1.

fischl-nahida-lisa-alhaitham.desc: Fischl E > Nahida EQ > Lisa N1Q > Haitham hE lP N2CD N3C > Fischl N1Q > Haitham Q > Lisa dN2 > Haitham 2N3J N2CJ 2N3D N3

arlecchino-rosaria-lynette-bennett.desc: arle melt; simple N3D combo with extra N1 at the end, fieldtime is split so rosa can reapply cryo with E. rot works with C0 lynette. timings are strict for consistency since solo cryo applier w/o assistance from lynette cryo burst, so ymmv depending on skill & content faced. C2+ lynette Q after rosa EQ makes melt very consistent but ER reqs are atrocious.

neuvillette-furina-lisa-lynette.desc: "cheaper" variant of neuvis hypercarry team with furina. rot works with pre-c4 lynette. pamber lisa burst and lynette skill before furina burst for better uptime at the price of losing some fanfare.

gaming-rosaria-xianyun-bennett.desc: On first rotation, swap to Xianyun after Bennett and do an N2. On second+ rotation, don't swap to Xianyun after Bennett if Xy swirled pyro already. Gaming does 6 melted plunges + 1non reacted plunge, slower plunges after the first 4.

neuvillette-fischl-nahida-raiden.desc: Neuv HB with Fischl as flex. Team does marginally more HB damage than Neuv damage. 4CA ~26s rot.

arlecchino-bennett-rosaria-kazuha.desc: Arlecchino melt with Rosaria. Very precise. Uses a Rosaria skill mid Arlecchino combo to reapply cryo. KQMS stats.

kuki-fischl-xingqiu-nahida.desc: Kuki hyperbloom with DW xingqiu and instructor nahida

arlecchino-furina-yelan-xianyun.desc: Arle Furina Yelan Xianyun. Yelan 2E 24s rot. No Arle Q. 8[N1JhP] N1 with 50% collision rate.

clorinde-sara-yunjin-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Hypercarry w/ Sara YunJin Xilonen. Two separate 16s rotations (or a large 32s rotation). YunJin splits up her Skill and Burst in between Xilonen's field time to ensure that 3 Crystallizes occur each 16s rotation in order to max Clorinde's A1.

neuvillette-furina-kazuha-charlotte.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Charlotte. 4CA 26-27s rot. Charlotte Q every rot healing everyone.

neuvillette-furina-baizhu-kazuha.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Baizhu. 4CA 27s rot. Baizhu with only 1E, reducing rotation length. Use Baizhu EQ before Furina Q to maximize Furina Q uptime on Neuv.

neuvillette-furina-aethergeo-kazuha.desc: Hyper Neuvilette with Geo MC who increases interruption resistance, crit by 10% and 35% dmg from 4 pc AP

gaming-layla-rosaria-bennett.desc: Gaming Melt 20s rotation with a shield. 2 sources of cryo app makes the team easier/more consistent to play

alhaitham-raiden-xingqiu-yaoyao.desc: Alhaitham hyperbloom team with yaoyao 21s rotation. KQMS stats. Improved config for better deepwood coverage. Yaoyao E -> XQ EDQN -> Alhaitham QN -> Raiden EN -> Alhaitham onfield. Easy to play as long as ping is low.

kokomi-furina-yelan-kazuha.desc: Kokomi Mono hydro. Different/shorter rotation. Yelan uses fav to keep er reqs low on shorter rotation. Kokomi and Furina then have higher dmg share

mualani-yelan-nahida-xiangling.desc: Mualani burn vape. 2 vaped Yelan E rotation, all of her particles go to Mualani so she can burst every rotation.

navia-xilonen-fischl-furina.desc: Navia Xilonen Fischl Furina.~21s rot. Use Navia 3rd E if available. 2 Xilonen E. ATK% Goblet on Navia.

neuvillette-furina-zhongli-jean.desc: Neuvillette-Furina with Resistance to Interruption 4CA rotation

sethos-furina-yelan-xilonen.desc: Sethos Furina Yelan Xilonen. 21s Rot. Sethos Taser. Yelan and Xilonen use E 2x with no attempt made to obtain Electro Scroll buff.

gaming-furina-zhongli-bennett.desc: Gaming plunges 9 times. To do this ingame, Press E immediately after Q and each plunge. Wait till Man Chai is extremely close to you, then plunge.

neuvillette-furina-kazuha-sigewinne.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Sigewinne. 4CA 26s rot. Sigewinne uses her E between Furina Q and Neuv's first field time.

nahida-xingqiu-kokomi-raiden.desc: Xingqiu E d Q N1, Nahida E N1 Q N1C, Raiden E N1, Kokomi E N1, Nahida E 3N3CJ N3, Kokomi Q N1, Nahida E N3CJ N1C

mualani-zhongli-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Mualani vape with Shield. Mualani and Xiangling burst every other Mualani skill. Xilonen and Zhongli never burst. When Mualani bursts, she skips her third NA. Assumes burst hits almost Instantly,

neuvillette-xilonen-kazuha-ororon.desc: Neuv Ororon Kazuha Xilonen. 4CA 28s rot. Ororon triggers Scroll, so Xilonen can hold 4AP. Team Fav weapons lower Neuv ER needs.

mualani-xilonen-sucrose-xiangling.desc: Mualani Xilonen Sucrose Xiangling. 33s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. 1st half Xiangling Q and uses Mualani Q, 2nd half Sucrose Pyro Q from Guoba. 4AP on Xiangling is a huge increase. You lose ~10k w/o 4AP proc here.

nahida-yelan-furina-kuki.desc: KQMS, Festering r5 >= WolfFang > Pipe r5 for Furina. Team does not meaningfully benefit from Xiphos on Kuki. The performance is on par with Nahida Yelan Xingqiu Kuki.

fischl-kuki-yelan-nahida.desc: High Quicken uptime Kuki Hyperbloom with Desynced rotation to accommodate Fischl's cooldowns

clorinde-furina-yelan-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Double Hydro (Furina Yelan Xilonen).  21s rotation. A lot of NA weaving to maximize Yelan's Burst.

mualani-furina-baizhu-xiangling.desc: Mualani burn vape. 20s rotation Mualani bursts every rotation. Baizhu provides more healing and comfort than Nahida however less dendro app causes less consistent vapes Baizhu also lacks Nahida's EM buff. Energy based on lv100 icewind suite.

neuvillette-zhongli-emilie-xiangling.desc: Emilie does not burst, only skill's after Zhongli has held E. Deepwood using Zhongli is easy to maintain as he refreshes using tap E after Neuv does 2 Charge attacks. Wish u luck farming EM/EM/Crit AP set for Xiangling!

neuvillette-furina-zhongli-sayu.desc: Neuvillette-Furina with Resistance to Interruption 4CA rotation

hutao-yelan-kazuha-bennett.desc: Hu Tao Yelan VV Vape . 19s 1 Vaporized Yelan E Very energy demanding rotation pray your favs proc

neuvillette-furina-zhongli-lynette.desc: variation of neuv - furi hypercarry with lynette on HB% for fanfare. rot also works for pre-c4 lynette.

sucrose-fischl-yaemiko-nahida.desc: Yae Fischl aggravate. No healing or shielding. Swap to sucrose multiple times to refresh buffs and proc c4 skill cooldown reduction

clorinde-fischl-kirara-xiangling.desc: TF Clorinde quickburn with Kirara. 25s~ rotation, everyone use 2 skills per rotation. Kirara doesn't burst. High quicken uptime.

arlecchino-zhongli-chiori-bennett.desc: Arle Chiori Zhongli Bennett. 16s rot (very tight). No Arle Q, 3[N5D] N3. chiori's short field time allows bennett to catch arle E particles. no 4AP is about 3k behind.

alhaitham-nilou-xingqiu-kirara.desc: Haitham Nilou Xq Kirara without 5* cons and weapons

arlecchino-xilonen-zhongli-bennett.desc: Arle Zhongli Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q. C 3[N5D] N1. Xilonen and Zhongli comes after Bennett Q.

lyney-furina-lynette-bennett.desc: Lyney vape with Lynette. 1st rotation swirls pyro ingame but not in sim because weapon swirl is not implemented. Lyney 6C and Burst every rotation.

neuvillette-furina-zhongli-xianyun.desc: Zhongli provides resistance to interruption and 4AP buffs. Xianyun provides healing, 4VV, and energy. Slightly worse than Jean due to Xianyun's longer animations

xiao-furina-xianyun-bennett.desc: Pyro Xiao vape with 50% collision rate. 8 high plunges. KQMC

hutao-yelan-furina-jean.desc: Hu Tao double hydro. Uses early Jean Burst to frontload fanfare stacks and not have long animations during Yelan's Burst. 2 Yelan Skills while her burst is active.

neuvillette-furina-kazuha-shenhe.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Shenhe. 4CA 26s rot. Shenhe hold E provides 15% CA DMG Bonus to Neuv via her A4. Here, her hE is used before Kazuha to allow ~1s more generous VV uptime but using it before Furina Q also works and it's not that different.

arlecchino-chevreuse-kazuha-bennett.desc: Arle mono pyro w chevreuse for c6 and small amt of dmg. 15/16s rotation N3D combo. Funell Arle skill particles to bennett. Alternates Kazuha skill and burst usage

kokomi-fischl-nahida-raiden.desc: fischl NE - nahida NEQ - kokomi NED - raiden NE - kokomi 3N2C N2 - fischl NQ - kokomi N2CN2 Q 10N2W N2

arlecchino-kaeya-yunjin-xilonen.desc: Arlecchino Kaeya Xilonen YunJin. Arlecchino with C6 Kaeya Melt. 6N3D combo. 16s rot. No Arle Q. C2+ Arle needs a different rotation.

kinich-nahida-yelan-ororon.desc: Kinich Nahida Yelan Ororon. ~19s Rot. Kinich with Hyperbloom Ororon. Kinich seeks blindspots. No Kinich short hold is -3K DPS. Nahida's burst is a DPS loss.

kazuha-yaemiko-fischl-kirara.desc: Yae, Fischl, Kazuha, Kirara - Ur gonna have significantly worse results ingame because first rotation dps is lower and u'd likely kill enemies in one and a half rotation

hutao-yelan-xingqiu-lisa.desc: Hutao Over vape with Double Hydro and Lisa

kinich-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Kinich Nahida Raiden Xingqiu. ~21s Rot. Kinich Hyperbloom from range accounting for distance (ommiting Xingqiu's rainswords during his combo). Kinich bursts every other rotation. No short hold E on Kinich is -6K DPS. Nahida fills time after Kinich's field time.

arlecchino-zhongli-kazuha-bennett.desc: Arle mono pyro w a shield. 15/16s rotation N3D combo. Funell Arle skill particles to bennett. Alternates Kazuha skill and burst usage

arlecchino-emilie-xilonen-bennett.desc: Arle "Mono Pyro" with Emilie and Xilonen. ~16s rotation. Arle 3[N5D] N1 and no Burst. Setup is just barely long enough for Arle's skill to be upgraded. Bennett dashes for AP after skill & burst.

nahida-xingqiu-raiden-baizhu.desc: Raiden Xingqiu Nahida Baizhu. Baizhu 2E 22s rot. this 2E helps raiden to have enough energy w/o ER sands. Raiden on-field hyperbloom. it is crucial to weav NAs between actions for XQ's Q proc

fischl-raiden-yelan-nahida.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Nahida Yelan Fischl

neuvillette-fischl-kazuha-xilonen.desc: Neuv Fischl Kazuha Xilonen. 4CA 27s rot. Assuming 2nd Xilonen E being mostly hydro scroll. Check out the samples to see how the setup works, noting that Oz has ~12s duration.

clorinde-sara-thoma-chevreuse.desc: OL Clorinde w/ Thoma. 17s rotations. Sara and Chevreuse funnel particles to Clorinde to lower Clorinde's ER reqs while also still buffing Clorinde's Burst. Clorinde makes use of her Skill movement to extend Sara's buff from her Burst

arlecchino-chiori-xilonen-bennett.desc: Arle Chiori Xilonen Bennett. 16s rot No Arle Q, C 3[N5D] N1. 4NO on Bennett is ~3k loss.

hutao-yelan-kuki-furina.desc: Hu Tao overvape. First rotation starts with Kuki E whereas subsequent ones don't

yelan-furina-kazuha-xilonen.desc: Optimized rotation. Kazuha burst every other rotation; Yelan MH is slightly better than EOSF, HP and Hydro goblets are about equal; Furina HP goblet is slightly better, pipe is about 2% worse than festering.

clorinde-yaemiko-xiangling-chevreuse.desc: Overload Clorinde w/ Yae Miko, Xiangling and Chevreuse. 16s Rotation. XL uses her Burst every other rotation. Chevreuse builds towards damage instead of HP, since her increased personal damage contributes more than what additional ATK% her A4 buff would provide.

clorinde-fischl-kazuha-yaoyao.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (FoHW) w/ Fischl Kazuha Yao Yao. Yao Yao's low maintenance and skill-based Dendro application makes her a great carrier of TotM for this team.

arlecchino-emilie-zhongli-bennett.desc: Arle Emilie Zhongli Bennett. No Arle Q 16-17s rot. Emilie Q every 2rot. Both Emilie and Zhongli come after Bennett Q.

neuvillette-furina-ororon-zhongli.desc: Neuv Furina Ororon Zhongli. 4CA 26s rot. Zhongli takes 2nd field time between Neuv field time using tE for Sac Jade passive, picking up Hydro Shards for 4AP, and Fav proc.

alhaitham-nilou-xingqiu-yaoyao.desc: Marechaussee Hunter Alhaitham in Nilou bloom team. KQMS. Yaoyao E -> Nilou EN2E -> Alhaitham Q swap XQ QN -> Alhaitham longest combo -> XQ EDN2.

navia-xilonen-fischl-bennett.desc: Navia Fischl Xilonen Bennett. Xilonen 1E 17-18s rot. Start with Bennett E dash for the scroll setup in the first rot. Navia keep herself on-field w/o swapping out.

neuvillette-furina-kazuha-kirara.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Kirara. 4CA 27-28s rotation. Kirara provides 12+12% DMG Bonus from her C6 and 4pc Scroll, with her shield for Interruption to resistance.

gaming-zhongli-rosaria-bennett.desc: Plunge fast after Rosaria bursts, but slower after 4 plunges, in order to keep up with the slow cryo application Rosaria has. Bennett does his skill before Zhongli in first rotation to apply pyro.

arlecchino-xiangling-kazuha-bennett.desc: Arle mono pyro w Xiangling for c1 and c6 buffs as well as some dmg. Xiangling bursts every other rotation 16s rotation N3D combo.

alhaitham-nilou-xingqiu-baizhu.desc: Marechaussee Hunter Alhaitham in Nilou bloom team with Baizhu as healer. KQMS. Alhaitham uses split fieldtime combo to accomodate 2 baizhu's skills (and favonius).

sucrose-fischl-yaemiko-tighnari.desc: Yae Fischl aggravate with Tighnari to enable quicken and do some dmg. Yae tighnari and sucrose share field time

furina-neuvillette-fischl-jean.desc: Neuvillette Electrocharge with no interruption resistance - Unoptimised random delay sim - 2-4 frames delay between non-bufferable actions, 9-15 frames of swap delay

arlecchino-yelan-zhongli-bennett.desc: Shielded Arle does N3C N14, 18 second rotation. Very comfy, works in multiwave content without the faff of swapping off Arle. No threat of death hanging over your head like the Sword of Damocles as long as ur dodging even a little bit.

navia-zhongli-furina-xianyun.desc: Navia does not hold E, only taps it. 4 High plunges per E, 50% collision. Furina swap in between Navia E's to proc Fav.

gaming-xilonen-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Gaming Rosaria Xilonen Xianyun. ~21s Rot. Gaming does 6 melted plunges + 1non reacted plunge (for energy), slower plunges after the first 4. Scroll covers 5 plunges and Xilonen's RES shred covers 6.

kinich-dehya-bennett-emilie.desc: 5 Quickscope Scalespiker Cannon Combo with Interruption Resistance. KQMS Stats.

hutao-xingqiu-bennett-furina.desc: Hu Tao Furina Bennett Xingqiu. Uses Xingqiu's Skill in Bennett's Burst.

alhaitham-nahida-xingqiu-kuki.desc: Alhaitham Nahida Xingqiu Kuki. 22s rotation. XQ EDQN -> Kuki Q if ready -> Nahida EN -> Alhaitham Q -> Kuki NE -> Alhaitham 2N3D NE N3D N3C 3N3D N3 (C)

fischl-kuki-xingqiu-nahida.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with 4GT Fischl. Enemy radius=3

lyney-bennett-xilonen-chiori.desc: Lyney Bennett Chiori Xilonen. 16s rotation. Lyney does 5 CA or 6 if burst isn't available. Chiori's C1 is around 11% team dps increase.

gaming-furina-xingqiu-bennett.desc: Gaming does 6 Ep N1. Juggle Man-Chai's ingame by pressing Skill after attacking and catching/almost catching it before plunging.

lyney-xiangling-kazuha-bennett.desc: Lyney Monopyro. Xiangling bursts every other rotation.

clorinde-fischl-kazuha-collei.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (FoHW) w/ Fischl Kazuha Collei. Collei provides consistent Dendro application to maintain Quicken and decent team EM buffing.

clorinde-fischl-kazuha-furina.desc: Clorinde Fischl Kazuha Furina. 17s rotation. Furina and Kazuha alternate their Bursts each rotation to reduce ER requirements and rotation length.

kaveh-fischl-xingqiu-raiden.desc: kaveh double electro HB with instructors kaveh, fairly easy rotation for kaveh, only 1 walk cancel, no dash cancels

clorinde-fischl-heizou-nahida.desc: FoHW Clorinde Aggravate w/ Heizou. 16s rotations. Alternative Anemo to Kazuha and Sucrose.

neuvillette-furina-kazuha-navia.desc: Neuvillette Furina Kazuha Navia. Navia hold E is used for Archaic Petra, Kazuha does not use his burst.

neuvillette-xilonen-zhongli-xiangling.desc: Neuv Vape with Xiangling Xilonen Zhongli. 4CA 27s rot. AP Xiangling is better than AP Zhongli and EoSF Xiangling. Zhongli barely procs Instructor but better than nothing.

fischl-kazuha-kirara-clorinde.desc: Clorinde TF With Kirara team abusing thunder fury.

raiden-yelan-furina-xilonen.desc: Raiden Yelan Furina Xilonen. 21s rot. Xilonen gets both Electro and Hydro Crystallize shards rather consistently.

neuvillette-yelan-kazuha-xilonen.desc: Neuv Yelan Kazuha Xilonen. 4CA 28s rot. Yelan 2E. Yelan provides hydro particles, and A4 DMG Bonus. 4EoSF on Yelan is ~9% low.

clorinde-fischl-lynette-nahida.desc: TF Clorinde Aggravate w/ Lynette. 25s rotations. Alternative Anemo to Kazuha and Sucrose with a simpler rotation.

arlecchino-nilou-kazuha-bennett.desc: arle vape with nilou. nilou does not deal damage but enable vapes in AoE without having er requirements. r5 sac sword nilou to shorten rotation to 16s. n3d arle, no arle burst.

kinich-ororon-fischl-nahida.desc: Kinich double Electro double Dendro quicken. Nahida and Kinich alternate burst use. Nahida uses some CAs to fill time. Kinich spins to catch blindspots and uses short hold E, gets 3 canons per skill.

kokomi-nilou-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Nilou Bloom with Triple Hydro Kokomi Xingqiu and Nahida

gaming-diona-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Gaming Diona Rosaria Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Melt Gaming with a Cryo Venn diagram. 6 buffed skill plunges melted + 1 unbuffed plunge melted. Mind your Cryo aura, 4 delayed plunges + 2 immediate plunges

furina-sucrose-hutao-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Yelan Furina team that fits grouping. Prototype Amber Healing Bonus Sucrose as sole healer makes this team very fragile.

neuvillette-charlotte-kazuha-furina.desc: Neuvillette Furina Charlotte Kazuha Hydropump, better in dps than the Zhongli+Charlotte version but more annoying without Neuvillette c1

clorinde-fischl-klee-chevreuse.desc: Clorinde OL w/ Support Klee. 16s rotations. Klee buffs Clorinde and Fischl with Hakushin Ring and Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City. Jumpy Dumpty is able to extend Chevreuse's A1 for the entirety of Clorinde's field time.

gaming-diona-rosaria-bennett.desc: 4* melt gaming. 6 plunges + 1 non-buffed plunge. pay attention to cryo aura ingame. Needs good positioning for overlapping diona and rosaria burst

kinich-emilie-zhongli-bennett.desc: Kinich Emilie Zhongli Bennett. 18s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. Assuming Zhongli pillar consistently hit the enemy for 4Deepwood.

hutao-zhongli-yelan-fischl.desc: Hu Tao overvape Zhongli Hold E> Yelan QEN4> Fischl E/Q> Hu Tao N2C 8N1C N2.. Hutao Starting HP=1.

mualani-kazuha-xilonen-xiangling.desc: Mualani Vape. Mualani and Xiangling burst every other Mualani skill, Xilonen and Kazuha never burst. When Mualani bursts, she skips her third NA. Xiangling's C4 ruins this rotation. Assumes Mualani's burst hits almost instantly.

hutao-yelan-chevreuse-furina.desc: no overload chev. used for healing and c6 pyro dmg%

neuvillette-furina-zhongli-heizou.desc: Pamber Heizou is also an option for a 4VV healer, with very minor grouping. Not being able to hold Favonius means that Neuv/Furina have slightly higher ER reqs.

arlecchino-chiori-albedo-bennett.desc: arle double geo. 16s~ rotation. chiori and albedo alternate burst use to fill downtime. both get burst and initial skill buffed by bennett. 6n3d no burst arle, crystallize can provide some survivability.

dori-furina-yelan-kazuha.desc: Dori Double Hydro EC. Not much time is spent on-fielding dori herself

lyney-xilonen-kazuha-bennett.desc: Lyney "Mono" with 2 shredders and no IR. 15s 4CA rotation

alhaitham-nahida-furina-lisa.desc: Alhaitham Hyperbloom with Nahida Furina Lisa. use 2 prototype amber

clorinde-sara-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Clorinde Sara Chev Bennett. 16s rot with DPS Chevreuse. Sara Q every 2 rots to avoid 20s rot length. Clorinde Q at the end every 2 rots.

clorinde-fischl-kazuha-baizhu.desc: TF Clorinde Aggravate w/ Baizhu. 26s rotation. Baizhu builds as much HP as possible for his A4 buff, and uses Hakushin Ring to buff most of Clorinde's field time.

sucrose-yaemiko-fischl-kirara.desc: Yae Fischl aggravate with ins Kirara and hakushin Sucrose. Yae frontloads a lot of damage with q thanks to numerous em buffs. (25s rot)

raiden-nahida-luminedendro-xingqiu.desc: Onfield Raiden Hyperbloom with Nahida DMC and Xingqiu

clorinde-xingqiu-nahida-fischl.desc: TF Clorinde Quickbloom w/ Xingqiu. 26s rotation. Xingqiu provides IR for Clorinde to limit rotation disruption. Clorinde partially builds into EM due to the increased Bloom production and lower Quicken uptime relative to Furina.

jean-furina-yelan-xingqiu.desc: Mono hydro onfield "carry yelan"  2 Yelan e rotation very simple to execute.

hutao-xingqiu-xilonen-yelan.desc: Hu tao C0 double hydro with Xilonen. Hutao starting HP=1.

neuvillette-furina-dehya-kazuha.desc: Dehya provides resistance to interruption. Neuv E > Furina N1 E d N1 > Kazuha EPQ > Dehya N1 E N1 > Furina Q > Neuv CA E CA Q > Kazuha EP > Neuv CA CA

xianyun-navia-ningguang-furina.desc: Navia Plunge 50% collisions. 2 Ningguang e to battery Navia.

nahida-xingqiu-raiden-zhongli.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Nahida Xingqiu Zhongli

arlecchino-xingqiu-sucrose-bennett.desc: Does not swirl hydro. Arle N3C N16 combo. Sucrose Ed N2 after Bennett Ed Q. Needs to stall for time by using Xingqiu and Sucrose normal attacks since Xingqiu E cd is 21s long.

neuvillette-furina-yaemiko-lynette.desc: standard neuvi - furina hyper with lynette as anemo and yae as flex. no totem refresh for max furina Q uptime. lynette uses HB% circlet to stack fanfare and EM build is best for damage. widsith yae is better than hakushin. rot is for C4+/sacsword lynette, but alternate rot is included.

navia-ningguang-bennett-furina.desc: Navia-Ningguang first rotation with sustainable ER through multiple rotations

neuvillette-furina-emilie-xiangling.desc: Neuv Furina Emilie Xiangling. 4CA 27s rot. Emilie Q every rot but long rot length and Xiangling's Fav lowers the ER req.

kokomi-nahida-nilou-luminedendro.desc: Nilou Bloom with Kokomi Nahida and Ins DMC

gaming-furina-xilonen-xianyun.desc: Gaming Furina Xilonen Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Gaming does 7 E plunges with no delay for the final plunge. Xilonen's Scroll set buffs Pyro on the first rotation. Xilonen does not use Q.

hutao-yelan-baizhu-furina.desc: Hu Tao Burgeon. 2 Yelan E 1 Baizhu E rotation. Hutao does N1C to reduce pyro application and vapes about 80% of her Charged Attacks on avg

arlecchino-navia-chiori-bennett.desc: arle double geo dual carry with navia. 17-19s rotation. navia burst every other rotation to reduce er requirements. navia get 2 bennett buffed Es. n3d no burst arle. ap on chiori or bennett very slightly better.

lyney-yaemiko-fischl-chevreuse.desc: Lyney Overload. Yae does not burst in this rotation but she often wants to in-game. Low pyro aura uptime makes C6 Chev a more significant DPS increase for Lyney. Building Chev for more healing allows Lyney to more comfortably stack mare and prop surplus in-game. 15s rotation.

neuvillette-yaemiko-nahida-xiangling.desc: neuvi nahida xl yae. ~30s optimized rot, 9-15f random swap delay, 2-4f random action delay. neuvi waits for nahida E to fall off -> shCA at the end for 3 A1 stacks every rot

lyney-xiangling-zhongli-bennett.desc: Lyney Monopyro with AP Xiangling and 2 weakspots

yelan-xingqiu-raiden-nahida.desc: Onfield Raiden Hyperbloom with Xingqiu Nahida Yelan

arlecchino-furina-yelan-bennett.desc: Arle Double hydro. Bennett and Yelan recieve healing. Low Fanfare generation with C0 Furina

neuvillette-nahida-emilie-xiangling.desc: Emilie bursts every rotation AFTER Xiangling so that Xiangling has her skill off cooldown by the time Neuv has done 2 Charge attacks. Xiangling funnels Fav particles to Neuv for lower energy requirements.

clorinde-nahida-fischl-thoma.desc: Clorinde Nahida Fischl Thoma. ~26s Rot. TF Clorinde Quickburn. Clorinde closes the rotation with burst. Deepwood Thoma maximizes Nahida's damage. Nahida skips burst sans ER.

diluc-xianyun-furina-chevreuse.desc: G9d7RJptfjbm: diluc plunge with furina+chevreuse, using diluc's burst

yoimiya-furina-yelan-xilonen.desc: Yoimiya Furina Yelan Xilonen. ~21s Rot. Yelan skill just before and after Yoimiya field time. Xilonen uses skill twice and bursts before Furina. Yelan has the highest damage share. No burst Youmiya.

gaming-xingqiu-sucrose-bennett.desc: VV setup is a bit tricky, ensure u dash away from enemy and apply pyro before attacking with Sucrose. Gaming juggles his Man Chai while weaving attacks between E plunges. Ingame, press Skill after attacking and while mid-air, wait till Man Chai has reached extremely close to Gaming before plunging

alhaitham-furina-yelan-kuki.desc: Deepwood: Yelan > Furina > Alhaitham. No jump cancels. Customized random frame delays + Starting HP%s; Hurt interval; 12-3 Icewind Suite energy.

xianyun-navia-yelan-furina.desc: Navia double hydro plunge. Very low Yelan dmg as Navia sacrifices Yelan dmg to do 4 geo plunges. 2 Yelan E and fav proc to help Navia's solo geo ER req

hutao-xingqiu-xianyun-furina.desc: Xianyun lets Hu Tao do charge attacks followed by low plunges.. Between the Bennett and Jean variants of this team, this Xianyun variant is both not constrained to an area and allows for slightly larger AOE than her normal charge attack playstyle.

clorinde-sara-nahida-xilonen.desc: Aggravate Clorinde (FoHW) w/ Sara, Nahida and Xilonen. 16s rotation. Clorinde uses her Burst every other rotation due to ER constraints. Nahida and Xilonen use their Bursts when Clorinde cannot use hers.

hutao-xingqiu-yelan-fischl.desc: TF Hu Tao with Double Hydro and Fishcl

fischl-yaemiko-xiangling-emilie.desc: Yae Fischl aggravate/burning. On field Yae doing mainly N2C. Full EM Xiangling build. Emilie bursts every rotation after the first.

furina-kazuha-fischl-kokomi.desc: Kokomi Electrocharge - There is a lot of dead time before Fischl refresh and subsequent Kokomi burst so read the config for the specifics- Hyperoptimised sim

yoimiya-fischl-chevreuse-bennett.desc: yoi overload. yoi uses 4pc TF to reduce her skill cooldown and fit into 16s rotation. yoi uses few phys NAs to fill time on rotations she doesn't burst.

arlecchino-candace-kazuha-bennett.desc: Arle Candace Kazuha Bennett. 17s rot. No Arle Q, 5[N3D] N2. Using 2 Candace E per rot for her high ER needs.

alhaitham-xingqiu-kuki-yaoyao.desc: Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite; Customized random frame delays; No jump cancels; KurtC. Many alternative build options.

clorinde-xiangling-chevreuse-bennett.desc: clorinde overload with triple pyro. 16s~ rotation with xiangling burst every other rotation to fit into shorter rotation and reduce er needs. clorinde burst when ready.

clorinde-furina-kazuha-ororon.desc: Clorinde Furina Kazuha Ororon. 16s rot. Clorinde Q every other rot. When Furina E is on cd, use Kazuha Q instead.

neuvillette-chiori-furina-zhongli.desc: Neuv Furina Chiori Zhongli. 4CA 26s rot. No grouping but less issue thanks to neuv's AoE.

alhaitham-furina-fischl-kuki.desc: Deepwood Furina. 90%/70%/70%/60% Starting HP respectively; Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite; KurtC; Customized random frame delays. Many alternative build options.

lyney-zhongli-chiori-bennett.desc: Lyney double geo. 5CA 16s rotation. 4Petra on Bennett. Lyney 4CA + E doesn't quite fit within Petra uptime, in practice you may want to 3CA + E + 1CA but the last CA gets cut off unless you adjust config.

chevreuse-fischl-bennett-keqing.desc: pyro keqing with chev and c6 benny. note that keqing has no IR and is left with very little stamina to dodge

dori-fischl-furina-nahida.desc: C6 TF Dori Hyperbloom with Fischl Furina Nahida. 25s rot.

clorinde-fischl-nahida-yelan.desc: TF Clorinde w/ Nahida, Yelan, Fischl. No Clorinde Burst. Yelan does 2 Skills for lower ER requirements, allowing her to use offensive weapons instead of Fav-adjacent ones.

lyney-xilonen-emilie-bennett.desc: Lyney Mono Pyro w/ Emilie and Xilonen. ~17.5s rotation. Lyney does 4 charged shots or 5 if burst isn't available.

hutao-yelan-kokomi-furina.desc: Hu Tao triple Hydro. Kokomi Q 3N2 + Her Elemental skill is enough healing to sustain Furina's drain and max fanfare stacks every rotation

kokomi-furina-yelan-zhongli.desc: Kokomi mono hydro with Zhongli. Kokomi alternating dash and walk cancels.  ~21s 2 Yelan E rotation. Very comfortable/safe team

xianyun-furina-yelan-fischl.desc: On field MH Yelan is slightly better than on field XY. 26s rotation, KQMS.

yoimiya-yelan-fischl-bennett.desc: Yoimiya overvape. 18 s rotation. Yelan NEQN -> Bennett QNE -> Fischl E/Q -> Yoimiya EN... -> Bennett NE. High theoretical damage but no shields.

arlecchino-emilie-fischl-bennett.desc: Arle Emilie Fischl Bennett. 16s rot. No Arle Q 6[N3D] N1. Emilie Q every 2 rots on Bennett Q. Few aggravate counts, but Fischl triggers a lot of overloaded.

arlecchino-kazuha-zhongli-bennett.desc: Arle Zhongli Kazuha Bennett. 16s rot(very tight). No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. no 4AP is about 3k behind.

gaming-furina-xilonen-chevreuse.desc: Gaming Furina Xilonen Chevreuse. ~20s Rot. Gaming does 7 E plunges. Xilonen's Scroll buffs Pyro nearly every rotation with Chevreuse, who can overwhelms Hydro aura. Xilonen's burst is not optimal vs funneling particles to Furina. Scroll covers 6 plunges while Xilonen's RES shred covers all of Gaming's Field time.

arlecchino-candace-sucrose-bennett.desc: Arle Candace Sucrose Bennett. ~18s Rot.Standard Vaporize command, Sucrose strengthens harlequin with the use of Viridescent Venerer, Bennett strengthens with his burst, Candace gives hydro status.

neuvillette-yelan-lynette-xilonen.desc: Neuv Yelan Lynette Xilonen. 4CA ~27s rot with Yelan 2E. Yelan provides hydro particles, and A4 DMG Bonus, Lynette provides a Taunt. Rot works with pre-C4 Lynette.

alhaitham-raiden-furina-baizhu.desc: Split uptime Alhaitham rotation. 2 Baizhu skill uses for energy healing and fanfare generation

sethos-xilonen-nahida-furina.desc: Sethos Furina quickbloom with Xilonen as healer and buffer. 20s~ rotation with 2 Sethos E, Sethos does 8N2W and 1 Shadow Piercing Shot. Note that Sethos might not be reliable in hitting bloom cores

neuvillette-raiden-nahida-xiangling.desc: Rotation is highly optimized using delays to increase the number of vapes. Additionally, AFKing occurs at the end of the rotation to make sure Nahida E drops off so there is an EC for Neuv A1.

arlecchino-zhongli-fischl-bennett.desc: Arle Fischl Zhongli Bennett. 16s rot (very tight). No Arle Q, 6[N3D]

clorinde-emilie-fischl-thoma.desc: Clorinde Emilie Fischl Thoma. ~24s Rot. TF Clorinde Quickburn. Clorinde closes the rotation with burst. Deepwood Thoma maximizes Emilie's damage. Emilie bursts every other rot after the first. EM build Thoma.

clorinde-sara-kazuha-furina.desc: Clorinde EC w/ Sara. Two split 16s rotations (or a large 32s rotation). Sara always takes the field before Clorinde to buff Clorinde's Skill combo and Burst.

kinich-ororon-xinyan-bennett.desc: Kinich Ororon Xinyan Bennett. Kinich using shE. ~20s rot. Start with Kinich Q for Scroll proc in the first rot.

lyney-zhongli-emilie-bennett.desc: Lyney Emilie Zhongli Bennett. 16s rot. Emilie and Zhongli before Bennett Q. Emilie Q if ready.

hutao-chevreuse-fischl-yaemiko.desc: Hutao Chevreuse Fischl Yae. ~17s Rot. Overload Hutao doing 6N3CJ. Hutao & Chevreuse burst every other rotation. Yae does not burst. EM build options for Hutao in config.

clorinde-furina-ororon-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Furina Ororon Xilonen. ~27s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Taser with Furina. AP Xilonen almost always Crystallizes Electro before and after Clorinde's skill. Xilonen's burst isn't nessesary on the first rotation.

neuvillette-furina-navia-jean.desc: Neuvillette Furina Navia Jean. Navia hold E is used for Archaic Petra. Up to 4 fav procs per rotation makes the ER reqs very comfortable.

nahida-xingqiu-raiden-kuki.desc: Raiden Kuki hyperbloom with Nahida Xingqiu

kaveh-baizhu-xingqiu-raiden.desc: kaveh baizhu xq raiden with a simple kaveh string, ins kaveh

gaming-furina-yelan-xianyun.desc: Gaming juggles his Man Chai while weaving attacks between E plunges. Ingame, press Skill after attacking and while mid-air, wait till Man Chai has reached extremely close to Gaming before plunging

clorinde-furina-fischl-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Furina Fischl Xilonen. ~27s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Taser with Furina. AP Xilonen almost always Crystallizes Electro before and after Clorinde's skill. Xilonen's burst isn't nessesary on the first rotation.

noelle-yelan-furina-xilonen.desc: Petra Noelle driving double hydro with Xilonen. 22s rotation

kinich-emilie-thoma-bennett.desc: Kinich Emilie Thoma Bennett. 19s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise.

neuvillette-albedo-furina-zhongli.desc: Neuv Furina Albedo Zhongli. 4CA 26s rot. No grouping but less issue thanks to neuv's AoE. Albedo's flower can be broken. shruge

kazuha-yaemiko-fischl-baizhu.desc: yae N1EN1EN1E; kazuha Ep; fischl E; kazuha Q; baizhu EQ; yae N1QN1EN1EN1E; kazuha Ep; fischl Q; baizhu E; yae N2CJ; kazuha Ep; yae N2CJ N2d N1;

fischl-xingqiu-kazuha-yelan.desc: 22s Yelan onfield taser carry -- Hyperoptimized with 4TF Fischl, high margin of error from frame delays

neuvillette-ororon-nahida-xiangling.desc: Neuv Nahida Xiangling Ororon. ~29s 4CA rot. 9-15f random swap delay, 2-4f random action delay. Neuv waits for Nahida E to fall off -> shCA at the end for 3 A1 stacks every rot

wanderer-yelan-furina-xilonen.desc: VV Fav Codex Wanderer driving double hydro with Xilonen. 21s rotation

ayaka-xilonen-shenhe-furina.desc: Ayaka Xilonen Shenhe Furina. Ayaka freeze without grouping. 22s rotation. Xilonen uses her burst at the start of the rotation to heal everyone. 2 Xilonen skills, 2 Shenhe skills. Fav Impact.

sethos-lisa-nahida-furina.desc: Sethos quickbloom with Furina, Pamber Nahida and Pamber Lisa for healing. 20s 2E Sethos rotation, Sethos does 8N2W and 2 Shadow Piercing Shots. Lisa uses hold E for energy.

arlecchino-fischl-chevreuse-xiangling.desc: Arle Fischl Xiangling Chev. 20s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. the N5 at the end is used for waiting 20s cd of xiangling, you can do EQE instead.

kazuha-fischl-yaemiko-tighnari.desc: Yae Fischl aggravate with tighnari enabling quicken. Tighnari swaps in and out multiple times for quicken and instructor uptime

raiden-sara-xiangling-chevreuse.desc: Raiden carry. Healing/ HP Chevreuse build. Sara buffs her own burst Xiangling and Raiden's bursts. Chevreuse funnels particles to Xiangling.

navia-xilonen-yelan-bennett.desc: Navia Yelan Xilonen Bennett. Yelan 1E 18s rot. Starts with Yelan maxing out her A4.

gaming-yelan-sucrose-bennett.desc: Bennett uses hold E lvl 1 to apply pyro. Sucrose does not swirl hydro here. Gaming juggles his Man Chai while weaving attacks between E plunges. Ingame, press Skill after attacking and while mid-air, wait till Man Chai has reached extremely close to Gaming before plunging

neuvillette-fischl-lynette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Fischl Lynette Xiangling. 4CA 27s rot. Simply [Lynette > Fischl > Xiangling > Neuv] order twice. Xiangling built EM for Overloaded damage.

hutao-yelan-sucrose-bennett.desc: Hu Tao VV Vape with Sucrose. Requires using Bennett's Hold Skill to swirl pyro. Rotation does not swirl Hydro

neuvillette-furina-lynette-sigewinne.desc: Neuv Furina Lynette Sigewinne. 4CA 25s rot. Fontaine tea party. Sigewinne uses her E after Furina Q.

kaveh-kirara-xingqiu-raiden.desc: kaveh kirara xingqiu raiden hyperbloom, instructors kaveh and deepwood kirara is sliightly better than deepwood kaveh and instructors kirara

hutao-yelan-fischl-ororon.desc: Hutao Yelan Fischl Ororon. ~17s Rot. Hutao double Electro Overvape. 9N2CJ Hutao.

hutao-yelan-xiangling-xingqiu.desc: "Funerational" Hu Tao Double Hydro. Delays Yelan's Burst cast to use 2 Elemental Skills while her Burst is active one of which is with fully stacked A4 DMG%

ningguang-yelan-furina-xilonen.desc: 21~ Rot Ningguang Yelan Furina Xilonen. KQMS stats. Expects crystalize to be picked up for Geo Resonance. Can be tough on stamina if at a distance, but tried to mitigate with 2NA and Burst for Star Jades.

gaming-fischl-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Gaming Fischl Chevreuse Bennett. 15s rot. Q N1 6EP. Chevreuse feeds her pyro and fav particles to gaming.

cyno-furina-fischl-nahida.desc: No healing except Pamber so bad survivability. MH is better than TF for Cyno.

navia-chiori-xianyun-bennett.desc: navia plunge, 18s~ rotation. navia does not build er and burst when ready, otherwise chiori bursts. 4 geo high plunges per skill, very tight. fav totm chiori and higher base atk weapon benny have a bit higher sim dps. no off field application, but navia still get decent number of shards on her skills.

lyney-xilonen-lynette-bennett.desc: Lyney Mono Pyro with double RES Shred. ~15s rotation. C4+ Lynette uses Burst if available, extra Skill charge otherwise. Assumes Lyney consistently hits weakspots.

neuvillette-furina-jean-kirara.desc: Neuv Furina Jean Kirara. 4CA 26s rotation. Kirara provides 12+12% DMG Bonus from her C6 and 4pc Scroll, with her shield for Interruption to resistance.

clorinde-arlecchino-chevreuse-fischl.desc: Arle and Clorinde dual dps w/ Chev and Fischl. 2nd Clorinde field time onwards does not have Oz.

alhaitham-nahida-furina-kuki.desc: Haitham quickbloom with single fieldtime haitham combo. 25s rotation

alhaitham-furina-kuki-baizhu.desc: GT Furina slightly higher than Deepwood Furina + Instructor/Clam Baizhu. Relatively comfy for HoD as far as Furina teams go. Customized random frame delays; Starting HP%s; Hurt interval; 12-3 Icewind Suite energy.

alhaitham-bennett-fischl-nahida.desc: 25s rot with Alhaitham Q mid-combo to refresh oz; Pretty optimized strings with no jump cancels; Energy drops based on 12-3 icewind suite; KurtC; Random frame delays: 9.5f mean 1.5 stddev (+1f base) for swap, 3 mean 1 stddev other actions

lynette-fischl-xingqiu-nahida.desc: hyperbloom driver lynette. deepwood xingqiu and instructor nahida. 25s rotation.

gaming-furina-ayato-bennett.desc: For us Ayato owners. Dude just does E N1 Q N1 before Furina burst. Bennett does not skill. Gaming plunges 9 times. To do this ingame, Press E immediately after Q and each plunge. Wait till Man Chai is extremely close to you, then plunge.

kirara-raiden-xingqiu-nahida.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Xingqiu Nahida Kirara

arlecchino-furina-sucrose-bennett.desc: Arle Furina Sucrose Bennett. 20s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 3[N5D] N2. Bennett Q C4 hE to leave pyro for sucrose to swirl it. Sucrose N1 E N3 to double swirl.

kazuha-fischl-yaemiko-nahida.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with a 25s Rotation. Rotation is primarily quickswap with Yae on field whenever possible to drive Fischl and maximise her A4 procs.

raiden-nahida-yaoyao-xingqiu.desc: Onfield Raiden hyperbloom with yaoyao. Rotation is XQ -> Nahida -> Yaoyao -> Raiden -> Nahida. Rotation is simple. It has a healer, and unlike nahida onfield, raiden in her Musou Isshin state won't get interrupted. Easier to reach theoretical dps in game.

furina-mona-hutao-yelan.desc: Clam Healing Bonus Mona. 2 Yelan E on first rotation only

fischl-xilonen-furina-yelan.desc: APL Yelan onfield with Fischl+Furina+Xilo. N4 spam, no cancels.

nahida-xingqiu-raiden-kokomi.desc: Nahida Xingqiu KOkomi Riaden Hyperbloom APL version

dori-furina-yelan-nahida.desc: Dori Furina Yelan Nahida. ~20s Rot. Simple on-field Hyperbloom with extented field time Fav GS Dori.

clorinde-fischl-thoma-chevreuse.desc: Clorinde Fischl Thoma Chevreuse.  17s rotation. EM Thoma for additional reaction damage, but weaker shield. Chevreuse Burst when available to let her build more HP.

kinich-ororon-fischl-zhongli.desc:
Kinich double electro quicken with Zhongli for survivability and res shred. Deepwood uptime rely on the pillar hitting (lol). 
18s~ rotation.

yaemiko-fischl-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Yae Chevreuse and Bennett share field time to generate energy and get Bennett's atk buff. 16s rotation Yae burst every other rotation.

sethos-fischl-nahida-furina.desc: Sethos Furina quickbloom with Pamber Nahida for healing. 20s rotation. MH slightly ahead of DPC and WT. Sethos does 8N2W + 3 Shadow Piercing Shots.

kinich-ororon-fischl-bennett.desc: Kinich quicken, with Benny as a buffer. No off field Pyro so no burning uptime. Kinich spins to catch blindspots and uses short hold E to get 3 canons per skill.

fischl-bennett-nahida-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham + Bennett and Fischl. Mostly a speedrun team

clorinde-kinich-fischl-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Kinich Fischl Xilonen. ~26s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Aggravate with Kinich. Kinich shoots 1 loop shot before burst; Kinch burst lasts into Clorinde's second skill, providing Dendro in multiwave. Scroll Kinich enables AP Xilonen, who picks up Crystallize before Clorinde's skill. Clorinde closes every rotation with burst.

hutao-yelan-diona-furina.desc: Hu Tao Yelan Furina. With a shield and (not a lot of) healing. Hu Tao makes rare use of Diona C6

bennett-xiangling-furina-xingqiu.desc: Bennett on field vape. Xiangling does majority of team's damage. Furina recieves no healing from Bennett. Bennet Bursts, then swaps to Xiangling and Xingqiu so they can buff their burst and skill respectively. Then he goes on field for remainder of the rotation.

hutao-yelan-xingqiu-kazuha.desc: Hu Tao double hydro with grouping. Rotation emphasises Yelan's dmg output by doing 2 skills while her Burst is active for increased Exquisite Throws.

kinich-ororon-thoma-bennett.desc: Kinich Ororon Thoma Bennett. Kinich using shE. 18-19s rot. Kinich Q if available. Ororon for Scroll trigger, build EM for Overloaded damage.

alhaitham-nilou-furina-kokomi.desc: Triple Hydro Bloom team. Bloom is ~80% of the total damage, but Furina's buffs enable herself and Alhaitham to do decent raw damage.

neuvillette-xingqiu-kazuha-xilonen.desc: Neuv Xingqiu Kazuha Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Xingqiu provides hydro particles, IR, and C2 Res Shred. 4EoSF on Xingqiu is ~5% low.

sucrose-xingqiu-fischl-baizhu.desc: Baizhu salad with good sucrose hyperbloom ownership

kinich-ororon-fischl-thoma.desc: Kinich quickburn with thoma. Despite the double electro, there is still alright burning uptime, kinich spins to catch blindspots and uses short hold E to get around 4 canons per skill.

noelle-furina-yelan-xilonen.desc: Noelle Yelan Furina Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Noelle is built for damage. Crystallize shards are caught by Noelle or with dashes or movement. Noelle Def > Geo DMG Goblet. Furina's HP remains high through the rotation. AP option in config.

navia-zhongli-xianyun-bennett.desc: navia plunge with shield. 18s~ rotation. crystallize pick up on dash. navia does not build er and burst when ready.  energy for bennett and xianyun can be a little tight if zl pillar breaks, can refresh pillar between navia skills for minimal dps loss. bennett skill between navia skills for energy and crystallize. clam might be a little unreliable.

clorinde-fischl-nahida-zhongli.desc: Clorinde Fischl Nahida Zhongli. 16s rot. Easy and straightforward. High ER req on Nahida. 4TotM Nahida, 4GT is ~1k less and 4DM is ~1.5k less.

clorinde-nahida-furina-ororon.desc: Clorinde Nahdia Furina Ororon. ~16 Rot. Clorinde Quickbloom with EM Ororon. Furina does her thing every other rotation. Nahida fills time in Furina's place and uses her burst. Nahida's combo's can likely be optimized.

clorinde-ororon-yelan-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Ororon Yelan Xilonen. ~17s Rot. Clorinde Taser. Emblem > NO Yelan. AP Xilonen consistently picks up Electro Crystallize before and after Clorinde's skill. Xilonen does not burst, but high ping players may want to.

nahida-xingqiu-furina-kuki.desc: KQMS. WolfFang r1 >= Festering r5 > Pipe r5 for Furina. Widsith Nahida + Fav furina and Fav Nahida + Festering Furina result in near identical simulated dps.

nahida-yaemiko-fischl-xianyun.desc: Yae aggravate plunge 50% collisions. Abyss 12-3 Coppelia energy

kinich-emilie-ororon-bennett.desc: Kinich Emilie Ororon Bennett. Kinich using shE. 18-19s rot. Kinich and Emilie Q if available. Ororon for Scroll trigger, build EM for Overloaded damage. Deepwood on Emilie is ~14% Team DPS increase over 4UR.

navia-xilonen-xiangling-bennett.desc: Navia Xiangling Xilonen Bennett. 21s rot. Navia 3rd E if available. Start with Bennett E dash for the scroll setup in the first rot.

kinich-furina-ororon-bennett.desc: Kinich "Quickbloom". Kinich with 3 characters focused on buffing him, with ororon also providing some quicken uptime. and occasionally triggering hyperblooms. 29s rotation. Kinich spins to catch blindspots and uses short hold E, gets 3 canons per skill.

hutao-yelan-zhongli-xingqiu.desc: Classic double hydro Hu Tao.  2 Yelan E. Xingqiu E with AP and Yelan A4 buff

gaming-xingqiu-xianyun-bennett.desc: Easy VV setup. Bennett E dash backwards Q, Xianyun N1 Ep Q N1. Gaming juggles his Man Chai while weaving attacks between 7 E plunges. Ingame, press Skill after attacking and while mid-air, wait till Man Chai has reached extremely close to Gaming before plunging.

clorinde-nahida-fischl-bennett.desc: Clorinde Fischl Nahida Bennett. ~16s Rot. Clorinde prefers crit weapons. 2E Bennett. Nahida bursts every other rotation after the first and fills time while Bennett's skill is on CD.

raiden-yelan-furina-jean.desc: Raiden double hydro. Electro VV is incosistent past first rotation

nilou-candace-nahida-yaoyao.desc: Nilou with Candace, Nahida, and Yaoyao. Candance does a surprising number of blooms

alhaitham-yelan-kuki-fischl.desc: Double electro Alhaitham hyperbloom. Good alternative for if you do not own Nahida.

clorinde-chiori-sara-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Sara Geo Wheelchair Team. Two separate 16s rotations (or a large 32s rotation). Xilonen uses her Burst at the start of every large rotation (except the first) to fill time.

bennett-arlecchino-rosaria-lynette.desc: Arle melt with Rosaria and Lynette. 18s rotation 6N3D combo. KQMS stats.

bennett-furina-jean-yelan.desc: benny vape dps. jean provide extra healing for furina and guaranteed pyro swirl via self swirl. 2e yelan 22s rotation.

nahida-xingqiu-raiden-albedo.desc: Raiden hyperbloom with Nahida Xingqiu Albedo

alhaitham-furina-raiden-xianyun.desc: # AlHaitham Furina Raiden Xianyun. ~29s Rot. AlHaitham Hyperplunge. Raiden refreshes E during Alhaitmam burst uptime. AlHaitham spends high plunges then does mirror combos. 70% collisions after E plunge, 50% after burst.

baizhu-furina-yelan-thoma.desc: Thoma burgeon featuring some furina forward vapes

neuvillette-charlotte-lynette-furina.desc: Neuv Furina Lynette Charlotte. 4CA 25s rot. Kazuha is on vacation. Lynette is free and has a taunt better than nothing.

fischl-nahida-yaemiko-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Yae Fischl Nahida

kaveh-yelan-xingqiu-raiden.desc: kaveh xingqiu raiden yelan with triple favge

sigewinne-furina-yelan-kazuha.desc: Sigewinne mono hydro with R5 sac bow, allowing to refresh her E stacks for furina

raiden-fischl-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Raiden Fischl Chevreuse Bennett. 18s rot. DPS build Chev. Q 2[hE] on bennett Q. Use Fischl N3Q to get Chev C6 buff and N1E at the end of the rot if available. Use Bennett E right before raiden to refresh Chev A1 res shred.

arlecchino-yelan-mona-bennett.desc: Arle Yelan Mona Bennett. Yelan 1E 18s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 6[N3D]. Mona's omen buffing Arle's high BoL hits

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-lisa.desc: Bennett Chevreuse Fischl Lisa. ~16-18s Rot. TF Bennett DPS generates partcles for DPS build Chevreuse. Lisa bursts every other rot before Oz within Bennett Q. Chevreuse Q3E every rot in Bennett Q. Bennett 3EM>EDC>ADC.

fischl-furina-yaemiko-baizhu.desc: Yae Fischl hyperbloom. Baizhu is given some additional field time to make up for his lower off field application

wanderer-bennett-faruzan-furina.desc: wanderer furina. burst at start of wanderer's field time if available

kinich-emilie-xiangling-bennett.desc: Kinich Emilie Xiangling Bennett. 21s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. Xiangling Burst every rot, she has really high ER even with Bennett 2E directly batteried.

clorinde-ororon-lynette-furina.desc: Clorinde Taser with Ororon and Lynette. 4 rotations alternating between starting with Furina ED Q and Lynette EQ. Requires C4/sac sword Lynette, and starts running into Skill cd if sim continues for more rots. Lynette's ER requirements are low so she builds for damage

raiden-furina-fischl-nahida.desc: Raiden quickbloom with Furina, with Prototype Amber Nahida as the sole survivability source. 20s rotation, Fischl burst rotation and skill every other rotation, Nahida attacks on field to fill time otherwise. GD, FOPL, MH, and emblem are similar on Raiden.

xianyun-furina-yelan-xingqiu.desc: On field MH Yelan is slightly better than on field XY. 25s rotation, KQMS.

klee-furina-xilonen-bennett.desc: Kleerina with Bennett and Xilonen. Xilonen bursts and uses 2 skills every rotation. 22-23s rotation.

clorinde-fischl-lumineanemo-nahida.desc: Clorinde Fischl Nahida with AMC on an EM/Electro/Crit build. Assumes Tornado hits full duration.

kokomi-nilou-nahida-collei.desc: Nilou with Kokomi, Nahida and Collei

neuvillette-raiden-nahida-dehya.desc: Neuvillette with vapes, hyperblooms and resistance to interrruption

klee-furina-yelan-bennett.desc: Klee Double Hydro Vape with Klee, Furina, Yelan, Bennett. Yelan 2E Rotation. Klee Vapes ~60% of her CAs. The whole team recieves at least 1 tick of bennett healing per rotation after the first rotation.

fischl-raiden-nahida-candace.desc: Double electro hyperbloom with Candace driver, ~15s rotation

hutao-yelan-bennett-xingqiu.desc: Hu Tao Double Hydro with Bennett

clorinde-fischl-furina-kazuha.desc: Clorinde Furina Fischl Kazuha. 20s rot. Start with fischl E and refresh oz with Q in the first rot. Kazuha groups the enemy before Clorinde enters to do her E combo.

nahida-furina-yaemiko-baizhu.desc: Yae Hyperbloom. 2 Baizhu E rotation. GT Furina is as good if not better, TOM is just funny.

freminet-furina-bennett-xianyun.desc: Freminet Furina Bennett Xianyun. ~21s Rot. Freminet Vape plunge without VV. Freminet uses skill and Pers damage between plunges to maintain his passives. 50% Collisions.

razor-fischl-xingqiu-nahida.desc: Fischl EN1 > Kusanali QEN1 > Xingqiu EDQN1 > Fischl N2Q > Razor EDN1Q N3ED 2N3D N3ED 2N3D N3EDN1.

arlecchino-yelan-layla-bennett.desc: Arle Yelan Layla Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q, N1 CA cancell 6[N3D]. CA cancel is DPS neutral (a few hundred DPS) here. not necessary.

kokomi-fischl-nahida-kuki.desc: Kokomi Fischl Nahida Kuki with random delays. Uses Kuki burst early in the rotation then onfields Kokomi without burst for a while. Right before Fischl burst, uses Kuki skill and only after that does Kokomi burst. Stays on her beyond her burst duration till Fischl Oz expires

freminet-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Freminet Nahida Raiden Xingqiu. ~21s Rot. Freminet Hyperbloom without Healing. Freminet weaves rainswords between skill uses. Freminet bursts every rotation. Nahida does not burst.

cyno-xingqiu-fischl-nahida.desc: Cyno Hyperbloom with Fischl Nahida and Xingqiu

clorinde-furina-navia-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Double Geo w/ Furina. 16s rotations. Furina takes the field every other rotation, as her Skill lasts for two Clorinde Skill combos. Navia uses her Burst in Furina's place on even numbered rotations. Clorinde uses her Burst when available.

arlecchino-fischl-chevreuse-thoma.desc: Arle Fischl Chev Thoma. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. read the comments inside for the detailed fischl setup.

raiden-fischl-kazuha-nahida.desc: Raiden aggravate with GT Fischl and no heal

beidou-kokomi-nahida-raiden.desc: On field kokomi hyperbloom with nahida burst talent lvl 8

raiden-xiangling-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Raiden Overload 20s rotation .3 Chevreuse skills. 2 Bennett skills funneled to Xiangling.

chevreuse-fischl-bennett-klee.desc: Klee overload reborn with Chevy. 17s-ish rotation with psuedo APL. swap_delay has some random variance instead of fixed 12 frames.

kazuha-furina-bennett-xianyun.desc: Kazuha Furina Bennett Xianyun. ~19s Rot. Simple Vape Plunge with grouping and no Pyro VV. Skill plunges bookend Kazuha's field time. 100% collisions for E plunges, 70% for starwicker plunges. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but Bubbles may miss.

kinich-ororon-fischl-xilonen.desc: Kinich quicken with TF to shorten his skill cd to fit into shorter rotation. Xilo buffs the electros and minorly buffs kinich via a4. kinich spins to catch blindspots and uses short hold E. he gets 3 canons per skill.

xingqiu-furina-bennett-xianyun.desc: Bennett Plunge with Xingqiu. Xianyun healing keeps Bennett above 90% for Harbinger. Vapes are not super timing sensitive. Xingqiu has Favonius to help with Bennett's ER problems.

sethos-dori-nahida-furina.desc: Sethos quickbloom with Furina. 20s~ rotation. Dori heals and provides energy for Sethos, with Pamber Nahida supplementing healing. 8N2W Sethos+ 2 Shadow Piercing Shots.

arlecchino-mona-kazuha-bennett.desc: Arle Mona Kazuha Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q, N3D combo. kazuha 2E per rot. used Pamber on mona for energy.

kokomi-nilou-luminedendro-kirara.desc: Nilou 2H2D with Kokomi, DMC, and Kirara

dori-xingqiu-fischl-nahida.desc: Dori Furina Fischl Nahida. ~24s Rot. Dori Hyperbloom with Xingqiu sans TF. Nahida takes the field during infusion downtime using N1C.

sethos-nahida-fischl-xilonen.desc: Sethos Nahida Fischl Xilonen. ~16s Rot.  Sethos Aggravate. Sethos looses a Shadowpeircing shot at the start of the chamber and end of his field time. Xilo only bursts when Sethos is waiting on skill CD. Nahida dashes for crystalize.

hutao-yelan-arlecchino-bennett.desc: Hu Tao Arle dual carry. 5N2CD Hutao then swap

raiden-kokomi-nahida-furina.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Kokomi Nahida Furina in ST. Kokomi Onfeild, n2dw, using walk for dash cooldown. Using event weapons, Kokomi replacable with PA, Furina with Pipe.

arlecchino-emilie-fischl-chevreuse.desc: Arle Emilie Fischl Chev. 16s rot. No Arle Q 6[N3D] N1. more mobile than bennett variant. Chevreuse provides ATK% and C6 DMG%. Fischl can hold either 4DM, 4UR, or 4GT.

keqing-fischl-nahida-furina.desc: Quickbloom Keqing with Furina. ~27s rotation. Note that at some point Fanfare gains diminish as Pamber is not enough to keep everyone above 50%

gaming-lynette-furina-chevreuse.desc: gaming vv vape without circle impact. chev provides her c6 buff,  easy vv setup, healing, and energy.gaming does 7 skill plunges. vha similar to cw. r5 fav lynette to get 2 procs

yelan-furina-bennett-xianyun.desc: Bennett Plunge with Yelan. Xianyun healing keeps Bennett above 90% for Harbinger. Vapes are not super timing sensitive. Yelan and Xianyun have Favonius to help with Bennett's ER problems. Only 1 Yelan E per rot.

clorinde-sara-chevreuse-xiangling.desc: Clorinde Sara Xiangling Chev. 20s rot with everyone using Q every rot.
