Chev can do 1 or 2 NAs (after hE) instead for fav and stack more HP but its just a few hundred DPS gain. Frequent swap on sara, using Aim before Xiangling, Q before Clorinde combo, and E before Clorinde Q.

neuvillette-furina-zhongli-sigewinne.desc: Neuv Furina Zhongli Sigewinne. 4CA 25s rot. Sigewinne pickup the hydro shard for 4AP twice. On the 2nd half, Zhongli uses tE to trigger 4pc Scroll while providing Hydro Shard for 4AP Sigenwinne. 4th CA isn't protected by his shield, use hE if uncomfortable.

dori-yelan-fischl-nahida.desc: Dori Yelan Fischl Nahida. ~24s Rot. Full EM Dori Hyperbloom. 2 E Yelan. Slingshot Yelan is viable.

hutao-fischl-xingqiu-bennett.desc: Hu Tao Overvape | Fill the time from 16s to 21s with just Bennett

lynette-neuvillette-raiden-nahida.desc: neuvi HB with NA weaving for E cd and more hydro app. lynette applies some hydro, triggers some HB, and shreds hydro RES fairly consistently. r5 fav for energy.

fischl-nahida-razor-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Fsichl Nahida razor

raiden-yelan-bennett-xiangling.desc: Raiden e > Yelan q n1 > Bennett q n1e > Xiangling n1q n1ed > Yelan n2e > Raiden n1q n4d n4e n4d n3 > Yelan n1e n2 > Bennett n1 e

fischl-ayato-nahida-raiden.desc: ayato fischl raiden nahida hyperbloom, ayato 2E on a 25s rot

gaming-kaeya-xianyun-bennett.desc: first rotation, swap to Xianyun after Bennett and trigger a pyro swirl. Kaeya's cryo application may not be reliable. On second+ rotation, don't swap to Xianyun after Bennett. Gaming does 7 Skill plunges.

chevreuse-yaemiko-fischl-bennett.desc: Chevreuse Yae Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. CW Chevreuse on-field DPS. Fischl snapshots Bennett's buff. Yae bursts at the tail of Bennett's burst if available. Chev obtains Overcharge ball for all 3 skills.

mualani-furina-kazuha-xilonen.desc: Mualani Furina Kazuha Xilonen. 31s rot. 1st half starts with Xilonen Q and Furina Q and ends with Mualani Q, 2nd half has Kazuha Q. Furina's E lasting 30s is really nice.

kokomi-kazuha-xingqiu-yelan.desc: Kokomi mono hydro. Yelan uses 2e and gets 2 fav procs to enable extremely low er requirements on teammates

arlecchino-layla-kazuha-bennett.desc: Arle Layla Kazuha Bennett. 16-17s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 6[N3D]. Do note that arle's first NA melted here. See the timing in samples tab. it will have lower performance w/o it.

clorinde-furina-nahida-baizhu.desc: furina nahida baizhu clorinde with TF clorinde. 27s~ rotation with 2 baizhu e. clorinde burst when ready. damage build baizhu with noblesse, clam is similar. em sands better than atk sands on clorinde.

wriothesley-yelan-furina-xilonen.desc: Wrio Furina Yelan Xilonen. Xilonen & Yelan 2E 22-23s rot. 3[N5CD]. Skip Wrio Q due to team DPS loss (~6%).

navia-chiori-furina-xianyun.desc: Navia Chiori Furina Xianyun. 20s rot. total 8 high plunge (50% collision) with perfect dash canceling all being geo dmg. Furina comes between navia E to funnel fav particles. Chiori Q every other rot, receiving max furina fanfare.

lyney-zhongli-kazuha-bennett.desc: Lyney Monopyro with crowd control and shield. AP Bennett and shorter rotation

bennett-yaemiko-fischl-nahida.desc: Bennett's pyro application doesnt interfere largely with quicken uptime. Fischl snapshots Bennett buff onto both uptimes which can be tight. Swap to Bennett 3 times for energy generation and Instructor uptime

kinich-nahida-yelan-fischl.desc: Kinich Nahida Yelan Fischl . ~18s Rot. Kinich seeks blindspots. No Kinich short hold is -6K DPS. Codex > Scroll Kinich.

arlecchino-furina-xianyun-bennett.desc: Arle Furina Xianyun Bennett. 20s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 6[N3D] N1 (No plunges). Bennett Q C4 hE to leave pyro for xianyun to swirl it. bennett has longer field time while tEQ(N1) setup is shorter but inconsistent for pyro vv.

sucrose-xiangling-fischl-xingqiu.desc: 4 star variant of Sukokomon. 25 second rotation, with two Oz and two Guoba per rotation. Primary damage source is Overload.  Guoba Swirls included. KQMC valid.

hutao-xingqiu-kirara-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Double Hydro With Kirara for Burgeons and Shielding (HuTao mix of N1CJ and N2CJ)

yaemiko-sara-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Yae carry with Chevreuse. 16s rotations Yae and Sara Burst every other rotation

clorinde-nahida-furina-lisa.desc: Clorinde Nahida Furina Lisa. ~24s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Quickbloom with Lisa. Clorinde burst is better than Lisa hold skill between Clorinde skill uses. Lisa burst before Furina is better.

fischl-nahida-kuki-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Spread with nahida Kuki and Fischl

gaming-xingqiu-kazuha-bennett.desc: VV setup is... simple enough. Bennett EQ N1, Kaz N1 Ep needs to happen super quickly. Hydro swirls are a bonus that sometimes happen, not a requirement. Gaming juggles his Man Chai while weaving attacks between E plunges. Ingame, press Skill after attacking and while mid-air, wait till Man Chai has reached extremely close to Gaming before plunging

alhaitham-furina-fischl-dori.desc: Alhaitham Furina Fischl Dori. ~21s Rot. Long field time Alhaitham with Dori supplying energy. Deploy's Oz during Alhaitham's burst window.

sethos-fischl-kazuha-yaoyao.desc: Sethos Fischl Kazuha Yaoyao. ~17s rotation.  Sethos uses 8N2W N1E (last N1 is physical) combo. DPC is a viable artifact set on Sethos due to its high Charged Attack DMG% bonus and Attack Speed increase.

sucrose-fischl-xingqiu-nahida.desc: Sucrose hyperbloom - this is an alternative rotation that maximizes Sucrose HB procs

sayu-fischl-nahida-furina.desc: Sayu Hyperbloom with Fischl Furina Nahida. ~25s rot.

nahida-xingqiu-yelan-hutao.desc: Hu Tao Vape+Burgeon with Xingqiu Yelan Nahida

yaemiko-xingqiu-yelan-nahida.desc: 25s Yae onfield hyperbloom -- Double hydro, Yelan 2E, Yae NA spam no cancels

yaemiko-kirara-nahida-alhaitham.desc: Triple Dendro Alhaitham spread. No Yae Burst. 2 Kirara shields for higher uptime as well as Instructor uptime

arlecchino-yelan-fischl-chevreuse.desc: Arle Yelan Fischl Chev. 18s rot. No Arle Q, N1 C 2[N5D] N4. Chev can provide ATK% and C6 DMG bonus. KQMS Random Frame Delay.

raiden-nahida-navia-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Nahida Navia Xingqiu.~21s Rot. Classic Hyperbloom where the main damage is hyperbloom. On-field Raiden. Navia occasionally comes out of the pocket and makes an burst and skill.

zhongli-navia-yelan-bennett.desc: Navia Yelan. 4E first rot (3 w buffs, one to prefunnel energy ). First rotation does higher dps than subsequent ones. 2 Yelan e. Navia does some pyro/vaped NA to fill downtime

arlecchino-xiangling-furina-bennett.desc: Mono pyro arle with furina vaping. Furina bursts every other rot, and do extra normals with arle if not bursting. N14 Arle combo for simplicity

clorinde-fischl-candace-nahida.desc: Clorinde Fischl Candace Nahida. Candace 1E 16s rot. Catch her hydro particles during her on-field. Nahida Q every 2 rots. Her Q every rot with PAmber/Fruit is ~3k lower.

heizou-furina-yelan-fischl.desc: Heizou Furina Fischl Yelan. ~25s Rot. Heizou Taser in ST w/ P-Amber Heizou bursting twice per rotation to heal the team. Transformative > Talent Damage.

sethos-tighnari-fischl-nahida.desc: Sethos Tighnari Fischl Nahida. ~18s Rot. Sethos Tighanri Aggravate. Sethos uses a Shadowpiercing shot to apply Electro at the start of the rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst. Sethos uses burst.

dori-furina-kazuha-yelan.desc: Dori DH + Kazuha. Despite her low damage, Dori is a pretty useful driver, healing the entire team, applying electro and lowering the team's er requirements with favge . Decent in aoe thanks to Kazuha's electro swirl and electrocharge procs. (23.5s rot)

arlecchino-yelan-sucrose-chevreuse.desc: Arle Yelan Sucrose Chev. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 3[N5D]. Chev's pyro app is enough for swirl pyro. no more bennett circle impact

yoimiya-yelan-furina-xilonen.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Furina Xilonen. Yelan 2E 21s rot. Yoimiya ATK% goblet. a few hundred gain. Slingshot Yelan has ~2.5k higher. check the config.

neuvillette-beidou-ororon-kazuha.desc: Neuv Taser with Ororon, 2 targets. ~26s 3CA rot. Ororon is on R5 fav but ER requirements are still higher compared to Fischl variant. R3 fav is barely behind if Ororon does E N2 instead of E N1

gaming-furina-xianyun.desc: Birb. Gaming plunges 9 times. To do this ingame, Press E immediately after Q and each plunge. Wait till Man Chai is extremely close to you, then plunge.

arlecchino-kokomi-kazuha-bennett.desc: Arle Kokomi Kazuha Bennett. 20s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D] N1. the N5 at the end is used for waiting kokomi's 20s cd.

kinich-ororon-chiori-zhongli.desc: Kinich quicken with double geo. Ororon provides scroll buff and some personal damage. open with Chiori to weave NAs to proc her a1, since Kinich can't proc it. Kinich spins to catch blindspots and use short hold E.

nahida-xingqiu-raiden-qiqi.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Nahida Xingqiu Qiqi

lyney-xilonen-zhongli-bennett.desc: Lyney "Mono" with Zhongli shield and geo resonance. Xilo and Zhongli force a fav proc each rotation. Lyney bursts every other rotation. 16s 4/5CA rotation

kinich-ororon-fischl-dehya.desc: Kinich quicken with Dehya providing some burning uptime and IR. Dehya uses r5 sac to shorten rotation to 18s~. Kinich spins to catch blindspots and uses short hold E.

yaemiko-fischl-chevreuse-xiangling.desc: Yae Xiangling Fischl Chevreuse. 26s rot. Yae N2C driving and 4GD EDC Xiangling using 2E. The Catch R5 and/or 4EoSF on xiangling is a bit worse.

kinich-ororon-bennett-lynette.desc: kinich quickburn with lynette as off field pyro applier via her burst absorption. ororon provides scroll buff and some overload damage, while not completely ruining burning aura. kinich spins to catch blindspots and use quick hold E.

clorinde-yaemiko-chevreuse-thoma.desc: Clorinde Yae Chev Thoma. 17s rot. No Yae Q, just 3[E] once. with 4NO on Thoma, you can do Q every 2rots on Chev and stack more HP on her.

nahida-yaemiko-fischl-sara.desc: On field Yae aggravate. Both Fischl Summons buffed by Sara. Only 1 Yae field time buffed by sara.

nahida-furina-yaemiko-kuki.desc: Yae Kuki hyperbloom. Desynced rotation for Kuki Skill/4PC instructor uptime. Split field time between Nahida and Yae. Yae burst every other rotation

yaemiko-furina-yelan-xianyun.desc: Yae does not build any ER and alternates between Burst and extra N2JlP. Assumes 50% collision. 25s rotation, KQMS.

kinich-emilie-kirara-bennett.desc: Kinich Emilie Kirara Bennett. 20s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. You can technically swap Kirara and Emilie's place with lower shield uptime and slightly less deepwood uptime on Kinich.

clorinde-fischl-nahida-bennett.desc: Clorinde Fischl Nahida Bennett. avg 16s rot. Bennett needs high ER, used 2E per rot. Harbinger of Dawn is good if you can maintain the passive.

hutao-yelan-zhongli-furina.desc: Hu Tao Furina w no healing. Surprisingly close to Xingqiu team dmg output. C1 Furina is a large increase to guarantee some fanfare consistently

clorinde-fischl-yunjin-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Fischl YunJin Xilonen. 16s rot. Alternate Clorinde Q and Xilonen Q at the end. YunJin right before Clorinde to pick up the Electro shard for 4AP and Geo resonance. 4Husk on YunJin is ~5% less.

lynette-faruzan-furina-xianyun.desc: Hyperbuffed plunge Lynette with Furina, Faruzan, Xianyun. Lynette dash-cancels after each plunge. No IR, but has Lynette's taunt. 100% collision rate. 21s rotation.

mualani-xiangling-emilie-zhongli.desc: Mualani Emilie Xiangling Zhongli. 31s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. 2nd half relies on Guoba and Burning. 4pc UR is comparable to 4pc Obsidian with Sac Jade here.

bennett-xiangling-furina-yelan.desc: On-field Vape Bennett. Very evenly split dmg distribution. Xiangling only vapes around 60% of her dmg in exchange for more forward vape Furina hits. Furina does not recieve any of Bennett's healing.

arlecchino-sucrose-zhongli-bennett.desc: Arle Sucrose Zhongli Bennett. 16s rot (very tight). Sucrose Burst if available. you can put 4AP on bennett instead but not that much different.

arlecchino-emilie-chiori-zhongli.desc: Arle Emilie Chiori Zhongli. No Arle Q 16-17s rot. Alternate Emilie Q and Chiori Q during waiting Arle E 5seconds

hutao-yelan-layla-xingqiu.desc: Hu Tao vape melt. Layla's shield lasts whole of Hu Tao's field time

sucrose-fischl-sara-tighnari.desc: tighnari fischl sucrose sara with 2E sara, hunter's path is as always a massive dps increase

yoimiya-yelan-bennett-furina.desc: Yoimiya double hydro. Rotation heals everyone. 2 Yelan E and 2 Bennett E rotation. Optimized first rotation with different rot

navia-albedo-furina-xianyun.desc: Navia Albedo Furina Xianyun. 21s rot. total 8 high plunge (50% collision) with perfect dash canceling all being geo dmg. Furina comes between navia E to funnel fav particles. Albedo recasts his E between navia E. but you still need to add ER subs on navia and furina if one of the casts are broken. which reduces the DPS.

nahida-xingqiu-yelan-thoma.desc: Thoma Burgeon wtih Nahida Xingqiu Yelan

arlecchino-yelan-yunjin-xilonen.desc: Arle Yelan YunJin Xilonen. 18s rot. No Arle Q. C N16 (3[N5D] N1 is similar). Hydro scroll every rot. YunJin pickup the shard for Geo resonance.

clorinde-furina-yelan-ororon.desc: Clorinde Furina Yelan Ororon. ~26s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Taser. Emblem > NO Yelan. Clorinde bursts following her first skill to catch relevant buffs; Burst with Clorinde is slightly better than filling skill cd downtime with Yelan Normal attacks.

navia-zhongli-fischl-bennett.desc: Navia Zhongli Fischl Bennett, Navia uses immediate E in first rotation. Fischl's E and Q alternated in rotation.

sucrose-fischl-yaemiko-luminedendro.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with DMC and Sucrose

sethos-chevreuse-fischl-xiangling.desc: Sethos Fischl Xiangling Chevreuse. ~15s Rot. Sethos consistently triggers Overload with his skill for an ER refund. Full EM Xiangling bursts every other rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst.

clorinde-furina-yelan-fischl.desc: Clorinde Furina Yelan Fischl. ~26s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Taser. Clorinde does not burst to avoid wasting coordinated attacks. 2E Yelan. Fischl skill and burst every rotation; Fischl skill before and after Furina is similar.

furina-yelan-xianyun-bennett.desc: c0 pyro furina vape plunge. her own application together with yelan enable vapes. using NAs between plunges perform worse because it take significantly more time than dash.

furina-lynette-fischl-baizhu.desc: Hyperbloom with Lynette as the on-field driver, though Fischl deals more damage. Furina and Baizhu's lacking elemental application limit the amount of Hyperblooms triggered. Lynette uses mostly N1CD

neuvillette-sigewinne-kazuha-xilonen.desc: Neuv Sigewinne Kazuha Xilonen. 4CA 26s rot. Sigewinne provides hydro particles wow

thoma-xingqiu-fischl-nahida.desc: Thoma BUrgeon with Nahida Xingqiu fischl

arlecchino-rosaria-shenhe-bennett.desc: Melt Arlecchino with Shenhe and Rosaria. Shenhe buffs Rosaria and slightly buffs Arlecchino while providing some off-field Cryo application.

furina-sucrose-fischl-baizhu.desc: Sucrose hyperbloom trigger - Furina supplies low enough hydro application that electro aura is very consistent thus Sucrose swirls it and triggers hyperbloom - Hyperoptimised sim

raiden-furina-xiangling-bennett.desc: Raiden Furina Xiangling Bennett. Furina doesn't get bennett's healing. You can try 4NO on bennett in the config.

navia-fischl-bennett-chiori.desc: Navia burst in alternate rotation, allowing her to build more crit. In rotation #2 forward burst is not as important for navia as she has leftover crystallize from last rot. However, starting a new chamber with no navia burst will be a huge dps loss for the first rot.

bennett-shenhe-arlecchino-ayaka.desc: arle-ayaka melt.  Provides frontloaded damage when ayaka burst is up. Arle is the one mostly melting here.

kokomi-sayu-fischl-furina.desc: 25s rot for Fischl, we do a bit of rolling. Kokomi N2Ds; options for N2C/N2W. Customized random frame delays; 90% Start HP; Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite.

ayato-furina-xilonen-yelan.desc: Ayato Furina Yelan Xilonen. Yelan & Xilonen 2E 27s rot. Fun fact cutting down a few NA's from Ayato's 2nd field time is DPS gain in Single-target.

chevreuse-fischl-yaemiko-yanfei.desc: double electro overload yanfei. 25s rotation with 2 chev skills to refresh c6 buff and healing, as well as for energy. em build is similar to crit build on yanfei. yanfei buffs the team via hakushin ring.

ayaka-xilonen-shenhe-ganyu.desc: Mono cryo. Ganyu and Ayaka share equal field time. Everyone uses their skills twice causing very low er requirements all round. BP and Wep banner options are ~3K behind P.Crescent R5 without headshot.

gaming-furina-fischl-chevreuse.desc: Gaming Furina Fischl Chevreuse. ~20s Rot. Gaming Overvape. Gaming does 7 E plunges with delays. Healing & DPS Chev perform similarly. Oz leaves the field before Gaming's burst ends.

yaemiko-sara-chevreuse-xiangling.desc: Yae overload. Sara buffs yae twice per rotation. Yae, Sara and Xiangling burst every other roation. Sara only buffs Xiangling on rotations she bursts

nahida-xingqiu-yaemiko-luminedendro.desc: Yae Hyperbloom with Xingqiu Nahida DMC

clorinde-ororon-yelan-kazuha.desc: Clorinde Ororon Yelan Kazuha. ~18s Rot. Clorinde Taser. Kazuha skill before and after Clorinde skill. Kazuha bursts when Clorinde cannot. Misses some Yelan waves.

sethos-nahida-aetherelectro-fischl.desc: Sethos Nahida EMC Fischl. Vs ASIMON. APL. CAs exclusively, CA lvl 2, then CA lvl 1 at low energy.  No Nahida burst.

gaming-xingqiu-yelan-bennett.desc: Gaming Xingqiu Yelan Bennett. ~21s Rot. Gaming Double Hydro Vape with Gaming weaving Pyro infused normal attacks inbetween 7 skill plunges. Support set options in config.

bennett-furina-kazuha-yelan.desc: vape dps benny. kazuha swirl both pyro and hydro. kazuha and yelan get healed, furina does not. 23s 2e yelan rotation.

navia-bennett-zhongli-chiori.desc: navia chiori zhongli bennett with bennett using E twice for pyro application, chiori uses her Burst every other rotation

yaemiko-fischl-sucrose-collei.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with Collei and Hakushin Sucrose

clorinde-fischl-chevreuse-thoma.desc: Clorinde Fischl Chev Thoma. 17s rot. Start with Fischl E and refresh oz with Q in the first rot. with 4NO on Thoma, you can do Q every 2rots on Chev and stack more HP on her.

alhaitham-sara-fischl-kirara.desc: Sara buffs both Fischl and Alhaitham. DMG Build Kirara + WF Alhaitham is higher dps than Full Shield Kirara + HoD Alhaitham. See config for notes on shield uptime/stacking. Custom random frame delays, 12-3 Icewind Suite energy.

sucrose-keqing-fischl-kirara.desc: Hyperoptimized Keqing aggravate with Kirara. Note Wolf-Fang is very similar to HoD

navia-zhongli-bennett-furina.desc: First rotation is different from second+ rotation. Navia does 3 E's on 1st and 4th rotations. Bennett does QE and Zhongli does E on Bennett burst in second+ rotaiton. Check config, differences are clearly laid out.

hutao-chevreuse-fischl-kuki.desc: Hutao Chevreuse Fischl Kuki. ~17s Rot. Overload Hutao doing 7N3CJ. Hutao & Chevreuse burst every other rotation.

nahida-furina-yaemiko-dori.desc: Yae dori hyperbloom 25s rot Yae burst every rot. Dori gets small amount of field time to use c6 healing

tartaglia-bennett-xiangling-kazuha.desc: International 1 rotating 12-1-1 Cryo Kenki. Serve to showcases dps when enemy dies as XL burst is over, and has no need to battery back.

nahida-nilou-furina-sigewinne.desc: Nilou Sigewinne bloom, with nahida mostly onfield. Does not need to stay into any circles, and nahida can reapply E as necessary for comfy multi wave contents

bennett-furina-fischl-yelan.desc: Bennett DPS. 1 Fischl uptime 2 Yelan E rotation. Bennett healing distributed to fischl and yelan also.

clorinde-fischl-yelan-kazuha.desc: Clorinde Fischl Yelan Kazuha. 18s rot. Clorinde Q every rot. Kazuha Q every 2rots.

chiori-navia-yelan-bennett.desc: Navia Yelan. 4E first rot (3 w buffs, one to prefunnel energy ). First rotation does higher dps than subsequent ones. 2 Yelan e. Navia does some pyro/vaped NA to fill downtime

neuvillette-charlotte-zhongli-furina.desc: Neuv Furina Charlotte Zhongli. 4CA 25s rot. Charlotte using hE and burst every rot. she enters between neuv FT to trigger fav and small freeze QoL.

collei-kuki-xingqiu-nahida.desc: On field nahida Hyperbloom with Collei (note that ER problems can be solved with R5 favge

kuki-kokomi-nahida-furina.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Kokomi Nahida Furina in ST. Kokomi Onfeild, n2dw, using walk for dash cooldown. Using event weapons, Kokomi replacable with PA, Furina with Pipe.

navia-furina-kokomi-yelan.desc: Navia Furina Yelan Kokomi. With the high amount of Hydro damage, AP slightly inches out Nighttime on Navia. Kokomi bursts and then Normal Attacks in the middle of the rotation to refresh the Jellyfish and heal Yelan and Furina. 2E Yelan rotation.

nilou-neuvillette-nahida-kirara.desc: Neuvillette Nilou bloom with kirara shield. 4CA 26s rot

yaemiko-dori-nahida-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham spread with Dori. Split rotation to refresh Yae's turrets and Instructor on Dori

bennett-furina-xingqiu-yelan.desc: benny vape dps with triple hydro. yelan and xingqiu get healed, furina does not. 23s 2e yelan rotation. nymph outperforms other options on xingqiu.

nahida-xingqiu-raiden-xiao.desc: Raiden Hypberloom wth Nahida Xingqiu xiao

First rotation of every chamber, Navia can do an additional skill before her burst to alleviate energy issues across the team including herself, without losing anything for it.

neuvillette-furina-layla-kazuha.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Layla. 4CA 28-29s rot. if you mess up the hydro swirl you lose about 3-6k DPS. 9-15f Random swap delay + 2-4f random action delay.

raiden-ororon-yelan-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Double Hydro. 2 Yelan E 21s rotation. Raiden N4D for more Yelan/Xingqiu burst dmg

navia-gorou-furina-xianyun.desc: Navia Gorou Furina Xianyun. 21s rot. total 8 high plunge (50% collision) with perfect dash canceling all being geo dmg. Furina comes between navia E to funnel fav particles. Gorou feeds both Geo and Fav particles to navia.

kazuha-keqing-fischl-nahida.desc: Keqing Fischl Aggravate with Kazuha and Nahida

xiangling-kokomi-nahida-furina.desc: Kokomi double hydro burgeon. Xiangling is on full EM build. Kokomi, Furina, and Xiangling trigger some vapes.

lisa-fischl-kazuha-kirara.desc: Lisa Aggravate with Instructor Kirara and Golden Troupe on Fischl

arlecchino-xingqiu-fischl-bennett.desc: Arle Xingqiu Fischl Bennett. 21s rot. No Arle Q, 3[N5D] N1. the N4 at the end is used for waiting xq's 21s cd.

clorinde-emilie-fischl-dehya.desc: Clorinde Emilie Fischl Dehya. ~15s/20s Rot. Clorinde closes the rotation with burst. Deepwood Dehya maximizes Emilie's damage. Emilie bursts every other rot after the first. EM build Dehya.

razor-emilie-fischl-bennett.desc: Razor Emilie Fischl Bennett. ~20s Rotation with 2E Sapwood Bennett. Razor Quickload w/ ~70% Quicken Uptime. Razor's damage exceeds Fischl. SS may be inconsistent. Self-Overloads not implemented.

clorinde-fischl-yoimiya-chevreuse.desc: Clorinde Fischl Yoimiya Chev. 16s rot. Yoimiya Burst provides 10% ATK and off-field Pyro app for better Chev Res Shred uptime. Chev Burst every 2rots and stacks more HP

navia-furina-bennett-yelan.desc: Navia double hydro. AP and NO bennett are similar st dmg NO a lot easier to use. Furina doesn't recieve healing

alhaitham-furina-fischl-baizhu.desc: Fischl hits ~50% of Dendro Cores. 80% Starting HP; Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite; KurtC; Customized random frame delays. Several alternative build options.

clorinde-fischl-emilie-thoma.desc: Clorinde Fischl Emilie Thoma. 17s rot. 4DM on Thoma is viable for maximizing Emilie's damage.

bennett-furina-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya double hydro with Furina and bennett. no interruption protection

yoimiya-furina-xingqiu-bennett.desc: Yoimiya double hydro. Rotation heals Bennett Xingqiu and Yoimiya.

lisa-chevreuse-xiangling-bennett.desc: Lisa Chevreuse Xiangling Bennett. ~20s Rot. Lisa Overload, with Bennett on field skill spam generating particles for the team and Maintaining Pyro Aura. Bennett passes particles to DPS build Chev. Similar damage in single target.

gaming-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: Gaming Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. Gaming on-field Overload; uses NAs between plunges. Fischl snapshots Bennett's buff. Bennett buffed Chevreuse bursts every other rot to keep a consistent rotation length.

navia-aethergeo-bennett-fischl.desc: Navia GMC Fischl Bennett. GMC provides a crit rate buff and with 2Es, a signficant number of particles for Navia. The rotation is quite short, at 17s, but spreading out Navia's E allows her to still 2E every rotation

sethos-nahida-yelan-kuki.desc: Sethos Nahida Yelan Kuki. ~16s Rot. Sethos Hyperbloom with Kuki. Yelan ER needs are high. Sethos should reposition to hit seeds between N2s.

kinich-furina-xiangling-bennett.desc: Kinich Furina Xiangling Bennett. 20s rot. No Kinich Burst. Everyone except Kinich Burst every rot.

nahida-yelan-raiden-baizhu.desc: Yelan Baizhu hyperbloom with on field Raiden

sucrose-ororon-fischl-xingqiu.desc: Sucrose Ororon Fischl Xingqiu, APL. Sucrose as driver when no skills or bursts are available.

fischl-nahida-barbara-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Fischl Barabara Nahida

xiangling-xingqiu-fischl-nahida.desc: Xiangling Burgeon with Fischl Xingqiu and Nahida

navia-furina-chiori-bennett.desc: Navia Chiori Furina Bennett. 21s rot. Use 3rd navia E if available. Chiori Q between navia's E to get bennett buff and heal.

hutao-furina-kazuha-chevreuse.desc: hu tao vv vape. chev provides her c6 buff, healing for furina, and easy vv setup. hu tao vapes around 75% of her CAs. kazuha uses r5 fav to get 2 procs per rotation.ins slightly better than sodp on chev at the cost of lower healing.

kokomi-nilou-alhaitham-xingqiu.desc: Nilou Bloom with Alhaitham Xingqiu Kokomi

freminet-yelan-furina-xilonen.desc: Freminet Yelan Furina Xilonen. ~23s Rot. Phys Freminet Shatter with Xilonen and Yelan using 2Es per rotation. Freminet primes his shattering pressure before doing his burst combo every rotation between Yelan skills.

navia-xilonen-rosaria-bennett.desc: Navia Rosaria Xilonen Bennett. 21s rot. Navia 3rd E if available. Starts with Rosaria E to setup cryo scroll.

ganyu-emilie-xiangling-bennett.desc: Ganyu aimshots 5-7 times depending on if Xiangling burst or not and whether she herself has the energy to burst or not. Check config to know how many in each scenario.

arlecchino-albedo-lynette-bennett.desc: Arle & Albedo team with Lynette. Arle uses simple N3D combo and rot works with C0 Lynette. R5 fav for energy. Uses Albedo Q to fill time in rot if Lynette Q is unavailable. No delay included for picking up crystallize shard for AP.

fischl-wanderer-faruzan-bennett.desc: Faruzan QE > Bennett EQ > Fischl Skill/Q > Wanderer Q (if Ava) N1EN1Q N2D (if A4 Ava), else N2C > without funneling Bennett E on last rot.

yaemiko-kazuha-fischl-tighnari.desc: Yae Fischl with Kazuha and Tighnari

tighnari-nahida-fischl-sara.desc: Tighnari Nahida Fischl Sara. ~28s Rot. Tighnari Sara AggraSpread. Sara tries to buff Fischl and Tighnari. Nahida on-fields in during downtime. Nahida actions can likely be optimized.

fischl-nahida-beidou-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Beidou Fischl Nahida in ST

cyno-furina-fischl-baizhu.desc: Cyno Furina Fischl Baizhu. ~25s Rot. Cyno Hyperbloom with Baizhu. Fischl uses skill and burst every rotation.

yoimiya-furina-yelan-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Furina Yelan Bennett. Yelan 1E 20s rot. Furina uses fav sword bcuz of that. Furina come out to get bennett's healing except 1st rot. Bennett's healing build with 4SoDP is nice. You can see furina gets 2 ticks sometimes depending on her HP ratio(70%).

lynette-ororon-fischl-yelan.desc: Lynette taser driver. APL. Lynette combo default to N1CD if has enough stamina and N3J otherwise.

klee-furina-kazuha-bennett.desc: Standard Kleerina. Aprox 23s rot. Furina forward vape + tryhard Klee combo abusing CdC and stamina usage.

neuvillette-xiangling-lynette-kirara.desc: Neuv Vape with Xiangling Kirara Lynette. 4CA 28s rot. DPS build is slightly better than Instructor on Xiangling. Rot works for C0 Lynette.

clorinde-nahida-lisa-yelan.desc: Clorinde Nahida Lisa Yelan. ~25s Rot. (TF) Clorinde Quickbloom with Lisa. Clorinde does not burst. Lisa uses hold skill between Clorinde skill uses. 2E Yelan on Fav contributes to very low ER reqs for Lisa.

keqing-xingqiu-fischl-nahida.desc: Keqing Hyperbloom with Nahida Xingqiu Fischl

neuvillette-zhongli-lynette-xiangling.desc: neuv vape with KQMS subs. xiangling QE provides pyro first half and lynette Q/xiangling E provides pyro second half. only gets hydro VV first half.

clorinde-nahida-fischl-kuki.desc: Clorinde Nahida Fischl Kuki. ~16s Rot. Clorinde Triple Electro Aggravate. Nahida bursts every other rotation after the first. Kuki attempts to burst every rotation. Fischl aternates skill and burst.

fischl-ayato-xiangling-bennett.desc: ayato xiangling fischl bennett, 2E ayato and 2E xiangling, 1EQ/rot fischl

fischl-yelan-xingqiu-sucrose.desc: Sucrose Tazer with Double Hydro and Fischl

kinich-yelan-ororon-thoma.desc: Kinich Yelan Ororon Thoma. ~18-20s Rot. Kinich Chaos. Kinich seeks blindspots. No Kinich short hold is -4K DPS. DMG% and EM Ororon are close.

mualani-furina-xiangling-baizhu.desc: Mualani Furina Xiangling Baizhu. 20s rot. Q if available + 3[3-stacked bite]. Xiangling Q every rot.

raiden-dehya-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Raiden (C6)Dehya Chevreuse Bennett. ~20s Rot. Full length Dehya burst. Raiden does not catch Bennett burst buff. Chev Bursts in Bennett Q.

yaemiko-furina-ororon-xianyun.desc: Yae Furina Ororon Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Yae Taser Plunge. Xianyun refeshes VV mid rotation. Yae uses bust skill immediately after all plunges spent when available. Ororon goes before Furina. 50% Collisons.

arlecchino-xingqiu-zhongli-bennett.desc: Arle Xingqiu Zhongli Bennett. 21s rot. No Arle Q, N5D combo, its using more NAs waiting for xq's 21s cd.

neuvillette-zhongli-kazuha-fischl.desc: Remember to retry till you get hydro absorption on Kazuha burst. Zhongli and Kazuha buff Neuvillette while Fischl provides energy to Neuv and does decent damage; 9-12f swap delay, 2-4 others

razor-nahida-xingqiu-baizhu.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Baizhu. ~24s Rot. Razor Double Dendro Hyperbloom. Deepwood Nahida w/ OHC Baizhu is nearly the same.

arlecchino-fischl-chevreuse-xinyan.desc: Arle Fischl Chev Xinyan. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. read the comments inside for the detailed fischl setup. Xinyan can hold 4TotM instead.

freminet-nahida-yelan-raiden.desc: Freminet Nahida Yelan Raiden. ~20s Rot. Defenseless Phys Freminet driven Hyperbloom. No burst Nahida.

ayaka-xilonen-rosaria-furina.desc: ~22s rotation with 2 Skills from Ayaka, Xilonen, and Rosaria. Xilonen's Burst heals everyone except Furina. Xilonen's Scroll procs may be inconsistent in practice; Shatter doesn't trigger Scroll, and underlying Cryo auras to Crystallize can be unreliable with Furina. KurtC w/o limited weapons

navia-bennett-xilonen-rosaria.desc: Navia Bennett Xilonen Rosaria. ~20s rotation. 2 Rosaria Skills, 2 Xilonen Skills. Navia does a third Skill if available. Rosaria lets Navia use a CRIT DMG Circlet thanks to her CRIT Rate buff.

arlecchino-xingqiu-kazuha-bennett.desc: Arle Xingqiu Kazuha Bennett. 21s rot. No Arle Q, N1 CA dash cancel 3[N5D] N1. use dash after bennett E for xingqiu vv setup.

kinich-furina-fischl-baizhu.desc: Kinich Furina Fischl Baizhu. ~20s Rot. Kinich Quickbloom with Baizhu. Scroll is slightly worse than Codex for team DPS. Fischl alternates skill and burst. No Kinich short hold E is -5k DPS.

kokomi-furina-xingqiu-kazuha.desc: F2P weapons team. Iron Sting and Kazuha bursting every other rotation results in marginally higher DPS than Fav r3. If available, Ballad + FD + Xiphos r1 produces 4% increase.

gaming-furina-zhongli-chiori.desc: gaming double geo. 20s~ rotation. chiori uses her burst if ready at the end  if ready, otherwise gaming uses another skill. gaming vapes most plunges, but not all.

bennett-lynette-xiangling-lyney.desc: Lyney Lynette Mono Pyro.  Lyney does 4 charged attacks and bursts every rotation. Lynette uses either burst if up otherwise skill right before Lyney does his combo.

razor-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: Razor Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~17 or 20s Rot. Ignoring Razor's burst cooldown is ideal for DPS given fewer rotations. Pyro Infused Razor deals slightly more Pyro DMG; Echoes + Pyro > TS + ATK Goblet. Fischl & DPS build Chevreuse use Q/E in Bennett Q. Self overloads not implemented.

mualani-emilie-dehya-nahida.desc: Mualani Emilie Dehya Nahida. Q every 2rots + 3[3-stacked bite]. Nahida Q every rot. Emilie w/o Q. 4Deepwood Dehya + 4GD Nahida also works

raiden-furina-nahida-baizhu.desc: Quickbloom Nahida with EM Raiden. 24s rotation. MH on Nahida is an increase over Gilded.

kuki-nahida-tighnari-mona.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Nahida Tighnai Mona, using R5 4 stars and R1 Hunters Path, vs Maguu Kenki

alhaitham-furina-sucrose-kuki.desc: Deepwood Furina. Sucrose doesn't burst, owns ~10% of HBs. Energy drops based on 12-3 Icewind Suite; Customized random frame delays & Starting HP%s. Many alternative build options.

lyney-dehya-kazuha-bennett.desc: Lyney Monopyro with Crowd Control and Res to interruption with R5 Sac Greatsword on Dehya

raiden-kazuha-yelan-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Double Hydro Taser -- Note limited healing, Yelan 2Es and optimal Raiden NA string for rainswords

ayaka-charlotte-shenhe-furina.desc: ayaka furina triple cryo. OHC Charlotte

yaemiko-furina-sara-xianyun.desc: Yae Furina Sara Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Yae Taser Plunge. After 5 plunges, Xianyun refeshes VV, then Sara burst. Yae bursts every other rotation. Yae always catches Sara's Crowfeather. 50% Collisons.

gaming-chongyun-rosaria-bennett.desc: Gaming Chongyun Rosaria Bennett. ~16s Rot. Gaming Melt. Chongyun melts his Q on Bennett's Q. 5 Skill Plunges.

hutao-fischl-yaemiko-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Overvape with Yelan Fischl Yae

sethos-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: Sethos Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. Sethos loses a lvl 1 aimed shot for Chev A1 on the first rotation. Sethos does 8N2W N1 (Last n1 is Phys). Chevreuse builds for damage.

navia-furina-fischl-baizhu.desc: Navia Furina Fischl Baizhu. Navia 3E 26s rot. Used radius=2 for a few hyperbloom dmg. 4GT Furina and 4NO Baizhu is slightly weaker at this level of investment. 9-15f random swap delay

clorinde-fischl-nahida-kirara.desc: Clorinde Fischl Nahida Kirara. 16s rot. Kirara for shield, dendro resonance, C6 damage bonus, potentially C4 dendro app for wave contents.

yaemiko-xingqiu-beidou-nahida.desc: (Note: Beidou has 10% chance of perfect counter) Nahida EQ > Xingqiu ED Q N1 > Yae E2 N1 E > Beidou EQ > Yae N19 > Beidou E

mualani-zhongli-sucrose-xiangling.desc: Mualani Zhongli Sucrose Xiangling. 34s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. 1st half Xiangling Q and uses Mualani Q, 2nd half Sucrose Pyro Q from Guoba.

arlecchino-yaemiko-chevreuse-thoma.desc: Arle Yae Chev Thoma. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 3[N5D] N2.

yelan-fischl-kazuha-xingqiu.desc: Yelan On Field with Xingqiu Fischl Kazuha

hutao-yelan-chevreuse-xilonen.desc: Hutao Yelan Chevreuse Xilonen. ~18s Rot. 9N2CJ Hutao Vape with Chevreuse enabling MH. Chev bursts every roation to reliably allow Xilonen to Crystallize Pyro. 1E Yelan.

sethos-yelan-fischl-nahida.desc: Sethos Yelan Fischl Nahida. ~16s Rot. PAmber supplies the only healing and allows Nahida to burst every rotation. Yelan ER needs are high. Sethos should reposition to hit seeds between N2s. Ownership of hyperbloom for Sethos and Fischl is affected by opponent size.

xingqiu-yelan-mona-hutao.desc: HuTao triple hydro with xingqiu yelan mona

arlecchino-fischl-chevreuse-dehya.desc: Arle Fischl Chev Dehya. Swap off arle's fieldtime to refresh fischl E every other rotation. ER sands fischl to accomodate increase in er reqs

neuvillette-zhongli-nahida-xiangling.desc: Vape Neuvillette using Nahida Dendro and XL's Q/E to apply pyro. Rotation is 29s long to allow Nahida E to expire so Neuv can apply hydro for Zhongli's hydro crystallize on subsequent rotations.

arlecchino-furina-sigewinne-bennett.desc: Arle double hydro with sigewinne. Sigewinne party heal gives decent stacks for furina buff.

arlecchino-xingqiu-yelan-zhongli.desc: Yelan 2E ~21s rot. No Arle Q. N14 is easier to execute and more DPS than 6[N3D] mainly due to more Q procs from XQ and Yelan.

navia-furina-xianyun-bennett.desc: Navia Furina Xianyun Bennett. total 8 high plunge (50% collision) with perfect dash canceling all being geo dmg. Xianyun has to weave NAs to trigger fav. w/o Geo particles, Navia uses ER sands to allow more crit subs.

yoimiya-yelan-fischl-ororon.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Fischl Ororon. ~18s Rot. Yoimiya Overvape; Yoimiya prefers EEC > 3EM >= EDC. Yoimiya bursts as available. Fischl alternates skill and burst.

neuvillette-yelan-kazuha-zhongli.desc: Neuv Yelan Kazuha Zhongli. 4CA 26s rot. Kazuha Q every rot. you can test low ER on kazuha to alternate Q and tEP. Yelan 2E rot. Yelan Q is triggered 7 times.

nilou-kaveh-kirara-xingqiu.desc: kaveh nilou bloom with c6 kirara. EN12EN4 combo

heizou-faruzan-furina-xianyun.desc: Heizou Faruzan Furina Xianyun. 100% collision. Furina EQ > Xianyun E lP Q > Faruzan Q > Heizou N1C Q E 8JhP N1C E

ayato-furina-dori-kazuha.desc: ayato dori furina kazuha taser vs 3T, kazuha infuses electro into his burst.  Targets are tighly clustered; all are struck by Ayato's NA/E/Q together.

arlecchino-xiangling-zhongli-bennett.desc: Arle Xiangling Zhongli Bennett. 20s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D] N1. bennett 2E per rot feeding xiangling directly.

neuvillette-ayato-nahida-xiangling.desc: Neuvillette vapes a little, but mostly Xiangling burgeons. Ayato is used solely for his Q, with his skill just providing some energy - Hyperoptimised sim

cyno-fischl-nahida-xilonen.desc: Cyno Fischl Nahida Xilonen. ~25s rot. Cyno Aggravate without TF. Xilonen 2 E cast. AP and TotM are close on Nahida.

bennett-chevreuse-sara-fischl.desc: "Hyper" fischl. KQMS. Fischl can be improved with prototype crescent if you are insane. C6 Chev is worth 15% dps.  C6 Sara is worth 8% dps.

clorinde-fischl-chevreuse-xinyan.desc: Clorinde Fischl Chev Xinyan. 16s rot. No Xinyan E (18s cd), leading to lack of particles. Chev Q every 2rots and stacks more HP and feeds her E particles into Xinyan. Started with Fischl aim for healthy energy economy during the rotation.

baizhu-xingqiu-furina-thoma.desc: Furina and Xingqiu maintains a good hydro aura uptime - Hyperoptimised sim

freminet-nahida-xingqiu-kuki.desc: Freminet Nahida Xingqiu Raiden. ~20s Rot. Freminet Hyperbloom with Xingqiu. Freminet bursts every rotation.

navia-zhongli-kokomi-furina.desc: Navia Kokomi Furina Zhongli. To assist with enabling Furina, Kokomi bursts in the middle of the rotation, refreshing Jellyfish and healing the entire party. It's not strictly necessary to drive, but does help.

hutao-yaemiko-yelan-fischl.desc: hu tao yelan fischl yae tom hakushin

ayato-nilou-nahida-baizhu.desc: Nilou Bloom with Ayato Baizhu Nahida

kinich-yelan-fischl-thoma.desc: Kinich Yelan Fischl Thoma. ~18s Rot. Kinich with Overload, Burgeon, Spread, etc. Kinich seeks blindspots. No Kinich short hold is -6K DPS. Kinich burst is a DPS loss. Scroll and Obsidian Codex go even.

raiden-fischl-kirara-alhaitham.desc: Double carry Quicken: Alhaitham hE LP combo and 2-Mirror Burst, full Raiden combo (~25s rot). Low ER Raiden (energy not needed); ToTM is higher DPS than EoSF and the Shield Strength is useful. DMG Build Kirara. KurtC

hutao-yelan-fischl-kuki.desc: Hutao Yelan Fischl Kuki. ~18s Rot. Hutao Overvape with Kuki enabling MH to edge out SR. 9N2CJ Hutao. No burst Kuki. 1E Yelan.

bennett-xiangling-yelan-xingqiu.desc: National with Yelan and Bennett on field

cyno-furina-baizhu-nahida.desc: Cyno-Furina quickbloom, but with a longer and more optimized rotation

dori-fischl-kazuha-nahida.desc: C6 Dori Aggravate with Fischl Kazuha Nahida, no TF set ver. ~26s rot.

bennett-xiangling-furina-kazuha.desc: kazuha xiangling furina benny. 20s rotation. kazuha absorb hydro with his burst, but xiangling still doesn't vape most of her damage. kazuha uses e often for grouping and energy

raiden-fischl-nahida-bennett.desc: Raifish Nahida Bennett. 18-19s rot. Fischl E at the end of the rot(=every other rot). Bennett triggers 4Ins twice! Nahida can snapshot that 120EM into her A1. You can try 4NO bennett in the config. its slightly weaker.

rosaria-furina-nahida-bennett.desc: rosaria burgeon melt. on field rosaria with c6 bennett, dealing mix of cryo, pyro, and burgeon damage.

kokomi-keqing-fischl-nahida.desc: 25s Keqing quickbloom w/Instructors Kokomi, enemy radius=3

navia-emilie-chiori-bennett.desc: Navia Chiori Emilie Bennett. 16s rot. Navia Q every other rot alternating with either Emilie or Chiori Q. Bennett comes between Navia's Field time but it is not necessarily required to refresh burning. you can send him at the end of the rot.

xiangling-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: chev xiangling benny fischl with action priority list. energy and enemy hp based on 12-3 aeonblight drake.

clorinde-chiori-zhongli-tighnari.desc: clorinde double geo with tighnari to enable quicken and as quickswap dps. clorinde and tighnari alternate burst use, clorinde burst before tighnari field time to enable spread for him. zhongli and chiori alternate burst use to fill rotation time. 16s rotation.

navia-xilonen-ororon-bennett.desc: Navia Xilonen Ororon Bennett. 1 Xilonen E 18s rot. Ororon triggers Overloaded on Bennett's Pyro app to self buff with Scroll.

neuvillette-kokomi-nahida-xiangling.desc: Mainly vaporice with some burning and burgeon Neuvillete with Xiangling Kokomi and Nahida

hutao-xingqiu-sucrose-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Double Hydro with Sucrose

navia-gorou-furina-yelan.desc: Navia Double hydro. With healing build gorou. 2 Yelan E 2 Gorou E rotation

bennett-furina-xiangling-yoimiya.desc: Vape Furina with key, driven by yoi; burst with furina every other rot; Furina burst actually don't bring much dps due to the low stack counts.

arlecchino-furina-yelan-jean.desc: Arle Furina Yelan Jean. Yelan 1E 21s rot. No Arle Q, 3[N5D]. Arle ATK/ATK/CRIT was slightly better due to high DMG% buffs. Jean uses 2nd E at the end for VV refresh and lowering furina's ER.

alhaitham-nahida-fischl-xianyun.desc: Alhaitham Nahida Fischl Xianyun. ~28s Rot. AlHaitham Spread plunge in a split rotation with Fischl Q during AlHaitham's Q window. Spends high plunges then does mirror combos until Nahida E expiration. 70% collisions after E plunge, 50% after burst.

clorinde-nahida-lisa-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Nahida Lisa Xilonen. ~25s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde Aggravate with Lisa. Clorinde burst over lisa skill is a DPS gain. Nahida bursts every other rotation. Xilonen does not burst.

kazuha-keqing-fischl-baizhu.desc: KeqingFischl Aggravate with Kazuha and 4Instructor Hakushin Baizhu. you can use 4NO but its weaker

navia-luminegeo-bennett-furina.desc: Navia with Furina and Geo MC.  Sim picks up a shard if available on dash.  Geo MC and Bennett do 2 Skills each.  Geo MC does an additional conditional Skill. Note that in-game Geo MC's pillar blocks Furina's pets, so it is kinda scuffed in practice.

raiden-fischl-xiangling-chevreuse.desc: Raiden Fischl Xiangling Chevreuse. 20s rot. Use Chev E mainly at the end of the rot. Use Fischl E at the end of the rot if available, if not, spam NA to get chev healing for C6.

navia-fischl-chiori-zhongli.desc: Navia Chiori Fischl Zhongli. 16s rot. Zhongli feeds fav particles into navia. Used 3[N2D] navia to make it 16s rot length.

hutao-xianyun-yelan-xingqiu.desc: Hu Tao Xianyun Yelan Xingqiu. 6N1CJP with high plunges and 50% collision rate.

sigewinne-furina-fischl-kazuha.desc: Sigewinne tazer, 25s rot with fischl. R5 Sac bow to refresh E stacks. Sigewinne got to burst since nobody needs fieldtime

arlecchino-bennett-sucrose-kirara.desc: Arle Bennett Sucrose Kirara. 16s rotation. Burning's only purpose is enabling Unfinished Reverie. Kirara Bursts every rotation for C6, Sucrose Bursts if available with her Burst easily picking up Pyro for C6. Arle 6[N3D] and no Burst.

arlecchino-yelan-lynette-chevreuse.desc: Arle Yelan Lynette Chev. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 3[N5D] N1. double VV using chev as a pyro source.

lyney-albedo-lynette-bennett.desc: lyney lynette with totm albedo. R5 favs to help with energy issues + assumes lyney repeatedly hits weakspots.

cyno-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: pyro cyno ft. c6 benny and chev. n2cd cyno. 15s rotation.

mualani-candace-kazuha-xiangling.desc: Mualani C5 Candace Kazuha Xiangling. 36s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. 1st half Xiangling Q and uses Mualani Q, 2nd half Kazuha Pyro Q from Guoba. Candace C6 is ~10% team DPS loss from C5. Candace can hold 4Instructor here(first half will have better dmg with it)

cyno-furina-dori-nahida.desc: Cyno hyperbloom with full EM Dori. 28s rotation

navia-chiori-mona-zhongli.desc: navia chiori mona zhongli using chiori's burst, navia rotation changes depending on whether or not chiori's Q is used

nilou-furina-jean-yelan.desc: Nilou monohydro - Nilou is actually a decent driver, which is why this works even though her MVs are poor. She does just enough damage to not be useless, too. Wolf Fang and Festering are more reliable alternatives to HoD.

itto-xilonen-furina-yelan.desc: Itto Xilonen with Furina Yelan. 2 Xilo Es on the second rotation onward greatly eases up energy requirements. Whiteblind R5 outperforms Serpent R1

jean-furina-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya double hydro with Furina and Jean. No interruption protection

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-raiden.desc: Bennett Chevreuse Fischl Raiden. ~16s Rot. TF Bennett on-field DPS generates partcles for DPS build Chevreuse. Chevreuse Q3E every rotation in Bennett's burst. Fischl snapshots Bennett's buff. No Burst Raiden. Bennett EDC>3EM>ADC.

yaemiko-fischl-zhongli-nahida.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with Nahida and Zhongli. Yae drives when possible to maximise Fischl's A4. This team is very easy to play and you can basically AFK. The team is mostly unaffected by Nahida's Q Talent Level

lyney-bennett-zhongli-venti.desc: Lyney Mono with shielding and crowd control: Lyney, Bennett, Zhongli, Venti. Lyney 4CA rotation with Bennett holding petra for better uptime. Venti prefers EM mainstats with more targets.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-yaemiko.desc: Bennett Chevreuse Fischl Yae. ~18s Rot. TF Bennett on-field DPS generates partcles for DPS build Chevreuse. Chevreuse Q3E every rotation in Bennett's burst. Fischl snapshots Bennett's buff. No Burst Yae. Bennett EDC>3EM>ADC.

bennett-fischl-yaemiko-tighnari.desc: tighnari double electro with benny's buff and healing. 25s rotation. fischl snapshot benny's buff with both her skill and burst, tighnari only get his buff for his first dps window. yae burst is buffed. hakushin similar to widsith on yae.

bennett-xingqiu-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya double hydro with bennett. KQMS. 21s rotation: XQ EQ -> Yelan Q -> Bennett EQ-> XQ  -> Yelan E -> Yoimiya -> Yelan E -> back to XQ.

klee-sigewinne-furina-bennett.desc: Kleerina with Sigewinne. Thanks to Sigewinne Furina deals more dmg and Klee can use all of Bennett's field time.

yoimiya-fischl-yaemiko-chevreuse.desc: Yoimiya Yae Fischl Chevreuse. 18-19s rot. Yoimiya and Yae use their burst every other rot.

cyno-kazuha-fischl-nahida.desc: Cyno Aggravate with Fischl Kazuha Nahida

bennett-sucrose-xingqiu-xiangling.desc: Sucrose National with Massive Frontloaded Quad Vape done by book nerd. 24s Rotation: Xq QN1, Benny QN1E, Succ N1ED, Xling N1 ED N1Q, Xq EED, Benny N3E, Xq N2, Benny Xling quickswap funnel, repeat

navia-zhongli-yelan-bennett.desc: Navia Zhongli Yelan Bennett. Yelan 2E 21s rot. use navia 3rd E if available. It can be hard to play yelan 2E rot. for e.g., you may want the first combo to be N3D N2 or even shorter one to get the 2nd yelan E timing.

fischl-nahida-yelan-cyno.desc: Cyno Hyperbloom with Fischl Nahida Yelan

fischl-albedo-nahida-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Fischl Nahida Alhaitham

navia-zhongli-bennett-xiangling.desc: Xiangling bursts every other rotation. Xl does her E before Bennett Q in rotation where she doesn't burst. Zl swap in between the 2 Navia E's to proc fav.

kokomi-nahida-fischl-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Fischl, Nahdia, Kokomi

alhaitham-yaemiko-fischl-kirara.desc: alhaitham spread w no burst yae (using burst in st is dps neutral for sustain)

dori-nahida-lisa-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Lisa Nahida Dori

fischl-nahida-mona-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Mona Fischl Nahida

jean-furina-bennett-raiden.desc: 4MH Raiden Sunfire with Furina. Performs better with 4MH than Emblem here. Uses ER clock + The Catch to meet ER requirements.

clorinde-emilie-thoma-bennett.desc: Clorinde Emilie Thoma Bennett. 18s rot. Emilie & Clorinde Q when available, on Bennett Q. EM sands on Clorinde, for Aggravate and Overloaded.

arlecchino-yelan-yunjin-zhongli.desc: Arle Yelan YunJin Zhongli. 18s rot. No Arle Q, N1 CA dash cancel 3[N5D]. weave NA on yunjin for fav proc. 4NO on YunJin is ~1k more DPS.

beidou-ayato-nahida-raiden.desc: 4TF Ayato hyperbloom with beidou, perfect counter, move targets away from player

cyno-furina-kuki-nahida.desc: Cyno hyperbloom with Furina, Kuki, Nahida. 28s rotation

arlecchino-yelan-xilonen-zhongli.desc: Arle Yelan Xilonen Zhongli. Pyro Scroll 18s rot. No Arle Q. C 5[N3D] N1 and Zhongli Q to remove aura, come back to Arle E to apply pyro for 4pc Scroll. You can also use Arle QE to leave pyro like this. Not using 4AP is ~4.5k loss

sucrose-keqing-fischl-baizhu.desc: 25s Keqing Aggravate with Instructors Baizhu -- Well optimized, Fischl A4 counts will vary

itto-chiori-xianyun-furina.desc: Itto "Lamentto" plunge with Chiori, Xianyun, Furina. Itto N1 Q E 8DJHP C2F E CF, 50% plunge collision rate.

hutao-xingqiu-fischl-zhongli.desc: TF Hu Tao with Xingqiu Zhongli Fischl

luminegeo-xilonen-bennett-fischl.desc: Geo Lumine Xilonen Bennett Fischl, combines APL with a set rotation. tighnari-furina-raiden-baizhu.desc: Comfy Tighnari Quickbloom with on-field Favonius Raiden to fill time + generate energy. Low overall ER requirements due to Raiden holding R5 Favonius Lance.

kokomi-nilou-nahida-baizhu.desc: nilou baizhu nahida kokomi with kokomi n2c

sucrose-keqing-fischl-yaoyao.desc: Keqing Aggravate with Sucrose and Yaoyao. High substats for instructor

noelle-furina-yelan-xingqiu.desc: AP Favge Noelle driver with triple hydro. Very comfy to play and surprisingly effective

neuvillette-furina-layla-jean.desc: Neuv Furina Jean Layla. 4CA 27s rot. incredibly defensive with healing, shield, and freeze. Random delay as 9-15f and 2-4f action.

keqing-collei-fischl-kazuha.desc: Keqing Fischl Aggravate with Collei and Kazuha

ayaka-lynette-shenhe-yelan.desc: Ayaka Freeze with Yelan. Pretty ST locked thanks to Yelan Hydro app but Lynette helps by absorbing Hydro with Q. Pre-C4 Lynette can do Q N2 instead of E N1 Q for about 2.5k less DPS; 3 favs keep her ER reqs low enough to use ATK sands even with 1E

bennett-furina-fischl-ororon.desc: Bennett Furina Fischl Ororon. ~20s Rot. Overvape Thundering Fury Bennett with Furina. Fischl alternates skill and burst in Bennett field. EDC > EEC > 3EM Bennett.

raiden-furina-xiangling-chevreuse.desc: Raiden Furina Xiangling Chevreuse. 20s rot. 4GT furina or 4MH raiden has similar result. 4SoDP chev was a bit weaker. Xiangling do some NAs to stack chev c6 before burst snapshot. also for rotation length.

sara-fischl-sucrose-kirara.desc: Sara Fischl Sucrose Kirara. ~26 Rot. On-Field Sara Aggravate with a Shielder Kirara. Sara buffs herself and Fischl. Hakushin only buffs Sara.

bennett-xiangling-furina-lynette.desc: xl benny furina lynette. 20s rotation. uses benny hold E with c4 to guarantee pyro swirl. lynette absorb hydro to help with vapes,xl vapes around 75% of her damage. lynette helps stack fanfare with her skill. r5 fav to get multiple procs.

nahida-xingqiu-yelan-lumineelectro.desc: EMC Hyperbloom with Nhaida Xingqiu Yelan

yoimiya-yelan-xilonen-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Xilonen Bennett. 18s rot. Pyro Scroll every rot setup. Utilize [Yoimiya Q + Bennett tE] or [Bennett's C4 hE] to remove hydro and leave pyro.

baizhu-xingqiu-yelan-thoma.desc: Thoma Burgeon with Xingqiu Yelan and Baizhu

chevreuse-fischl-yelan-bennett.desc: overvape dps chev with c6 bennett, 19s rotation

klee-sigewinne-furina-xilonen.desc: "hypercarry" off-field Furina with on-field enabler Klee. ~20s rot bc Furina cd. It has good vertical investment.

arlecchino-rosaria-kaeya-bennett.desc: Arle Rosaria Kaeya Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 5[N3D]. KQMS Random Frame Delay.

clorinde-zhongli-chiori-fischl.desc: clorinde double geo double electro. zhongli and clorinde burst every rotation, chiroi burst every other rotation. ap similar to totm on zhongli. low fischl damage due to the lack of buffs and a4 triggers, but she batteries clorinde.

kazuha-sara-yaemiko-nahida.desc: "Hyper" Yae Aggravate with Nahida kauzha Sara

xiao-faruzan-bennett-xianyun.desc: Xiao triple anemo with Bennett (50% collision). Bennett only makes an E.

chiori-xiao-faruzan-zhongli.desc: Xiao double geo with Chiori. 50% collision. KQMS.

yoimiya-yaemiko-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Yae chevreuse Bennett. 18s rot. Yoi and Yae don't use their burst. DPS chevreuse with 4EoSF.

hutao-xingqiu-layla-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Double Hydro Vape Melt with Layla

mualani-mona-emilie-dehya.desc: Mualani Mona Emilie Dehya. 35s rot. Q if available + 3[3-stacked bite]. Mona C1 is beneficial. Mona uses her E at the rotation downtime.

raiden-fischl-kazuha-bennett.desc: RaiFish -- Raiden N4D combos with E cancel, Fischl E at the end of every other rotation
