wanderer-faruzan-yelan-bennett.desc: Wanderer with Yelan, Faruzan and Bennett

raiden-yaemiko-sara-chevreuse.desc: ~22s Ei Miko Sara Chevreuse, first rot is altered, requires either low ping or a large enemy, requires Chevreuse c4.

yanfei-furina-bennett-fischl.desc: yanfei overvape. 20s~ rotation. yanfei vapes around 2/3 of her CAs. yanfei doesn't build er and burst when ready.

klee-fischl-xingqiu-bennett.desc: Klee Overvape, APL rotation, note frame delays can cause a much different reaction chain

kuki-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: Kuki Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. Kuki on-field DPS. 8x CA leaves little stamina to dodge.

diluc-furina-yelan-xilonen.desc: Diluc Furina Yelan Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Yelan skill just before and after Diluc field time. Xilonen uses skill twice and bursts before Furina. Yelan has the highest damage share.

wriothesley-bennett-thoma-emilie.desc: Wrio Emilie Thoma Bennett. N3CJ combo 20s rot. Emilie and Wrio Q every 2 rots. 4DM on Thoma provides high RES Shred uptime for Emilie.

raiden-navia-xilonen-sara.desc: Raidenavia dual carry! This team is synergistic for lots of reasons, such as Raiden's flexible and consistent application and Sara's buff being long enough for Navia. Scales better with investment, especially when you have PPS on Xilo. Favge barely helps here.

raiden-furina-bennett-kazuha.desc: baal hypercarry with furina instead of sara

baizhu-neuvillette-raiden-nahida.desc: Neuvillette hyperbloom with Interruption Resistance and some multiwave dendro application - Optimised random delay sim - 2-4 frames delay between non-bufferable actions, 9-15 frames of swap delay

yoimiya-furina-xiangling-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Furina Xiangling Bennett. 20s rot. furina and yoimiya burst every other rot (alternating each other's Q), lowering furina's ER. mostly furina has vape ownership.

wriothesley-bennett-xiangling-xilonen.desc: Wrio Xiangling Xilonen Bennett. 21s rot. Alternating Cryo and Pyro Scroll depending on Wrio Q usage.  Check the config for the detail about scroll. 4NO instead of 4AP is 1k loss.

yanfei-yelan-bennett-furina.desc: Yanfei Vape. Yanfei bursts every other rotation. Furina does not get healed

nahida-hutao-raiden-xingqiu.desc: hutao/raiden soup, team with funny reaction

ayato-nahida-fischl-kuki.desc: Ayato Nahida Fischl Kuki. ~25s. Rot. Ayato double Electro Hyperbloom. Kuki uses burst in the 1st half of the rotation and burst in 2nd.

lynette-nahida-furina-dehya.desc: ''Burngeon'' in AoE (3T) w. full EM C6 Lynette. N2C+N1C combo. Tightly packed small mobs maximizes AoE damage. In practice the self damage from burgeon and burning + Furina's pet HP drain + ins Dehya's lower sustain = hope the enemy dies before you do. Pamber is ~5k DPS loss and full HP dehya is ~15k dps loss but both are strongly recommended ingame. Does worse against ST and/or very big enemies.

yoimiya-yelan-ororon-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Ororon Bennett. 18s rot. Pyro Scroll setup Yelan > Ororon E N1 > Bennett Q E > Ororon Q.

fischl-furina-kirara-bennett.desc: ~22s rotation with near-full Oz uptime thanks to 4TF, quickswapping between Fischl N2D spam, Bennett Skills, and a 3s Kirara hE. Oz consistently snapshots Bennett's buff on each summon. Fischl triggers Hyperbloom on ~60% of Blooms. Kirara and Bennett built for dmg. 12-3 Icewind Suite's base stats used for energy drops and incoming damage instances every 4-6s. Customized random action delays and starting HPs.

tighnari-yaemiko-fischl-zhongli.desc: Yaefischl Aggravate with Tighnari and Zhongli

faruzan-furina-xiangling-bennett.desc: Faruzan Furina Xiangling Bennett. ~21s Rot. Faruzan Furinational, Fav Bow Faruzan strikes an ideal balance of team energy. Similar damage share between Furina, Xiangling and Faruzan. 10% Weakspot chance.

heizou-nahida-furina-fischl.desc: Heizou Nahida Furina Fischl. ~25s Rot. Heizou Salad with an EM build P-Amber Heizou triggering Hyperbloom with Swirls and bursting twice per rotation to heal the team.

nahida-kuki-yelan-tighnari.desc: Tighnari Hu Tao style quickbloom with Kuki Nahida Yelan

razor-xingqiu-raiden-nahida.desc: Razor and Raiden fight to see who explodes the seeds. only defensive support by Xingqiu.

bennett-fischl-furina-xingqiu.desc: furina + bennett c6 driving fischl. Make sure to snapshot bennet burst to fischl before it expires. Driving NA strings can probably be optimized

navia-furina-albedo-bennett.desc: Navia Albedo Furina Bennett. 21s rot. Albedo's E can be broken in game. then he can't generate geo particles until he recasts it. In worst scenario when his E is broken at its creation, you lose not only his personal DPS, since you need to use ER sands on both navia and furina for that scenario.

xingqiu-xinyan-yelan-hutao.desc: Hu Tao Double Hydro with Xinyan

clorinde-sara-chevreuse-xinyan.desc: Clorinde Sara Chev Xinyan. 18s rot. Sara Q every 2rots for rot length. Starts with Sara E for Electro app and use it before Clorinde Q afterwards.

arlecchino-yaemiko-chevreuse-dehya.desc: Arle Yae Chev Dehya. 18-19s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. Yae Q if available, or N2C catching chev particles. Sac R5 on dehya for reliable Interruption Resistance.

barbara-nilou-nahida-luminedendro.desc: Barbara bloom with desynced rotation to account for Barbara's 27s E cooldown

navia-furina-dori-yelan.desc: Navia Dori Furina Yelan. Dori increases Navia's energy recharge, allowing her to run close to zero er. In addition, she also heals the entire party, enabling Furina. AP performs similarly to Nighttime.

arlecchino-nahida-fischl-bennett.desc: burnload arle. N16 combo. Good burn uptime to be using UR.

raiden-fischl-xingqiu-sucrose.desc: Raiden Taser w/ Sucrose on fielding during Raiden's downtime. And yes, the single target dps would be slightly better with tenacity Raiden instead.

dori-nahida-fischl-kazuha.desc: Dori Nahida Fischl Kazuha. ~28s Rotation. Dori Aggravate with Kazuha. Low ER requirements all around.

arlecchino-yelan-fischl-thoma.desc: Arle Yelan Fischl Thoma. Yelan 1E 18s rot. No Arle Q, N1C 3[N5D] (N13 spam is similar). Thoma's pyro app is not problem here thanks to Yelan Fischl Overvape. KQMS Random Frame Delay.

gaming-zhongli-bennett-emilie.desc: Gaming Ep at the start of chamber. He plunges 9 times. Bennett does not use E. Every other rotation from the second, Emilie bursts.

dehya-zhongli-emilie-bennett.desc: C6 Dehya, Zhongli, Emilie, Bennett. 20s rot. Emilie bursts if ready, otherwise uses skill. bennett picks up crystalize

razor-nahida-xingqiu-zhongli.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Zhongli. ~24s Rotation. Hyperbloom Razor with ZL.

cyno-nahida-fischl-thoma.desc: Cyno Nahida Fischl Thoma. ~24s Rot. Cyno Quickburn with UR, featuring Nahida and an EM build Thoma. Nahida skips Q on first rotation, then bursts as available.

gaming-xianyun-bennett-emilie.desc: Gaming applies pyro at the start of the chamber by doing Ep. He plunges 8 times per rotation. Emilie uses her skill on the first rotation then bursts every other one.

neuvillette-yaemiko-kazuha-fischl.desc: Neuvillette Electrocharge - Kazuha buffs everyone and everyone does damage. Only burst on Yae when you want to finish off a wave of enemies in AOE - Optimised random delay sim - 2-4 frames delay between non-bufferable actions, 9-15 frames of swap delay

kokomi-furina-zhongli-chiori.desc: Onfield kokomi with double geo core and furina. Uses N2DN2W combos for kokomi strings

yaemiko-zhongli-fischl-tighnari.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with Tighnari and Zhongli

neuvillette-dehya-sucrose-xiangling.desc: Neuv Vape with Dehya for some interruption resistance. 4CA ~26s rot. 3 favs + long rot lets Xiangling use ATK% sands.

raiden-fischl-nahida-zhongli.desc: Raiden Fischl Nahida Zhongli. Avg 18s rot. Fischl E or Zhongli Q at the end of the rot. zhongli Q every rot was dps loss due to its long animation.

jean-yelan-bennett-raiden.desc: Sunfire Overvape with Raiden and Yelan

xiangling-lisa-xingqiu-hutao.desc: Lisa n1 q > Xingqiu ed q n1 > Xiangling n1q ed > Hu Tao n1 e n[1,2,1,2,1,1,2,1]cj n4 > Lisa n1hE n3

neuvillette-furina-barbara-kazuha.desc: Neuvillette Mono Hydro. Roughly 26s Rotation, KQMS, 12-3 Kenki Particles. Clam and Sodp on Barbara have similar performance.

arlecchino-fischl-beidou-chevreuse.desc: Arle Fischl Beidou Chev. 20s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D] N1. its not impressive in ST bcuz of beidou but it can be good for AoE content. Beidou 2E per rot for better energy and she catches fav from chev.

ayaka-rosaria-shenhe-kazuha.desc: Ayaka Rosaria Shenhe kazuha Mono Cryo

raiden-fischl-yelan-xingqiu.desc: TF Fischl Double Hydro with totm Raiden

yoimiya-chevreuse-fischl-lisa.desc: Yoimiya Chevreuse Fischl Lisa. ~27s Rot. (TF) Yoimiya Overload. Chevreuse passes particles to Lisa if possible. EM Yoimiya is better; Hamayumi doesn't justify not using burst.

raiden-nahida-luminedendro-kokomi.desc: Raiden Hypberloom with kokomi DMC and Nahida

raiden-furina-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Raiden Furina Chevreuse Bennett. ~20s Rot. Raiden alongside DPS Overvape Chevreuse. Bennett feeds particles to Chevreuse.

furina-fischl-kazuha-bennett.desc: bennett "soup". 20s rotation. fischl with fav burst every rotation on most iterations. bennett vapes about half of his skills.

raiden-emilie-xiangling-bennett.desc: Raiden Emilie Xiangling Bennett. 20s rot. Emilie Q every rot on Bennett Q. 4DM on someone else other than bennett would have similar DPS in ST.

lyney-tartaglia-kazuha-bennett.desc: Lyney-Tartaglia team without double VV setup

eula-fischl-xianyun-furina.desc: Eula physical plunge, 50% collision. KQMS. Eula does not build ER and burst when possible. MH4 slightly better than Shime4.

cyno-xingqiu-luminedendro-nahida.desc: Cyno Hyperbloom with DMC XQ and Nahida

yoimiya-yelan-kazuha-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Kazuha Bennett. 18s rot. reliable double swirl setup. lack of interruption resistance.

dori-furina-fischl-kazuha.desc: Dori Furina Fischl Kazuha. ~22s Rot. Dori Taser with Kazuha E as available.

ayaka-kazuha-shenhe-yelan.desc: Ayaka Kazuha Shenhe Yelan Freeze, Mistsplitter compatible

sara-fischl-kazuha-nahida.desc: KQMS stats, no random delays. On-Field Sara aggravate team, Fischl variant with Nahida as a healer. ~26 sec rotation

arlecchino-rosaria-diona-bennett.desc: Arle Rosaria Diona Bennett. 21s rot. No Arle Q, N3D combo and CA cancelling. Rosaria 2E per rot. KQMS Random Frame Delay

heizou-nahida-fischl-yelan.desc: Heizou Nahida Fischl Yelan. ~25s Rot. Heizou Salad with Heizou triggering hyperbloom with swirls and bursting twice per rotation to heal the team. 2 E Yelan. Heizou spams N1C between skill and burst.

alhaitham-yelan-raiden-zhongli.desc: Alhaitham Hyperbloom with Zhongli and Yelan

kinich-yaemiko-fischl-kazuha.desc: Kinch Yae Fischl Kazuha. ~36s Rot. Kinich on-field Aggravate with Scroll. Yae & Kinich burst every rotation. No Kinich short hold is -5k DPS.

dori-nahida-fischl-sucrose.desc: Dori Nahida Fischl Sucrose. ~30s Rotation. Dori Aggravate with Hakushin Sucrose.

lisa-fischl-sucrose-yaoyao.desc: Lisa Aggravate with Yaoyao. Energy issues; very high substats on instructors

heizou-nahida-fischl-xingqiu.desc: Heizou Nahida Fischl Xingqiu. ~25s Rot. Heizou Salad with Heizou triggering hyperbloom with swirls and bursting twice per rotation to heal the team. Heizou will eventually be stamina constrained. Nahida skips Burst without ER.

zhongli-keqing-fischl-nahida.desc: Keqing aggravate with Zhongli Fischl Kazuha

mualani-mona-sucrose-xiangling.desc: Mualani Mona Sucrose Xiangling. ~34s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. Mona C1 is beneficial. 1st half Xiangling Q and uses Mualani Q, 2nd half Sucrose Pyro Q from Guoba. Using Mona E is beneficial to allow her hold 4intructor. Check the config and 4Scroll mona is ~1k behind.

ayaka-lynette-mona-shenhe.desc: Ayaka Freeze with Mona. Amenoma and Wolf-fang perform similarly on Ayaka, ToTM and Scroll perform simlarly on Mona. Rot can be adapted for pre-C4 Lynette by changing EQ to N1 Q

fischl-nahida-diona-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Nahida Fischl and Diona

kinich-zhongli-xiangling-bennett.desc: Kinich Zhongli Xiangling Bennett. 21s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. Xiangling Burst every rot

raiden-yaemiko-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Raiden Yae Chevreuse Bennett. avg 19s rot. Yae burst every other rot. DPS build chev with 4EoSF. use bennett or chev before raiden for res shred refresh. You can try 4SoDP healer Chev in the config. its weaker.

alhaitham-fischl-yaemiko-kuki.desc: Deepwood: Yae > Kuki > Alhaitham. ~28s rotation with 1 Kuki E (low survivability). Alhaitham N1Cs before starting the loop (to enable Hakushin) and uses tap E over hE LP. Customized random delays, 12-3 Icewind Suite energy.

raiden-yaemiko-xiangling-chevreuse.desc: Raiden Yae Xiangling Chevreuse. 22s rot. Easier rot. Xiangling uses some NAs before Q to ensure chev c6 stacks and to make it 22s rot for yae Q's 22s cd. 4EoSF on yae is slightly worse.

neuvillette-xiangling-zhongli-albedo.desc: Neuv Xiangling Albedo Zhongli. 4CA 26s rot. Closer to Neuv forward vape. Random frame delay on swap and unbufferable actions.

bennett-emilie-fischl-lisa.desc: Bennett Emilie Fischl Lisa. ~18s Rot. On-Field Bennett Burning w/ Overload; 59/51% Burning/Quicken uptime. All characters Q/E catch Bennett's buff. Lisa Burst as every rotation as available. Deepwood on Bennett vs Lisa is the same.

raiden-ororon-furina-xilonen.desc: Raiden Furina Ororon Xilonen. 20s rot. Raiden ATK Goblet. Xilonen uses 4AP, mostly for Electro due to EC aura.

kinich-fischl-thoma-bennett.desc: Kinich Fischl Thoma Bennett. 18s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. Simple rotation with Thoma's IR. Scroll on Fischl is better for team DPS.

xiangling-furina-emilie-bennett.desc: 21sec rotation, Emilie onfield for bennet buff

kazuha-sara-fischl-nahida.desc: TF Fischl Hypercarry iwth Nahida Kazuha Sara

noelle-kazuha-yelan-furina.desc: Petra Noelle driving Furina Yelan Kazuha

yoimiya-furina-kazuha-bennett.desc: Yoimiya vape with hydro infused Kazuha burst - Hyperoptimised sim

itto-gorou-furina-xianyun.desc: Itto "Lamentto" plunge with Gorou, Furina, Xianyun. Itto N1 Q E 8JDHP C3F E CF, 50% plunge collision rate.

bennett-furina-fischl-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Furina Overvape with +- 3 delays. Hydro aura is not consistent. No yoi burst to save on fieldtime.

lisa-fischl-kazuha-baizhu.desc: Fischl Aggravate with Baizhu Kauzha Lisa

yoimiya-yelan-yunjin-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Yelan YunJin Bennett. 20s rot with YunJin 2E. Rust R5 is worse than Slingshot R5 here. Note that solo hydro yelan's ER need is really high. make sure yunjin catches geo particles while she is on-field. she can hold favlance if you have enough CR and weav NAs for reliable proc.

yoimiya-xingqiu-fischl-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Xingqiu Fischl Bennett. 21s rot. due to xq's long cd, doing some NAs at the end of the rot

navia-yelan-chiori-zhongli.desc: Navia Chiori Yelan Zhongli. Yelan 1E 18s rot. Start with EQ navia in the first rot for her energy. Used 3[N2D] navia to make it 18s rot length(yelan 18s cd).

arlecchino-kazuha-chiori-zhongli.desc: Arle Kazuha Chiori Zhongli. 17-18s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. Kazuha starts with tEPQ every rot and comes in between arle combos to tEP for refreshing buffs.

raiden-furina-nahida-xiangling.desc: Raiden Furina Nahida Xiangling. ~21s Rot. Raiden makes a mess of reactions. P-amber Nahida supplies the only healing. The Burgeon count is thankfully low.

fischl-cyno-thoma-emilie.desc: Cyno Fischl Emilie Thoma. 4UR Cyno 25s rot. EM focused 4DM Thoma, dealing high Overloaded damage with lower shield HP. Emilie Q every 2 rots.

razor-furina-nahida-bennett.desc: Razor Furina Nahida Bennett. ~25s. Razor Hyperburgeon with C6 Bennett infusion. Nahida runs P-Amber to counteract Furina's HP drain, fanfare decreases in later rotations. 2E Bennett builds EM. Self-Overloads not implemented.

ayato-furina-yunjin-xilonen.desc: Ayato Furina Yunjin Xilonen. ~25s Rot. Ayato does a physical NA at the end of his first skill and cuts his second skill short. Ayato prefers crit weapons. Yunjin dashes to pick up Crystalize shards for AP. Damage build Xilonen is more damage.

cyno-kinich-fischl-xilonen.desc: Cyno Kinich Fischl Xilonen. ~25s Rot. Cyno Aggravate with a Kinich shooting one cannon shot before burst to provide Dendro in multiwave. Xilonen runs AP and picks up Crystallize easily.

baizhu-furina-yelan-nilou.desc: triple hydro nilou bloom with baizhu driver. 22s~ rotation. baizhu is built em, still but his shields healing are still enough to sustain the team. can also build hp/hb for not a huge lose. on field baizhu apply decent amount of dendro to make blooms, with him owning around half of them. yelan and furina build hp/hydro/crit and deal high non reaction damage.

mualani-zhongli-kazuha-xiangling.desc: Mualani Zhongli Kazuha Xiangling. 35s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. 1st half Xiangling Q and uses Mualani Q, 2nd half Kazuha Pyro Q from Guoba.

yelan-zhongli-fischl-yoimiya.desc: Yoimiya Overvape with yelan Fishcl Zhongli

chevreuse-fischl-bennett-yanfei.desc: Yanfei 15-16s rotation, burst every other rot. Can use 4 SR but will have less c4 shield uptime.

yoimiya-emilie-fischl-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Emilie Fischl Bennett. ~17s Rot. Emilie bursts every other rot. Fischl alternates skill/burst. Near zero Quicken uptime. Deepwood > NO Bennett.

diluc-furina-yelan-xianyun.desc: Diluc Furina Yelan Xianyun. ~25s Rot. Diluc weaves normals between low plunges while Yelan burst is active, then dash dancels high plunges. No Pyro VV.

ayaka-charlotte-lynette-furina.desc: Ayaka Freeze with Furina. Charlotte Q E to funnel particles to Ayaka. Current rotation absorbs Cryo with Lynette Q, but she can do E N2 Q to absorb Hydro and help with Freeze consistency. Pre-C4 Lynette skips first E

beidou-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: Beidou Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. Beidou on-field Overload; uses NA's only with N2D, assumes Beidou takes damage to activate her C4; Beidou bursts as available. Electro>ATK Goblet. Fischl snapshots Bennett's buff. Bennett buffed Chevreuse bursts every other rot. 25% perfect counter, 25% counter. Self-Overloads not implemented.

clorinde-nahida-beidou-xilonen.desc: Clorinde Nahida Beidou Xilonen. ~24s Rot. Thundering Fury Clorinde with Beidou. Clorinde burst is optional. Nahida bursts every other rotation after the first. Eshu is techincally functional Copium. Within narrow distance for Beidou C6, RES shred may be inconsistent in practice. 10% counter; 20% Perfect counter.

raiden-fischl-nahida-sara.desc: Raiden, Fischl, Nahida, Sara. 20s rotation. VV-less Aggravate, very easy to play, very low ER requirements. Other weapon options for Nahida in Config.

arlecchino-rosaria-albedo-zhongli.desc: Arlecchino melt with Rosaria + Albedo Zhongli double geo core. 17s~ rotation. n15 combo arle, no cancels and no burst.

neuvillette-yelan-kazuha-yaemiko.desc: Neuv Yelan Yae Kazuha. 3CA 26-27s rot. Yelan 2E. weaving some NAs for her Q proc. 9-15f Random swap delay.

wanderer-faruzan-furina-mika.desc: Wanderer Faruzan Furina Mika. ~22s Rot. Wanderer Q at the end of FT if available. Wanderer swirls Cryo with E. Easy to overcap CR. SoDP~=OHC Mika.

yoimiya-furina-sucrose-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Furina Sucrose Bennett. 20s rot. Sucrose burst if available to absorb hydro and provide consistent hydro aura. Yoimiya burst if available during the downtime.

freminet-furina-yelan-xilonen.desc: Freminet Yelan Furina Xilonen. ~23s Rot. Cryo Freminet Shatter with Xilonen and Yelan using 2Es per rotation. Freminet does a lvl 1 Shattering Pressure before Yelan uses burst and does an abbreviated burst between Yelan skills.

xiao-fischl-yelan-xingqiu.desc: Xiao Driver for Double Hydro and Fischl

yoimiya-yelan-sucrose-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Sucrose Bennett. 18s rot. Only swirl pyro for short sucrose field time. Bennett Q level1 hE > Sucrose E dash N1. High DPS when TTDS is activated. Check the DPS on the first rot to see that.

yoimiya-xingqiu-fischl-yelan.desc: Double Hydro TF Yoimiya with Fischl

keqing-furina-yelan-mika.desc: Keqing Yelan Furina Mika. ~22s Rot. Phys Keqing on-field spamming CA. Keqing bursts after Yelan's burst expires. 2E Yelan. OHC > SODP Mika.

clorinde-zhongli-bennett-chiori.desc: clorinde double geo with benny's buff. clorinde burst when ready. zhongli burst every rotation to fill time. no chiori burst.

ayaka-bennett-xiangling-emilie.desc: Rev melt solo cryo Ayaka with Emilie. High er reqs for ayaka, and emilie bursts every 2 rotations.

xianyun-furina-beidou-fischl.desc: xianyun furina beidou fischl taser with xianyun plunging. SGT, in AoE beidou uses 4pc EoSF. 50% perfect parry chance.

hutao-fischl-yelan-kazuha.desc: hu tao yelan fischl overvape w kazuha

neuvillette-xiangling-kazuha-kirara.desc: Neuvillette Guide Weapons (Vape) R5 Sacrificial Jade

noelle-albedo-yelan-furina.desc: Noelle Albedo Yelan Furina. ~21s Rotation. AP Noelle dashes to pick up crystallize. 2*E Yelan. MH Noelle option in config.

ayato-nahida-fischl-thoma.desc: Thoma Burgeon wtih Nahida Ayato Fischl

neuvillette-furina-ganyu-kazuha.desc: Neuv Furina Ganyu Kazuha. 4CA 31-32s rot. Ganyu's freeze as a defensive utility. 4EoSF on ganyu has similar result. Random delay as 9-15f swap and 2-4f action

arlecchino-emilie-kazuha-kirara.desc: Arle Emilie Kazuha Kirara. 17s rot. No Arle Q 6[N3D]. Emilie Q if available and if not, use Kazuha Q. Kirara right before Arle, protecting Arle. using Kirara Q for better 4DM uptime and AoE coverage.

dori-fischl-sucrose-collei.desc: Dori Aggravate wtih Sucrose Fischl Collei

bennett-nahida-yelan-fischl.desc: Bennett Nahida Fischl Yelan. ~19s Rot. Bennett Burgeon  with Fischl snapshotting his buff and adding Overload. Nahida omits burst if unavailable.

clorinde-beidou-chevreuse-xiangling.desc: Clorinde Beiodu Xiangling Chev. 20s rot. Beidou is pretty solid in 2T. Beidou can hold Favgs if you want more comfort. Damage weapon on xiangling isn't that good.

navia-yelan-bennett-chiori.desc: Navia Chiori Yelan Bennett. Yelan 1E 18.5s rot. Start with EQ navia in the first rot for her energy.

klee-furina-kazuha-chevreuse.desc: kleerina without circle impact. chev provides easy vv setup, her c6 buff, healing, and energy. 21s rotation. kazuha uses r5 fav to get 2 procs per rotation.

freminet-furina-ororon-xianyun.desc: Freminet Furina Ororon Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Freminet Phys plunge with Superconduct. Ororon prefers NO to Scroll. Executes 1 Shattering Pressure combo while plunging. 50% Collisions. PF > MH on Freminet.

raiden-kazuha-fischl-alhaitham.desc: Raiden Alhaitham with Kazuha and Fischl (Its mostly Fischl)

navia-fischl-bennett-ningguang.desc: navia with ningguang. 20s~ rotation. ning uses CA after burst to utilize c6 star jades.

navia-furina-chiori-kokomi.desc: Navia Chiori Furina Kokomi. 20-21s rot. Kokomi refreshes jellyfish and heals the whole team. Use 3rd navia E if available. you may try fav furina to lower navia's ER in the config.

gaming-chongyun-bennett-xianyun.desc: Gaming Chongyun (C5)Bennett Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Chongyun melts his Q on Bennett's Q. Xianyun only swirls Pyro at the start of the rotation. Gaming weaves NAs after his skill plunges and burst to apply Cryo. 4 Skill Plunges.

nahida-kuki-xingqiu-tighnari.desc: Tighnari Hu Tao style mainly Hyperbloom with Xingqiu Kuki and Nahida first version

razor-nahida-xingqiu-diona.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Diona. ~24s Rotation. Hyperbloom Razor with Diona. Few Shatter occurences. NO > Ins Diona, as she has issues owning reactions in this rotation. DW > NO Diona with GT Nahida.

arlecchino-yelan-mona-zhongli.desc: Arle Yelan Mona Zhongli. Yelan 1E 18s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 6[N3D]. Mona can hold TTDS catching fav particles from zhongli on-field and being double hydro. activated every other rot though.

lisa-fischl-zhongli-tighnari.desc: TIghnari Spread with Fishcl Lisa Zhongli

lisa-furina-fischl-xianyun.desc: Lisa Furina Fischl Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Lisa Taser Plunge. Xianyun refeshes VV after Fischl uses burst. Lisa uses hold skill immediately after all plunges are spent to catch furina's burst. 50% Collisons.

rosaria-bennett-furina-emilie.desc: Burnmelt/Burgeon Rosaria with Furina Vaping. Noblesse Bennett + Deepwood Furina is a bit worse. For Bennett: Deepwood > Noblesse > Scroll >= Instructor. Bennett does not heal himself first rotation but does on subsequent ones. Rosaria does a mix of N2CD and N1CD with Skill inbetween.

cyno-furina-nahida-xilonen.desc: Cyno Furina Nahida Xilonen. ~27s rot. Cyno Quickbloom with Xilonen (5 N4E N4). Xilonen 2 E cast which generates both Electro and Hydro Crystallize shards consistently.

freminet-rosaria-bennett-xianyun.desc: Freminet Rosaria Bennett Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Freminet Melt Plunge. Freminet uses skill/burst if lacking Cyro aura before plunging. High ER needs on Bennett and Xianyun. 50% Collisions.

sucrose-xingqiu-fischl-luminedendro.desc: Sucrose Hyperbloom with DMC Fischl and Xingqiu

diluc-furina-xianyun-xilonen.desc: Casual friendly Diluc plunge set up. 20s rot. Vape loses consistency past the first rotation and Xianyun does what you would normally do with Bennett VV rotations thanks to Furina's pets being super inconsistent with Hydro appilcation. Tries to wait for hydro aura before plunging. 66% Collisions.  12-3 icewind suite energy drops.

xiao-faruzan-fischl-bennett.desc: Xiao Fischl Faruzan Bennett. 19s Rot. 11 High plunges. Faruzan burst leads the rotation. Fischl catches Bennett's buff. 50% Collisions.

klee-furina-kokomi-xiangling.desc: Kleerina with xl - except this time, Kokomi is here to provide hydro application for xl and then pass on ttds to Klee. Hydro resonance is a nice bonus for Furina, too

wriothesley-xilonen-shenhe-chiori.desc: Wrio Double Geo N3C combo. Shenhe and Wrio Burst when available, Chiori Bursts when available to fill downtime. 16s rotation

nahida-xingqiu-thoma-raiden.desc: Thoma Burgeon with Nahida Xingqiu and a little bit of Raiden hyperbloom

kazuha-yaemiko-furina-xianyun.desc: Yae plunge team with Kazuha for his grouping ability. 50% collisions. 25s rotations

alhaitham-fischl-albedo-kuki.desc: Deepwood: Albedo > Kuki. Decent amount of Crystallizes and dashes to help with HoD, but low Kuki E uptime. No jump cancels. Customized random frame delays; 12-3 Icewind Suite energy.

ayato-furina-kazuha-xilonen.desc: Ayato Furina Kazuha Xilonen. 25s rot. Kazuha not using Q. simply using E before Ayato's field time

freminet-furina-nahida-kuki.desc: QMS 4MH Freminet Hyperbloom w/ Furina. Furina EdQ > Nahida EQ > Shinobu E / E CA Q > Frem EQ N2 E 3[EN2EN1]. Uses swap_delay=4

arlecchino-xingqiu-layla-bennett.desc: Arle Xingqiu Layla Bennett. 21s rot. Arle No Q, N1 CA dash cancel 3[N5D].

navia-furina-sigewinne-chiori.desc: Navia double hydro with Sigewinne. Sige funnels to furina for lower er reqs. OHC slightly better than totm on sige

nahida-nilou-yelan-kirara.desc: Single target focused Nilou. On field Nahida. 2E Yelan 21s rotation. Hydro characters get almost all bloom ownership. HP Hydro Crit Yelan build

freminet-furina-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Freminet Furina Rosaria Xianyun. ~20s Rot. PF Freminet Phys plunge with C6 Rosaria Phys shred. Executes 1 lvl. 4 Shattering Pressure combo after plunging. Rosaria and Furina Freeze opponents for Freminet's Shatter cons. 50% Collisions.

kokomi-nilou-luminedendro-collei.desc: Nilou Bloom with kokomi Collei and DMC

clorinde-fischl-yaemiko-kazuha.desc: Clorinde Fischl Yae Kazuha. ~16s Rot. Clorinde Mono Electro. Clorinde bursts every rotation. No burst Yae & Kazuha.

clorinde-nahida-beidou-yelan.desc: Clorinde Nahida Beidou Yelan. ~26s Rot. (TF) Clorinde Quickbloom with Beidou. Clorinde does not burst. Beidou bursts before Yelan.

qiqi-furina-yelan-xingqiu.desc: qiqi driver and battery via fav for triple hydro. 23s~ rotation with 2 yelan E.  qiqi alternate between skill and burst use.

arlecchino-yelan-mona-layla.desc: Arle Yelan Mona Layla. Yelan 1E 18s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 6[N3D]. Mona can hold TTDS catching fav particles from layla on-field and being double hydro. activated every other rot though. Layla's shield and Freeze make arle safe.

alhaitham-nahida-raiden-xianyun.desc: Alhaitham Nahida Raiden Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Alhaitham Quicken Plunge. AlHaitham uses skill, spams JlPN1, then bursts, followed by Raiden quickly generating energy for the next rotation. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but Bubbles may miss. 60% Collisions.

yelan-kokomi-raiden-collei.desc: Riaden Hyperbloom with Collei Yelan and Kokomi

kazuha-keqing-fischl-yaoyao.desc: Keqing FIshcl Aggravate with Kazuha Yaoyao

nahida-yelan-yaemiko-zhongli.desc: Yae Yelan Hyperbloom with Nahida Zhongli

ayaka-furina-nahida-kuki.desc: Ayaka Furina Nahida Kuki. ~22s Rotation. Ayaka driving Hyperbloom w. Furina and P-Amber Nahida.

faruzan-furina-fischl-bennett.desc: Faruzan Furina Fischl Bennett. ~20s Rot. Faruzan on-field DPS spends Burst and Hurricane Arrows as available, with Bennett Es during downtime. Fischl snapshots Bennett Q.

neuvillette-fischl-kazuha-kirara.desc: Neuv Fischl Kazuha Kirara. 4CA 30s rot. Neuv with Kirara's shield. Kazuha swirls hydro in the early rot and electro in the later rot. fischl's ST dmg and kazuha's AoE swirl makes this team good at both ST and AoE. 9-15f Random Swap Delay.

yoimiya-furina-sigewinne-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Furina Sigewinne Bennett. 20s rot. Sigewinne prefunnel Furina, lowering her ER. In single-target, with luck on Furina&Sigewinne timing, Yoimiya can consistently vape her NAs(making EM sands better). Wait a bit(about N2-3) before Yoimiya E, not to ruin the enemy aura. 4SoDP greatly increase Yoimiya's damage, while 4OHC increases Sigewinne's.

alhaitham-yaoyao-yelan-kuki.desc: Alhaitham Quickbloom with yelan and double healer - yaoyao and kuki. Optimised for Alhaitham damage.

raiden-yaemiko-kazuha-nahida.desc: Yae Raiden Aggravate with Kazuha Nahida

yelan-xingqiu-raiden-collei.desc: Riaden Hyperbloom with Double Hydro and Collei

yoimiya-yelan-fischl-chevreuse.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Fischl Chev. 18s rot. Chev can provide ATK% and C6 DMG bonus. KQMS Random Frame Delay.

yelan-baizhu-yoimiya-furina.desc: Yoimiya double hydro baizhu. Slight optimizations from previous sim. CDmg/EM/Atk on Yoi. Changed rotation to clear dendro before yoimiya uptime. Yoi bursts every other rotation.

raiden-xingqiu-yelan-fischl.desc: Raiden Double Hydro with ToTM Fischl

kazuha-furina-nahida-bennett.desc: Kazuha Furina Nahida Bennett. ~23s Rot. Kazuha Burgeon/Furina Burn-Vape in 2 Target. Kazuha remains on-field in Bennett's burst. P-Amber Nahida counteracts some of Furina's HP drain; fanfare decreases in later rotations. 2E Bennett builds EM. Fragile, don't get vaped.

fischl-baizhu-nahida-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Triple Dendro with Fischl Baizhu Nahida

kokomi-furina-xiangling-bennett.desc: Xiangling Vape. Very simple comfy team. Has an abundance of healing from Kokomi Bennett and Furina's A1

xingqiu-baizhu-thoma-fischl.desc: Thoma BUrgeon with Fischl Xingqiu Baizhu

mualani-mona-kazuha-xiangling.desc: Mualani Mona Kazuha Xiangling. ~18s rot. Q if available + 3[3-stacked bite]. Mona C1 is beneficial. Xiangling Q every 2 rots. Kazuha Q comes in instead of it. Using Mona E is beneficial to allow her hold 4intructor. Check the config and 4Scroll mona is ~3k behind.

mualani-candace-lynette-xiangling.desc: Mualani Vape with C5 Candace. ~36s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. Xiangling Q applies Pyro first half, Guoba and Lynette Q second half. Rot works with pre-C4 Lynette. Only works with C0-C5 Candace

ayato-furina-fischl-xianyun.desc: Ayato Furina Fischl Xianyun. Xianyun is here for healing and TTDS. Furina EQ > Fischl E > Xianyun EP Q > Ayato E N16 Q > Fischl Q > Xianyun EP > Ayato E N15

clorinde-emilie-nahida-dehya.desc: Clorinde Emilie Nahida Dehya. ~15s/17s Rot. Nahida burst every rotation.

yoimiya-lisa-chevreuse-bennett.desc: yoi overload with lisa. full em lisa. dps build chev. 21s~ rotation.

yanfei-furina-xianyun-bennett.desc: Yanfei plunges with Furina Xianyun and Bennett, not easy to vape properly, waits are needed to vape the plunges.

raiden-furina-yaemiko-xilonen.desc: Raiden Furina Yae Xilonen. ~22s Rot. Raikou with Xilonen. Xilonen uses skill again just before Raiden burst.

raiden-yelan-bennett-chevreuse.desc: Raiden with DPS built overvape Chevreuse, 19s rotation

arlecchino-fischl-chevreuse-yanfei.desc: Arle Fischl Yanfei Chev. 20s rot. Arle EQE every rot so that yanfei can hold TTDS without ER sands. the rot is a bit funny catching TTDS and swap out.

yoimiya-yelan-furina-diona.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Furina Diona. Yelan 2E 22s rot. diona comes back to heal herself later. Utilize diona's C6 200EM and 4SoDP buff while having occasional melt.

cyno-nahida-xingqiu-thoma.desc: cyno 'chaos' team with xingqiu. burgeons + overloads and resistance to interruption

ayato-furina-ororon-xilonen.desc: Ayato Furina Ororon Xilonen. 24-25s rot. Ororon triggers Scroll, so Xilonen can hold 4AP.

ningguang-yelan-xingqiu-chiori.desc: on field ning apl double hydro. AP and nighttime similar on ning. chiori does not burst.

neuvillette-xiangling-zhongli-chiori.desc: Neuv Xiangling Chiori Zhongli. 4CA 27s rot. Enemy aura is somewhat unstable due to the geo app. Both of them takes the equal vape ownership. Random frame delay on swap and unbufferable actions.

razor-nahida-xingqiu-layla.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Layla. ~23s Rotation. Hyperbloom Razor with Layla. Few Shatter occurences. DW > ToM Layla with ToM Nahida.

sara-fischl-kazuha-kirara.desc: Sara Fischl Kazuha Kirara. ~26 Rot. On-Field Sara Aggravate with a Shielder Kirara.

freminet-furina-yelan-dori.desc: Freminet Furina Yelan Dori. ~22s Rot. Phys Freminet on-field with Fav Dori comfortably batterying the team. Yelan loses few dice procs.

mualani-zhongli-lynette-xiangling.desc: Mualani Vape with Zhongli. ~33s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. Xiangling Q applies Pyro first half and Guoba plus Lynette Q second half. Includes a tiny wait between Mualani Q and N1 to make sure Q hits first. Rot works with pre-C4 Lynette

neuvillette-lisa-lynette-fischl.desc: neuvi double electro with lisa and lynette. rot is for c4+/sac lynette but alternate rot is included. lisa skips skill so fav is r5 to help er.

wriothesley-nahida-furina-kuki.desc: Wrio driving a Hyperbloom comp feat. Furina

arlecchino-chiori-zhongli-lynette.desc: Simple Arle double geo, rot works with C0 Lynette. N3D combo and uses Lynette Q or Zhongli Q to fill time depending on which is available. Lower damage due to losing Bennett, but no circle impact. Zhongli shield provides survivability. R5 finale and R1 wolffang are about the same.

arlecchino-xingqiu-yelan-thoma.desc: Arle Yelan Xingqiu Thoma. Yelan 2E 21s rot. Arle No Q, 6[N3D]. Thoma for pyro resonance, shield, C6 DMG Bonus and 4NO.

kazuha-nahida-xingqiu-bennett.desc: Kazuha Xingqiu Nahida Bennett. ~23s Rot. Kazuha Burgeon in 2 Target. Kazuha does NA in Bennett's burst. Assumes XQ rainswords contact opponents. 2E Bennett builds EM.

yoimiya-furina-yelan-jean.desc: Yoimiya Furina Yelan Jean. Yelan 1E 20s rot. Yoimiya can try her burst every other rot but it leads to a few hundred DPS loss. also she doesn't do massive damage in the team to make her burst particularly worth using to make her do more damage.

yaemiko-fischl-zhongli-collei.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with Collei and Zhongli

klee-furina-bennett-xianyun.desc: Kleerina with Bennett and Xianyun. Double swirl rotation makes Xianyun struggle with ER. Klee bursts every other rotation and has a 50% collision rate. Rotation is difficult to pull off in-game because of lack of interrupt resistance and quickly switching aura. 21/22s rotation.

kuki-nahida-yelan-cyno.desc: Kuki Cyno Hyperbloom with Nahida and Yelan

keqing-nahida-fischl-xianyun.desc: Keqing Nahida Xianyun Fischl. ~24s Rot. Non-TF Keqing Aggravate plunge. Keqing cancels a few plunges with N1 for more Aggravtes- Close the rotation with burst. Sensitive Electro aura, steps are taken to ensure VV. Nahida touches the field once. Hold skill aerial plunge not used. 50% Collisons.

yaoyao-fischl-lisa-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Yaoyao Lisa Fischl

navia-furina-gorou-bennett.desc: Navia Gorou Furina Bennett. 22s rot. 4Exile is really good for team energy here. Gorou feeds fav and geo particles to navia. his field time is only once per rot, easier to play.

alhaitham-xingqiu-kuki-diona.desc: Deepwood Alhaitham w/ flexible combo to adapt to energy (essentially, burst every other rot if low ER). Customized random frame delays; 12-3 Icewind Suite energy.

bennett-xingqiu-fischl-ororon.desc: Bennett XIngqiu Fischl Ororon. ~21s Rot. Overvape Thundering Fury Bennett. Fischl alternates skill and burst in Bennett's field. EDC > EEC > 3EM Bennett.

yoimiya-yelan-rosaria-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Rosaira Bennett. ~18s Rot. Yoimiya VapeMelt. Freeze immunity is -8K DPS.

razor-emilie-yaemiko-bennett.desc: Razor Emilie Yae Bennett. ~22s Rotation. Razor Quickload w/ 61/56% Burning/Quicken uptime. SS may be inconsistent. No burst, EM support Yae. Self-Overloads not implemented.

ningguang-luminegeo-bennett-chiori.desc: Ningguang-Geo MC-Chiori-Bennett APL rotation,  GMC C6 is a slight team dps increase but lower personal DPS

fischl-yelan-kazuha-ayato.desc: ayato yelan fischl kaz with rotation fixed

yoimiya-yelan-yunjin-xilonen.desc: Yoimiya Yelan YunJin Xilonen. 19-20s rot. Picking up the shard is required for Geo Resonance buff. YunJin can easily hold DEF% weapon thanks to team Fav and Xilonen's Geo particles.

razor-emilie-lisa-bennett.desc: Razor Emilie Lisa Bennett. ~22s Rotation. Razor Quickload w/ 70/46% Quicken/Burning uptime. SS may be inconsistent. Self-Overloads not implemented.

raiden-sara-chevreuse-bennett.desc: Raiden Sara Chevreuse Bennett. 20s rot. Utilize Chev C2 delayed pyro app as a final res shred refresh. 4TotM on Chev makes sara's burst and raiden's initial slash stronger but weaker raiden total dmg.

kokomi-fischl-nahida-xiangling.desc: Kokomi, Fischl, Nahida, Xiangling Curry team

neuvillette-beidou-fischl-kazuha.desc: Neuv Fischl Beidou Kazuha. 26s rot. Neuv's AoE with Kazuha's hE and Beidou Q make the team potent against multiple enemies while Fischl handles single target damage. Beidou can have manageable ER thanks to fischl.

yanfei-furina-yelan-bennett.desc: Yanfei Furina Yelan Bennett. ~20s Rot. Yanfei double Hydro Vape with 1xE Yelan. Yanfei bursts every other rotation. Yanfei receieves all healing. 1E Bennett.

raiden-fischl-furina-bennett.desc: Raifish Furina Bennett. 20s rot. Fischl E at the end of the rot(=every other rot). Furina doesn't get bennett's healing.

keqing-furina-fischl-xianyun.desc: Keqing Furina Fischl Xianyun. ~25s Rot. Keqing Taser Plunge. Xianyun refreshes VV mid rotation. 4 plunges in each half. Keqing fills some time at the end of the rotation with N1C and Burst. Hold skill aerial plunge not implemented. 50% Collisons.

yoimiya-emilie-chiori-zhongli.desc: Yoimiya Emilie Chiori Zhongli. 18s rot. Yoimiya has 18s cd on her E, so fill the downtime with bursts.

ayaka-kokomi-lynette-shenhe.desc: Ayaka Freeze with Kokomi. C4 Lynette uses EQ when E is available and N1 Q otherwise, pre-C4 uses only N1 Q. ToTM is slightly behind Scroll on Kokomi

wriothesley-bennett-lynette-emilie.desc: Lynette books her particles and Bennett has 6 more ER rolls than KQMS allows. VV setup is easy: Wrio N1, Emilie E, Lynette E.

clorinde-yelan-ororon-yunjin.desc: Clorinde Yelan Ororon YunJin. 18s rot. YunJin can have manageable ER req thanks to 2pc Scroll, Ororon and Team Fav. Put Ororon right before Clorinde to feed her particles.

yoimiya-yelan-xingqiu-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Xingqiu Bennett. Yelan 1E 21s rot. Simply xq > yelan > bennett > yoi (Q every other rot) > bennett E. Xingqiu's long cooldown allows Yoimiya to use her Burst to increase her damage. She can easily restore her energy with 4SR thanks to bennett.

beidou-kokomi-nahida-xiangling.desc: Kokomi Vape Burgeon with a CA based rotation. ~24s rotation. Beidou's IR reduces need for dash, but stamina management is needed on player's part to get all 6 CAs off during Kokomi's Burst.

sayu-nahida-yaemiko-fischl.desc: Sayu Nahida Yae Fischl. ~25s Rot. Sayu Aggravate with a max duration roll with Fav. Yae bursts every rotation.

noelle-lynette-yelan-furina.desc: double hydro with driver noelle and 4pc VV lynette. atk% goblet is better than dmg% for C2+ lynette. rot can be adjusted for pre-C4 lynette by weaving some additional NAs

ningguang-gorou-fischl-chiori.desc: on field ning apl. crystallize and c4 gorou provide some survivability.

heizou-furina-yaemiko-fischl.desc: Heizou Furina Yae Fischl. ~25s Rot. Heizou Taser in ST w/ P-Amber Heizou bursting twice per rotation to heal the team. EM >= ADC Heizou in ST. Burstless Yae.

dori-kirara-fischl-kazuha.desc: Dori Kirara Fischl Kazuha. ~30s Rotation. Dori Aggravate with Ins. Sapwood Kirara.

kuki-nahida-luminedendro-kokomi.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with DMC Nhaida and Kokomi

arlecchino-kazuha-xinyan-bennett.desc: Arle Xinyan Kazuha Bennett. 18s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D] N1. xinyan's shield lasts 12s

noelle-yelan-furina-chiori.desc: Noelle Yelan Furina Chiori, APL version. Noelle has main DPS of team.

razor-nahida-xingqiu-dori.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Dori. ~23s Rot. Razor-Dori Hyperbloom. Razor and Dori split Hyperbloom ownership, with Dori's chain typically taking more cores when adjacent.

sucrose-xingqiu-fischl-collei.desc: Sucrose Hyperbloom with Fischl Xingqiu and Collei

kinich-furina-xiangling-baizhu.desc: Kinich Furina Xiangling Baizhu. 20s rot. Everyone except Kinich Q every rot. Burnvape Furina.

ayaka-yelan-heizou-shenhe.desc: Heizou Ayaka Shenhe Yelan Freeze, Mistsplitter compatible

xiao-faruzan-lynette-bennett.desc: xiao hypercarry with lynette.21s~  rotation. lynette feed skill and fav particles to xiao when needed

neuvillette-shenhe-kazuha-zhongli.desc: Neuvillette Guide Weapons (Low ER, no Furina) R5 Sacrificial Jade

raiden-kazuha-baizhu-fischl.desc: Raiden Fischl Baizhu Kazuha short rotation version (fischl using E every other rot)

razor-emilie-fischl-dehya.desc: Razor Emilie Fischl Deyha. ~20s Rot. Razor with 16s of Field time. Emilie bursts every other rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst. Deyha applies Pyro immediately following Emilie.

aetherelectro-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: EMC Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. EMC on-field DPS. Assumes 3 hits from Electro travelers skill; the Thunder amulets are picked up as soon as possible. EMC bursts as available to fit into the rotation length. EMC does N3C. 3EM > EDC EMC. Fischl just before Chevreuse is better for DPS. Chevreuse bursts every other rot, though it may be possible to burst every rot in game if she's consistently catching EMC amulets.

wriothesley-shenhe-furina-xilonen.desc: Wrio Shenhe Furina Xilonen. Xilonen 2E 22s rot. N3CJ spam. Wrio Q every other rot.

kokomi-fischl-nahida-thoma.desc: Thoma Burgeon with Fischl Kokomi Nahida

lynette-faruzan-kokomi-furina.desc: Lynette hypercarry with Kokomi. 20s rotation. Kokomi offers healing and buff Lynette with TTDS, as well as enable hydro resonance and battery Furina.

neuvillette-kazuha-zhongli-chiori.desc: Neuv Kazuha Chiori Zhongli. 4CA 28s rot. You just care about hydro 4AP. No worry for aura management.

bennett-furina-xiangling-fischl.desc: Bennett Furina Xiangling Fischl. ~20s Rot. Fischl Furinational with Bennett funneling Xiangling's burst, then on-feild skill spam for the rest of the rotation. CW > NO on Bennett. Fischl alternates skill and burst in Bennett's burst.

razor-furina-kuki-nahida.desc: Razor Quickbloom with 34 second rotation. Kuki casts 2E and Razor does not make an E before the Q since it is not necessary due to the requirements of ER.

aetherelectro-emilie-fischl-bennett.desc: EMC Emilie Fischl Bennett. ~21s Rot. EMC Quickburn. EMC does N3D, skilling off cd. Deepwood exceeds DPS set options. Fischl alternates skill and burst in Bennett burst.

wriothesley-bennett-dehya-emilie.desc: Wrio Emilie Dehya Bennett. N3CJ combo 19s rot. Emilie and Wrio Q every 2 rots. R5 SacGS can lower Dehya's 20s cooldown.

raiden-kazuha-nahida-sara.desc: Raiden Aggravate with Nahida Sara Kazuha

lynette-yaemiko-fischl-kirara.desc: Lynette aggravate driving Fischl. Used 4Ins Kirara. Lynette is using N2C combo

sayu-nahida-furina-dehya.desc: Sayu Nahida Furina Deyha. ~20s Rot. Sayu Burngeon in 2 Target. Max length rolls on Sayu. Deyha provdes crucial IR, damage reduction, and Pyro without NAs. Furina provides Hydro without NAs while and Vapes off of Burning aura.

keqing-furina-ororon-xianyun.desc: Keqing Furina Ororon Xianyun. ~21s Rot. Keqing Taser Plunge. Xianyun refreshes VV mid rotation. 4 plunges in each half. Ororon before Furina. Hold skill aerial plunge not implemented. 50% Collisons.

cyno-furina-ororon-baizhu.desc: Cyno Furina Ororon Baizhu. 25s rot. Ororon provides enough energy for Cyno to use 4MH with Furina.

itto-xilonen-furina-fischl.desc: Itto Xilonen with Furina Fischl. Energy requirements are greatly eased by Xilonen 2E on the second rotation onwards. Rotation length allows for a Fischl E every rotation, unlike conventional Itto teams.  Recasts Oz with Q when available for uptime & to snapshot buffs.

itto-xilonen-furina-xingqiu.desc: Itto Xilonen with Furina Xingqiu. 2 Xilo Es on the second rotation onward greatly eases up energy requirements. Whiteblind R5 outperforms Serpent R1

hutao-xingqiu-beidou-fischl.desc: TF Hu Tao with Beidou Fischl Xingqiu

navia-zhongli-yelan-xingqiu.desc: Navia Zhongli Yelan Xingqiu. Yelan 2E 21-22s rot. use navia 3rd E if available. feed fav particles to navia.

kinich-yaemiko-fischl-xilonen.desc: Kinich Yae Fischl Xilonen. ~15s Rot. Kinich on-field Aggravate, where Kinich uses TF to fit into the shoter rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst.  Burstless Yae. No Kinich short hold is -6k DPS.

alhaitham-raiden-fischl-xianyun.desc: AlHaitham Fischl Raiden Xianyun. ~26s Rot. Alhaitham-Raiden Quicken Plunge. 1st half Alhaitham does EP 7JlPN1 Q, 2nd half Raiden on-field. Quicken persists for the Raiden's field time. 60% Collisions.

ningguang-fischl-bennett-chiori.desc: on field ning apl. fischl uses fav to allow benny use higher base atk weapon.

yoimiya-emilie-xiangling-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Emilie Xiangling Bennett. 20s rot. Emilie Q every 2rots outside of Bennett Q. Yoimiya also Q every 2rots filling downtime. Xiangling can hold 4DM

navia-furina-charlotte-chiori.desc: Navia Chiori Furina Charlotte. 21s rot. Chiori uses her burst between navia's E if available. Charlotte feeds her fav particles to navia, at navia's 2nd E. she trigges Fav twice in this rot structure and its R3 cd.

xiao-faruzan-zhongli-bennett.desc: The popular 2 Burst/Enemy Xiao with adjusted ER. 50% collission rate

kuki-nahida-xingqiu-bennett.desc: Kuki Nahida Xingqiu Bennett. ~22s Rotation. Kuki Hyperburgeon with C6 Bennett. Kuki uses burst & skill as available in Bennett's burst while Bennett swaps and skills occasionally.

lisa-kazuha-emilie-bennett.desc: Lisa Kazuha Emilie Bennett. ~21s Rot. Lisa Overload in 2 Target, with Bennett & Kazuha on-field maintaining Pyro Aura. UR & Deepwood Bennett are similar. Significant DPS loss in ST.

razor-emilie-fischl-thoma.desc: Razor Emilie Fischl Thoma. ~20s Rot. Razor ends his field time on Fiery Collapse to increase Emilie damage. Emilie bursts every other rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst. EM build Thoma.

raiden-fischl-baizhu-alhaitham.desc: KQMS stats; cozy and fun double carry Quicken team with very easy rotation; Alhaitham is played as quickswap burst DPS, but can stay longer on field if needed. TTDS or Hakushin on Baizhu can be a ~2.5% total dps increase.

mualani-barbara-sucrose-xiangling.desc: Mualani Barbara Sucrose Xiangling. 3[3-stacked bite]. Relying on either Pyronado or Sucrose Q. Barbara for Hydro Resonance, filling downtime with favcodex for team energy. Her E provides C2 buff but may remove the pyro aura if unlucky. With Barbara E(triggering vape), 4Ins XL and 4Scroll Barbara has better dmg.

xianyun-nahida-yaemiko-fischl.desc: Xianyun Nahida Yae Fischl. ~24s Rot. Xianyun Aggravate plunge in ST. Nahida only touches the field once. Yae bursts every other rotation; dps neutral. 50% Collisons. 3EM is better in 2T.

furina-fischl-lynette-bennett.desc: furina "soup" with lynette. fischl uses tf and stays on field to reduce her skill cooldown and fit into shorter rotation .

ayaka-diona-mona-kazuha.desc: Ayaka freeze with Diona. Diona provides much less energy per rotation than other Cryo alternatives, which requires non Amenoma Kageuchi Ayaka to have around 125% to 130% ER with double Fav supports

sayu-nahida-fischl-yaemiko.desc: Sayu Nahida Fischl Yae. ~25s Rot. Rolling Aggravte Sayu and Yae share the rotation. 6.5s Roll Sayu. Burstless Yae.

kaveh-xingqiu-fischl-kuki.desc: Kaveh Xingqiu Fischl Kuki. ~21s Rot. Kaveh Hyperbloom. Kaveh needs Fav for ER purposes. Xingqiu 3EM > ADC; Xingqiu owns a meanigful amount of Bloom and EC. Fischl and Kuki alternate skill/burst to fill rotation time for Xingqiu's skill.

klee-yaemiko-fischl-chevreuse.desc: Klee overload with Yae, Fischl, Chev. Yae bursts every other rotation. 16/19 second rotation

lisa-kazuha-xiangling-bennett.desc: Lisa Kazuha Xiangling Bennett. ~20s Rot. Lisa Overload in 2 Target, with Bennett & Kazuha on field maintaining Pyro Aura. Lesser performance in ST.

razor-emilie-kuki-bennett.desc: Razor Emilie Kuki Bennett. ~21s Rotation. Razor Quickload w/ 67/49% Quicken/Burning uptime. Kuki & Emilie burst in alternate rotations. SS may be inconsistent. Self-Overloads not implemented.

clorinde-fischl-nahida-baizhu.desc: Clorinde Fischl Nahida Baizhu. Baizhu 2E 21s rot. Fischl Q every rot with some ER and E every other rot. Nahida 4GT + Baizhu 4DM is a few hundred better for team DPS.

yoimiya-yelan-furina-charlotte.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Furina Charlotte. Yelan 1E 20s rot. ATK/EM/CRIT 4MH. To maximize yoimiya's damage, used TTDS Charlotte with hE and 2 Fav to manage her ER. her c4 energy also helps.

raiden-fischl-sucrose-yaoyao.desc: Raiden e > Yao Yao q e > Sucrose q n1ed > Fischl n2q > Sucrose n1ed > Raiden q n4e 2n4d n4 > Sucrose n1c > Fischl e n1 > Sucrose n2ed n1c (changes a lot in subsequent rots)

arlecchino-xingqiu-yelan-layla.desc: Arle Yelan Xingqiu Layla. Yelan 2E 21s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel 3[N5D] N1. Layla's shield covers arle's field time

cyno-furina-fischl-xilonen.desc: Non dendro Cyno carry, 26s rotation. Double crystallize succeeds ~70% of the time, otherwise only Electro is crystallized

cyno-chevreuse-fischl-xiangling.desc: "King of Hell" Cyno with Fischl, 26s rotation. Glad is within 1% of Echoes and ping independent

nahida-yaemiko-fischl-baizhu.desc: Double Dendro Double Electro Yae aggravate. F2P/Craftable weapons

emilie-chiori-bennett-zhongli.desc: onfield emilie with double geo core. Emilie spams N2C, but onfield strings are not too important.

hutao-chevreuse-fischl-beidou.desc: Hutao Chevreuse Fischl Beidou. ~20s Rot. Overload Hutao with IR. Hutao does 6N3CJ N2CJ. Hutao & Chevreuse burst every other rotation. Fischl alternates skill and burst. Beidou uses skill once per rotation. 20% Counter, 20% Perfect Counters. 3EM Hutao similar in 2T.

faruzan-kirara-fischl-lynette.desc: Main DPS Farusan, dealing anemo dmg on field while swirling electro for fischl A4. 25s rotation to maximise Oz uptime. Kirara won't apply too much dendro and provides some survivability with the shields.

navia-zhongli-fischl-tighnari.desc: Navia Zhongli Fischl Tighnari. 27s rot. Tighnari Q once every 2E. 4pc deepwood on him is slightly weaker.

ganyu-nahida-dehya-bennett.desc: Burning Melt Ganyu with Sac Greatsword Dehya

rosaria-yelan-furina-mika.desc: Rosaria Yelan Furina Mika. ~22s Rot. Rosaria on-field. 2E Yelan. ~65% Cryo Resonance uptime.

sethos-chevreuse-fischl-thoma.desc: Sethos Chevreuse Fischl Thoma. ~16s Rot. Sethos loses a lvl 1 aimed shot at  the start of the chamber. Sethos does 8N2W N1(last N1 is Phys). Chevreuse builds for damage. Fischl alternates skill/burst.

kazuha-faruzan-furina-lisa.desc: Kazuha Faruzan Furina Lisa. ~20s Rot. Kazuha-Faruzan Quickswap. Kazuha skills off CD with Faruzan aimed shots in between. Pamber Lisa provides the only Furina fanfare. Lisa uses skill while both Anemo units are on CD. 100% Collisions.

mualani-yelan-zhongli-xiangling.desc: Mualani Yelan Zhongli Xiangling. 20s rot. Q if available + 3[3-stacked bite]. Xiangling Q every rot. need high ER yes.

lynette-faruzan-lisa-furina.desc: Lynette hypercarry with Lisa. 20s rotation. Lisa offers def shred and healing via Prototype Amber, as well as enabling electro charged damage. She uses her full hold skill to battery herself.

shenhe-wriothesley-bennett-xiangling.desc: Wrio melt. N3C combo. Wrio burst every other rotation. Shenhe can use tap e to buff Wrio's burst once on final rot or every time w c1 Shenhe

furina-sigewinne-chiori-xilonen.desc: APL Furina & Chiori Quickswap team with Sigewinne and Xilonen. Crystallize shards are picked up for geo resonance. Xilonen feeds fav particles to furina. Sigewinne can also use fav bow.

xingqiu-yelan-xiangling-yoimiya.desc: Echoes Yoimiya Vape with Xingqiu Yelan and Xiangling

navia-noelle-furina-xianyun.desc: Noelle Plunge. Do Navia EQ on first rotations and burst on Navia on subsequent ones only if it's available. Furina procs Fav and Navia funnels her E to Noelle in between 2 sets of 4 Noelle High pluges, 50% collision

ayaka-layla-kazuha-shenhe.desc: Improved Ayaka monocryo's rotation with Layla and also made it safer. Only a 1.2k dps increase from the old one though.

raiden-fischl-thoma-chevreuse.desc: Raiden Fischl Thoma Chev. 18s rot. DPS build Thoma trying his best with so many buffs available. Better xiangling when??

yoimiya-furina-yelan-mika.desc: Yoimiya Furina Yelan Mika. ~21s Rot. Yoimiya with a few extra attacks with Mika's attack speed buff. SoDP > OHC Mika.

alhaitham-fischl-beidou-baizhu.desc: Alhaitham Double Electro and Fav Baizhu 25-26s rotation. Random swap delay

raiden-fischl-xinyan-chevreuse.desc: HP Chev Raifish Xinyan damage builded. NO a bit better that ToM

eula-furina-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Eula Furina Rosaria Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Eula bursts every third rotation; she fills time with NA on non-burst rotations. OHC > SoDP Xianyun, but bubbles may miss.

raiden-kazuha-nahida-lisa.desc: Raiden Aggravate with Lisa Kazuha Nahida

clorinde-furina-fischl-yunjin.desc: Clorinde Furina Fischl YunJin. 16s rot. Clorinde Q every 2 rot. Characters have low enough field time to allow YunJin to spend time on using Level 2 hold E for her ER.

bennett-xiangling-xingqiu-raiden.desc: Raiden National but Raiden only uses E

bennett-emilie-furina-xianyun.desc: Bennett Emilie Furina Xianyun. ~20s Rot. On-field Bennett Burning plunge. 8 plunges, 5 skills. UR Emilie + DM Xianyun & DM Emilie + VV Xianyun are closely matched. VV is only for Hydro when applicable.

lisa-fischl-zhongli-luminedendro.desc: Lisa Fishcl Aggravate with DMC and Zhongli

zhongli-keqing-fischl-collei.desc: Keqing Fischl Aggravate with Zhongli and Collei

kazuha-emilie-faruzan-bennett.desc: Kazuha Emilie Faruzan Bennett. ~20s Rot. Kazuha Faruzan Burning Quickswap. Kazuha skills off CD with Faruzan aimed shots in between. UR on Faruzan exceeds Deepwood. Emilie bursts every other rot. Kazuha's Na/CA should be Pyro in practice. Bennett uses skill a 2nd time after his burst expires.

xingqiu-yelan-bennett-klee.desc: Klee 2Hydro Vape -  Klee burst is a dps loss because of time spent not driving Xingqiu and Yelan.

eula-furina-yelan-dori.desc: Eula Furina Yelan Dori. ~22s Rot. Eula double Hydro with 2E Yelan attempting to funnel Fav particles to Eula. Dori also supplies some flat energy to Eula after her burst animation.

furina-candace-xilonen-xianyun.desc: Furina Candace Xilonen Xianyun. ~20s Rot. C0 Furina Hydro Plunge. 2E Xilonen and Candace. Xilonen does not burst. NO instead of AP Candace is -2K DPS.

ningguang-fischl-yaemiko-chiori.desc: on field ning apl double electro. yae and chiori do not burst.

yoimiya-bennett-zhongli-yelan.desc: Yoimiya Vape with Zhongli Yelan Bennett

beidou-raiden-aetherdendro-candace.desc: Candace Beidou Raiden Quickbloom with DMC

alhaitham-nilou-yelan-baizhu.desc: MH Alhaitham Nilou bloom team with Yelan. ~21 s rotation. Nilou ENNE-> Baizhu EQ -> Yelan EQ -> Alhaitham E ... -> Baizhu E -> Alhaitham Q swap Yelan E swap back ...

nahida-shenhe-bennett-ganyu.desc: Highly Unstable Burning Melt Ganyu with Shenhe

freminet-furina-yelan-kuki.desc: Freminet Furina Yelan Kuki. ~20s Rot. Freminet on-field with Superconduct support Kuki.

arlecchino-kazuha-yunjin-zhongli.desc: Arle Kazuha YunJin Zhongli. 17s rot. No Arle Q, 6[N3D]. Arle C > Kazuha tEP > Arle NA combo to swirl pyro. (or you can do Arle E > Kazuha tEPQ > (teammates) > Kazuha tEP > Arle C and NA combo)

yoimiya-chevreuse-fischl-beidou.desc: Yoimiya Chevreuse Fischl Beidou. ~27s Rot. (TF) Yoimiya Overload with IR. Chevreuse passes particles to Beidou if possible. 10% Counter, 20% Perfect Counter. EM Yoimiya is better; Hamayumi doesn't justify not using burst.

nahida-dori-jean-yelan.desc: Dori Hypbloom with Yelan Jean Nahida

tighnari-nahida-fischl-kuki.desc: TighNahida 26s rotation Spread. 4Instructor Triple EM Xiphos Kuki

raiden-fischl-sara-baizhu.desc: Raiden Fischl Sara Baizhu. ~20s Rot. Simple Shredless Aggravate with Baizhu. Sara buffs Fischl and Raiden. Baizhu fills time until his burst is ready.

fischl-collei-kuki-alhaitham.desc: Alhaitham Spread with Collei, Kuki and Fischl

wriothesley-bennett-xiangling-zhongli.desc: Wriothesley melt burst every other rotation. N3CJ combo. 2 Bennett funnels to Xiangling

bennett-furina-fischl-lisa.desc: Bennett Furina Fischl Lisa. ~20s Rot. Overvape Thundering Fury Bennett. Oz Snapshots Bennett. Lisa uses burst every rotation as available in Bennett Q.

cyno-aetherdendro-fischl-xilonen.desc: Cyno DMC Fischl Xilonen. ~25s Rot. Cyno Aggravate with an Xilonen creating a Crystalize for AP DMC to pickup. Fischl uses skill and burst every rotation.

neuvillette-dehya-lynette-xiangling.desc: Neuv Vape with Dehya and Lynette for some interruption resistance and a Taunt. 4CA ~26s rot. 3 favs + long rot let both Xiangling and Lynette use ATK% sands.

itto-chiori-gorou-zhongli.desc: Itto Chiori Gorou Zhongli Monogeo. Chiori uses burst when available. Includes an adjustable random chance for stone stele to break on cast (0 by default)

kazuha-chevreuse-bennett-xianyun.desc: Kazuha Chevreuse Bennett Xianyun. ~18s Rot. Mono Pyro Plunge with grouping featuring C6 Chev. Skill plunges bookend Kazuha's field time. 100% collisions for E plunges, 70% for starwicker plunges.

kazuha-sara-yaemiko-kirara.desc: "Hyper" Yae Aggravate with  2 Kirara E for shield and Instructor uptime, ~22s rotation.

fischl-nahida-lisa-kirara.desc: Kirara Spread (finally a festering desire user!)

kinich-furina-thoma-baizhu.desc: Kinch Furina Thoma Baizhu. ~21s Rot. Shielded Kinich Burgeon. Kinich seeks blindspots. Kinich bursts every other rotation. No short hold E is -2K DPS.

noelle-zhongli-yelan-furina.desc: Noelle Zhongli Yelan Furina, AP Zhongli dash to pick up crystallize.

neuvillette-furina-ayaka-kazuha.desc: Neuv Furina Kazuha Ayaka. 4CA 29s rot. Ayaka came to fontaine, providing freeze as a defensive utility. if you swap the order of her CA with her burst, lowers her dmg but gets higher total DPS. Random delay as 9-15f swap and 2-4f action

yaemiko-furina-lisa-xianyun.desc: Yae Furina Lisa Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Yae Taser Plunge. Xianyun refeshes VV mid rotation. Yae uses bust skill immediately after all plunges spent when available. Lisa uses hold skill. 50% Collisons.

razor-xingqiu-baizhu-nahida.desc: Razor Hyperbloom with Xingqiu Baizhu Nahida

ayaka-bennett-xiangling-lynette.desc: Xiangling melt with on field Ayaka as enabler. Cryo app from Lynette's burst adds consistency but isn't necessary to ensure XL melts. Eosf and blizzard are similar on Ayaka. R5 favs let Xiangling run EM sands for a bit more damage but risks energy issues. Rot works with C0 Lynette.

raiden-luminedendro-sara-sucrose.desc: Raiden e > Sucrose n1ed > DMC q e n1 > Sara e aim n1 > Sucrose ed q n2 > Raiden q n4e 3n4d

navia-luminegeo-bennett-xiangling.desc: Navia GMC Xiangling Bennett. GMC 2E 22s rot. GMC feeds geo and fav particles twice into navia, being excellent battery. C1 is snapshottable 10% CR and interruption resistance to the on-fielder. You need to practice short hold E(shorter animation than normal hold E). and good positioning of it

ganyu-xilonen-xiangling-bennett.desc: Ganyu Xilonen Xiangling Bennett. Ganyu 2Es 21s rot. Ganyu Q if available. In consecutive combat, make sure you leave Cryo on the enemy before Bennett E(this will remove that Cryo), and then start the next rot with Ganyu E to leave Cryo for Scroll proc.

ningguang-xiangling-bennett-chiori.desc: Ningguang Xiangling Bennett Chiori. APL. Ningguang on Field.

lyney-rosaria-zhongli-bennett.desc: lyney reverse melt rosaria team with resistance to interuption

raiden-furina-kokomi-kazuha.desc: Raiden Furina Kokomi Kazuha. 20s rot. Kokomi quickly Q N2 E swap to heal the team while not having excessive field time. You can also use 4pc Clam on Kokomi.

arlecchino-chiori-albedo-lynette.desc: Arle double geo, rot works with C0 Lynette. Uses Albedo or Chiori burst to fill time and Lynette burst if available. Low ER reqs let Lynette run non-ER weapon. No Bennett means less damage but also less circle impact. Does not include delay to account for for picking up crystallize shard. Finale (atk%+anemo% stats) is slightly better than wolf fang (atk%+atk% stats)

lisa-xingqiu-yelan-yoimiya.desc: Lisa eH q > Xingqiu qn1 ed > Yelan q n1 e n1 > Yoimuya n1e 2n5d n5 > Yelan n2e > Lisa n4

yoimiya-furina-lynette-chevreuse.desc: yoi vv vape. chev provides her c6 buff, easy vv setup, and healing. lynette helps stack fanfare with her skill. r5 fav on lynette to get 2 procs

xilonen-furina-xianyun-chiori.desc: Xilonen Furina Xianyun Chiori. ~20s Rot. Xilonen cancels plunge endlag with NAs as dashes spend nightsoul. 6/2 Geo/Phys plunges. Xilonen and Chiori alternate burst to fill time. 50% collisions.

hutao-xingqiu-zhongli-fischl.desc: Hu Tao overvape with Xingqiu Zhongli Fischl

yoimiya-chevreuse-fischl-raiden.desc: Yoimiya Chevreuse Fischl Raiden. ~26s Rot. Yoimiya-Raiden Overload. DPS Chev is slightly better. Fischl uses skill before Yoimiya's field time and burst before Raiden.

yaemiko-baizhu-fischl-tighnari.desc: Yae Fischl Aggravate with Tighnari and Baizhu

razor-furina-fischl-baizhu.desc: Razor Fischl Furina Baizhu. ~24s Rot. Razor opens with EDN1Q N1ED for Aggravates and end withs E to ensure DEF shred during his downtime.

neuvillette-lisa-kazuha-fischl.desc: Kazuha and Lisa buff Fischl and Neuvillette and they do damage - Kazuha has more ER than KQMS allows. 9-12f swap delay; 2-4 others

mualani-dehya-emilie-zhongli.desc: Mualani Emilie Dehya Zhongli. 33s rot. 3[3-stacked bite]. Dehya requires SacGS R5. but you still miss the proc if unlucky.

kinich-emilie-zhongli-thoma.desc: Kinich Emilie Zhongli Thoma. 18s rot. 4UR on Kinich is slightly better. No circle impact, shielded simple gameplay

yoimiya-furina-yelan-xianyun.desc: Yoimiya Furina Yelan Xianyun. Yelan 2E 21s rot. Yelan E before and after Yoimiya, and furina catches one of that hydro particles on-field, significantly lowering her ER

mualani-candace-zhongli-xiangling.desc: Mualani C5 Candace Zhongli Xiangling. 20s rot. Q if available + 3[3-stacked bite]. Xiangling Q every rot. Candace C6 is ~10% team DPS loss from C5. Candace uses 2nd E at the rotation downtime. be aware of its cd. next rot's 1st E is barely off-cd.

yoimiya-yelan-zhongli-chiori.desc: Yoimiya double geo with Chiori. 18s rotation

neuvillette-zhongli-kazuha-mona.desc: Neuv mono-hydro with mona. 4CA rotation; pretty straightforward

diluc-xingqiu-xianyun-bennett.desc: diluc plunge. xingqiu ensure easy vapes. changing player position after bennett dash for consistent pyro swirl without xingqiu's orbitals interfering.  100% collision.

thoma-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: Thoma Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. Thoma on-field Overload; Thoma bursts as available. Fischl snapshots Bennett's buff. Bennett buffed Chevreuse bursts every other rot.

cyno-furina-ororon-xilonen.desc: Cyno taser with Ororon. 25s rotation. timing is tight for Cyno to catch Ororon's particles with Xilo between them.

yoimiya-yaemiko-fischl-xingqiu.desc: Yoimiya Yae Fischl Xingqui. ~24s Rot. TF (Yoimiya) is able to use her skill twice per rotation, with her burst capping the rotation end.  Similar performance between 3EM Evenstar & ADC Widsith Yae. Burstless Yae.

fischl-raiden-furina-sayu.desc: raiden fischl furina with sayu as healing

navia-gorou-yelan-bennett.desc: Navia Gorou Yelan Bennett. 20s rot. Gorou 2E before navia's field time(Q and 2nd E). 4totm to buff navia's second E. use 3rd navia E if available.

raiden-yaemiko-kazuha-luminedendro.desc: Raiden Yae Aggravate with DMC and Kazuha

ayaka-ganyu-kokomi-shenhe.desc: Ayaka triple cryo freeze with a larger focus on Ayaka's on field DPS. Shenhe QE -> Ganyu EQ -> Kokomi E -> Ayaka d N2 E N1 Q N1 -> Shenhe E -> Ganyu E -> Ayaka d 2N2C E d N2C.

rosaria-furina-nahida-kuki.desc: Rosaria Furina Nahida Kuki. ~22s Rotation. Physical Rosaria on-fielding Hyperbloom ft. Furina and P-Amber Nahida.

bennett-beidou-lisa-chevreuse.desc: Thundering Fury Bennett with c6 Chevreuse and Beidou. 2 Beidou perfect counter

wriothesley-furina-xianyun-shenhe.desc: Freeze Plunge C0 Wrio. 50% collision rate. Wrio combo is N3CJP with high plunges. Blizzard > MH. Xianyun almost never gets Hydro VV.

sucrose-fischl-xingqiu-collei.desc: Sucrose Hyperbloom with Fischl Xingqiu and Collei

dori-nahida-furina-xianyun.desc: Dori Nahida Furina Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Dori Quickbloom Plunge. Dori uses her burst after two plunges. The CD on Dori's skill/infusion is eliminated by ICD-less plunges. Xianyun only applies VV for 6 plunges in the second half of the rotation; very sensitive. 50% Collisons.

dori-nahida-furina-jean.desc: Dori Nahida Furina Jean. ~23s Rot. Dori Hyperbloom with Fav GS Dori Decreasing ER Requirements. Full EM Jean swirls self Electro applied by Dori's lamp.

arlecchino-emilie-furina-yanfei.desc: Arle Emilie Furina Yanfei. 20s rot. Arle N3D combo. Arle and Furina Q every 2rots, lowering Furina's ER and increasing her Vaped E damage. Yanfei provides defensive utility

itto-gorou-furina-chiori.desc: Itto Chiori Gorou with Furina. Fanfare generation drops off sharply after the first rotation. Fragile to play despite Crystallize. Scales well with Furina constellations.

klee-fischl-lisa-chevreuse.desc: Klee overload with Lisa. Klee alternates between N1Cs and N2Cs to maintain stamina. 20s rotation.

ganyu-kazuha-shenhe-rosaria.desc: Mono cryo Ganyu with Shenhe, Rosaria, Kazuha

neuvillette-kazuha-zhongli-albedo.desc: Neuv Kazuha Albedo Zhongli. 4CA 28s rot. You just care about hydro 4AP. No worry for aura management. Albedo's flower can be broken tho

tartaglia-xiangling-furina-bennett.desc: Xiangling Childe vape with furina. 1 Guoba 22s rotation. TOM and GT are very similar for Furina

dori-emilie-fischl-bennett.desc: Dori Emilie Fischl Bennett. Dori Thundering Fury Quickburn. Dori's C6 Infusion is almost entirely overriden Bennett C6 Infusion.

bennett-furina-xiangling-rosaria.desc: Bennett Furina Xiangling Rosaria. ~20s Rot. Rosaria Furinational with Bennett funneling Xiangling's burst, then on-field skill spam for the rest of the rotation. Rosaria uses burst after XL burst.

xiao-furina-yelan-xianyun.desc: Xiao Yelan Furina Xianyun. ~22s Rot. VV Xiao weaves NAs inbetween 8 low plunges. You may N0 ingame. 50% collisions.

xinyan-chevreuse-fischl-bennett.desc: Xinyan Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~18s Rot. Xinyan uses NAs, in practice you should book trick + spin while shield is up.

navia-furina-bennett-xiangling.desc: Navia with furina buffing her and xl. Aura will be mostly pyro for furina to vape

hutao-chiori-xingqiu-zhongli.desc: Hutao double geo with chiori. weaves at the end just to proc fav and fill in time for the 21s rotatioon

bennett-nahida-raiden-xingqiu.desc: Bennett Nahida Raiden Xingqiu. ~22s Rot. Bennett Burgeon on-field with Raiden snatching dendro cores leftover. Nahida omits burst if unavailable.

wanderer-nahida-xingqiu-raiden.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom with Nahida Xingqiu and Wanderer Driver

heizou-nahida-fischl-beidou.desc: Heizou Nahida Fischl Beidou. ~24s Rot. Full EM on-field Heizou in 2-target with Beidou, Aggravate swirling and bursting twice per rotation to heal the team. 20% Counter, 20% Perfect Counters.

yanfei-bennett-furina-yelan.desc: KQMS Double Hydro Yanfei Vape with Furina

alhaitham-kuki-xingqiu-baizhu.desc: Alhaitahm Spread + Kuki Hyperbloom with Xingqiu Bazihu

ganyu-furina-rosaria-xilonen.desc: Ganyu Furina Rosaria Xilonen. 21s Rot. On-field Freeze DPS Ganyu in two target does 2 Es per rotation. Assumes freezable enemies and high ability to headshot. ~1k less DPS with Song of stillness.

ganyu-sucrose-xiangling-nahida.desc: Burn Melt Ganyu with Sucrose XL Nahida ~25 s rot. XL use Guoba only.

hutao-xingqiu-raiden-fischl.desc: Hu Tao Raiden with Xingqiu and Fischl

raiden-yaemiko-sucrose-nahida.desc: Raiden e > Yae 3e > Sucrose n1ed n1c > Nahida eq > Yae n1q 3e > Sucrose n1ed q n2c > Raiden q n4e 3n4d

navia-chiori-yelan-xingqiu.desc: Navia Chiori Yelan Xingqiu: N3D 2N2D on Navia to fit second Yelan skill. Options for Husk and HoD on Chiori and EoSF on XQ in config (NO is ~2% better than EoSF for XQ).

klee-emilie-xiangling-bennett.desc: Klee Emilie Xiangling Bennett. 20s rot. 4EoSF on Xiangling instead of 4DM loses 1k. Emilie Q every 2 rots.

ayaka-kokomi-venti-shenhe.desc: Ayaka freeze with random delays of 2 to 6 frames. This makes use of Ayaka's E dash buffer. Venti EQ > Shenhe EQ > Kokomi E d > Ayaka E d N1 Q N2C > Venti E N1 > Shenhe N1 E > Ayaka d N2C E d 2N2C.

wanderer-yelan-faruzan-zhongli.desc: Zhongli EHDN1 > Yelan EQN1 (N1 Aim if Ava special charge) > Faruzan N1Q > Wanderer N1 Q (if ava) N1 E N1C (Combo N2C + Dash when the A4 is activated. Repeat this while you have flying stamina) E.

kinich-thoma-xiangling-bennett.desc: Kinich Thoma Xiangling Bennett. 21s rot. E 5[N2 shE] (Q) combo with consistently NA clockwise. Xiangling Burst every rot. Thoma reduces her ER req.

sucrose-keqing-fischl-collei.desc: Keqing Fischl Aggravate with Collei and Sucrose

yoimiya-ororon-fischl-xingqiu.desc: Yoimiya Ororon Fischl Xingqiu. ~24s Rot. (TF) Yoimiya is able to use her skill twice per rotation, with her burst capping the rotation end. 3EM >= EDC Yoimiya. Fischl skill and burst just before Yoimiya skills.

yaemiko-aetheranemo-fischl-tighnari.desc: Yae Fishcl Aggravate with Tighnari and AMC

raiden-noelle-nahida-xingqiu.desc: Raiden Hyperbloom, Noelle and Nahida Driver

bennett-furina-yelan-ororon.desc: Bennett Furina Ororon Yelan. ~20s Rot. The Overload count is fairly low. Ororon uses his skill and burst in Bennett burst. 1E Yelan.

xiangling-wanderer-faruzan-bennett.desc: C0 Wanderer C6 Faruzan, one if not the highest AOE main DPS Wanderer teams, but no shielder

nahida-zhongli-bennett-ganyu.desc: Highly Unstable Burning Melt Ganyu with Zhongli

hutao-yelan-sucrose-amber.desc: VV Hu Tao with Yelan Sucrose Amber and perfect execution to vape everything

yanfei-nahida-fischl-xingqiu.desc: Yanfei Nahida Fischl Xingqiu. ~24s Rot. Yanfei OverBurgeonVape. Fischl uses skill and burst every rotation. Note that Yanfei is in melee range.

ningguang-gorou-furina-chiori.desc: on field ning apl. c4 gorou provides some healing for furina, and crystallize provides some shielding, but survivability is still very limited.

neuvillette-zhongli-albedo-xiangling.desc: Improved rotation of Double Geo Vaporize Neuvillette, be aware that using Guoba twice is vitar for that team to be able to rotate

lynette-furina-fischl-bennett.desc: Lynette Furina Fischl Bennett. ~20s Rot. On-field Lynette Soup in ST Target with C6 Bennett infusion contributing overloads. Fischl snapshots Bennett's buff. Fischl alternates skill and burst.

navia-xiangling-bennett-albedo.desc: Navia Albedo Xiangling Benntt. 21s rot. Albedo's E is used at the start of the rot, it can be broken during setup and stop generating geo particles. you can recast it but you may lose DPS due to bennett Q and 4NO uptime, extending rotation, etc.

eula-raiden-furina-mika.desc: Eula Raiden Furina Mika. Optimized 24s rotation. PF on Eula is ~2k less DPS. Giving Raiden a DMG weapon gives similar results and can pull ahead if she is more invested than Eula. EOSF is generally worse than TOTM unless Raiden is heavily invested.

neuvillette-nahida-dehya-lynette.desc: neuvi dehya nahida lynette. ~25s unoptimized rot, 9-15f random swap delay, 2-4f random action delay. energy & some consistency issues.

navia-zhongli-fischl-yaemiko.desc: Navia Zhongli Fischl Yae. 16.5s rot. Yae no burst only 3[E] once. 4th rot onwards you need to add some extra actions for navia E cd

dori-furina-ororon-xianyun.desc: Dori Furina Ororon Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Dori Taser Plunge. Lower reaction ownership reliability will cause a bit of waiting for skill CD even with TF. After 5 plunges dori uses burst, then Xianyun refeshes VV to fill time. Ororon goes before Furina. 50% Collisons.

navia-zhongli-rosaria-bennett.desc: Navia Zhongli Rosaria Bennett. simple 19s rot. Navia EQ in the first rot for energy. Rosaria 2nd E between Navia's field time for better energy economy. Bennett uses EoSF to meet ER needs with alleyflash. Rosaria holds 4NO instead of him. CD circlet due to Rosaria's CR buff.

rosaria-furina-yelan-dori.desc: Rosaria Furina Yelan Dori. ~22s Rot. Rosaria on-field with Superconduct Support Dori. Yelan does 2Es. Dori uses burst after Furina's burst.

alhaitham-fischl-xianyun-nahida.desc: Alhaitham N2JP. Settings for Low/High plunge (default Low) and collision rate (25%). 2pc Deepwood still slightly lower than Gilded. Customized random frame delays; Icewind Suite energy.

razor-nahida-furina-dori.desc: Razor Nahida Furina Dori. ~26s Rot. Razor Hyperbloom with Dori supplying energy to the team.

raiden-kazuha-luminedendro-sara.desc: Raiden Aggravate with Sara Kazuha DMC

navia-zhongli-xingqiu-bennett.desc: Navia Zhongli Xingqiu Bennett. 21s rot. use the 3rd E if available. zhongli refreshes pillar between navia's field time. Feeding Fav particles to navia is crucial for her ER.

nahida-xingqiu-kuki-dehya.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Dehya (and she does something)

neuvillette-yaemiko-fischl-zhongli.desc: Neuv double electro with 4AP Zhongli. 4CA 28s rot. Yae w/o burst. prioritize hydro shard over electro shard.

yaemiko-kazuha-fischl-kokomi.desc: Buff Yae's Burst with Hakushin Ring. Refresh turrets every 12 seconds. Refresh Kokomi's jellyfish before it expires

neuvillette-xiangling-kazuha-layla.desc: Neuv Xiangling Kazuha Layla. 4CA 32s rot. Neuv with Layla's shield. using layla's burst in the second part leads to cryo swirl in the next rot.

xiao-faruzan-yelan-xianyun.desc: Xiao Faruzan Yelan Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Xiao weaves NAs inbetween 8 high plunges. You may N0 in game. 50% collisions.

raiden-kazuha-furina-lisa.desc: Raiden Hypercarry with P.Amber Lisa and Furina. ~20s Rotation.

wriothesley-furina-xilonen-bennett.desc: Wrio Furina Xilonen Bennett. Xilonen 2E 20s rot. Wrio Q every other rot.

bennett-emilie-rosaria-chongyun.desc: Chongyun Rosa burnmelt with emilie. Benny swaps often to use his E to refresh burning and for energy. Except for personal damage, Emilie enables unfinished reverie for the cryo characters for good damage gain

wanderer-faruzan-yunjin-bennett.desc: wanderer + yunjin improved with wanderer using ult

wriothesley-furina-yunjin-xilonen.desc: Wrio Furina Xilonen YunJin. Xilonen 2E 20s rot. Wrio Q every other rot. YunJin picks up the Crystallize Shard for Geo Resonance. 4NO > 4Husk. 4AP isn't that big upgrade over these two. She has manageable ER thanks to Xilonen and multiple Fav proc.

neuvillette-yaemiko-kazuha-raiden.desc: neuvi yae raiden kaz. ~28s unoptimized rot, 9-15f random swap delay, 2-4f random action delay. skill bot raiden as a worse alternative to fischl.

fischl-yelan-furina-mika.desc: On field Fischl with Yelan Furina Mika. Fischl's damage is evenly split between Physical and Electro

hutao-xingqiu-kazuha-yelan.desc: Hu Tao Double Hydro with Kazuha and BB siwrl

raiden-kazuha-bennett-sara.desc: (First rot Raiden e > Kazuha hEp ) > Sara n1e aim n1 > Bennett q > Kazuha q > Sara q > Raiden q n4e 2 n4d n4 > (Next rots start w/ (Kazuha hEp n2 > Bennet n1 e )

arlecchino-rosaria-sucrose-layla.desc: Arle Rosaria Sucrose Layla. 17s rot. No Arle Q, CA dash cancel and N15 spam (6[N3D] is about 1k behind). Sucrose E after Arle E for pyro vv and high EM buff.

emilie-bennett-furina-xianyun.desc: Emilie Bennett Furina Xianyun. ~24s Rot. On-field Emilie Burning plunge. Burstless Emilie. Pyro > ATK > Dendro Goblet. 8 plunges; Final plunge is unbuffed.

navia-zhongli-fischl-yelan.desc: Navia Zhongli Fischl Yelan. Yelan 1E 18s rot. simple and easy to follow.

wriothesley-bennett-xiangling-nahida.desc: Wriothesley melt burst every other rotation. Nahida burst every other rotation. N3CJ combo. 2 Bennett funnels to Xiangling

lynette-emilie-faruzan-bennett.desc: Lynette Emilie Faruzan Bennett. ~20s Rot. Burning on-field Lynette. Emilie burst every other rot. Bennett and Faruzan use skill and aimed shots between Lynette's skill uses. C6 Bennett is -2K DPS.

ningguang-furina-bennett-chiori.desc: on field ning apl with furina offering her buffs and personal damage. benny uses fav so he can burst more often without spending time doing skills.

razor-chevreuse-fischl-xiangling.desc: On field Razor overload. Razor's damage is split between physical and electro, atk phys and electro goblets are close. glad performs similarly to echoes. Chevreuse funnels to Xiangling over Fischl.

razor-nahida-xingqiu-thoma.desc: Razor Nahida Xingqiu Thoma. ~22s Rot. Razor Chaos in 2T, where Razor & Thoma fight for dendro cores.

ayaka-kokomi-lumineanemo-shenhe.desc: Ayaka Shenhe Freeze with AMC support. AMC on Cryo Goblet. 20s rotation. Assumes Tornado hits full duration.

xiao-faruzan-zhongli-albedo.desc: Xiao with C6 Faruzan, and Double Geo

ningguang-luminegeo-fischl-chiori.desc: on field ning apl triple geo. fischl provides off field damage and application for crystallize, which can provide some survivability, as well as keeping uptime on 4pc nighttime for ning and gmc.

sara-nahida-beidou-sucrose.desc: beidou hyper, unrealistic amount of discharges

bennett-nahida-furina-yelan.desc: Bennett Nahida Furina Yelan. ~24s Rot. Bennett Burgeon Vape with Furina & 1xE Yelan. Fanfare generation drops after the first rotation. Bennett recieves all healing.

ayaka-yelan-lumineanemo-shenhe.desc: Ayaka Shenhe Freeze with AMC Support ft. Yelan. AMC on Cryo Goblet. ~21s rotation. Assumes Tornado hits full duration.

neuvillette-lisa-kazuha-zhongli.desc: Neuvillette with lisa buff does the same damage as he does with Fischl instead due to energy; 9-12f swap delay, 2-4f action delay

dori-furina-fischl-xianyun.desc: Dori Furina Fischl Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Dori Taser Plunge. Lower reaction ownership reliability than Aggravate will cause a bit of waiting for skill CD even with TF. After 3 plunges dori uses burst, Xianyun refeshes VV to fill time, then Fischl bursts. 50% Collisons.

lisa-emilie-xiangling-bennett.desc: Lisa Emilie Xiangling Bennett. ~20s Rot. Lisa Overload, with Bennett on field skill spam generating particles for the team and Maintaining Pyro Aura.
