xianyun-furina-faruzan-bennett.desc: Xianyun Furina Faruzan Bennett. ~23s Rot. Xianyun Plunge. Burst Support Bennett is ideal. 50% Collisions.

kazuha-furina-emilie-bennett.desc: Kazuha Furina Emilie Bennett. ~20s Rot. Kazuha and Bennett use skills as available to apply Pyro. Bennett builds EM. Emilie on fields during downtime for more Bennett burst buffing. 70% Collisions. Swirling Hydro mutiple times per rotation may be problematic in as targets increase.

nahida-xingqiu-zhongli-thoma.desc: Thoma Burgeon with Zhongli Nahida Xingqiu

arlecchino-yelan-rosaria-layla.desc: Arle Yelan Rosaria Layla. 18s rot. No Arle Q, N1 CA dash cancel 5[N3D]. mostly melt. KQMS Random Frame Delay.

navia-xiangling-bennett-ningguang.desc: navia ning double pyro. 20s~ rotation. xiangling uses fav to reach her extremely high er requirements.

kuki-yelan-xingqiu-luminedendro.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with DMC Xingqiu and Yelan

freminet-furina-chongyun-xianyun.desc: Freminet Furina Chongyun Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Freminet Shatterplunge with FavGS Chongyun. Conistent Cryo Swirl, inconsistent Hydro Swirl. Combo: (2E 7JPD 1JP 2E Q2E/N3). 50% Collisions.

ganyu-xilonen-bennett-xiangling.desc: Melt Ganyu with Xilonen. Ganyu struggles to fit in a Kazuha or Sucrose due to duration issues, but Xilonen's powerful and long-lasting buffs allow her to fill in the shoes of an Anemo unit. Though the setup is comfortable, the gameplay is not because of Ganyu lacking poise which C1 Xilonen only partially mitigates.

xilonen-furina-gorou-xianyun.desc: Xilonen Furina Xianyun Gorou. ~20s Rot. Xilonen cancels plunge endlag with NAs, since dashes spend Nightsoul. Xilonen bursts every other rotation. Goruo skips burst if unavailable. 50% collisions.

raiden-fischl-xiangling-bennett.desc: Raiden Fischl Xiangling bennett. 20s rot. use Fischl E at the end of the rot if available(every other rot)

yoimiya-yelan-fischl-thoma.desc: Yoimiya Yelan Fischl Thoma. 18s rot. 4GD on yoi is only a few hunderd behind. 4CW is ~1k behind. Yoimiya can keep vaping her NAs thanks to overvape.

raiden-yaemiko-kazuha-sara.desc: Raiden Sara Yae Mono Electro with Kazuha

lyney-nahida-kazuha-bennett.desc: Lyney burning team with TOTM Nahida, Kazuha and Bennett. Not all Lyney charge shots hit weak points, but overall team damage hits above 54k if you hit the weak point each time. TOTM edges out both Deepwood and Golden Troupe on Nahida, but all are viable.

lynette-keqing-fischl-kirara.desc: Catgirl Aggravate. Burst every other rotation on Fischl/Kirara/Lynette. Fischl Q/E -> Kirara E(Q) -> Lynette E(Q) -> Keqing EQE -> N1C N1 E N1C N1C.  ~12.5-13s rotation with no Oz downtime and nearly 100% Kirara shield uptime. You want a bit of extra ER on Keqing with how short the rotation is.

keqing-furina-rosaria-xianyun.desc: Keqing Furina Rosaria Xianyun. ~20s Rot. Keqing Phys Plunge. Keqing does N1C before and after plunging. The combo also enables PF. MH>PF Keqing. Rarely Keqing may burst to conserve stamina. Hold skill aerial plunge not implemented. 50% Collisions.

ningguang-gorou-bennett-chiori.desc: on field ning apl. gorou offers geo crit dmg, geo dmg% and and his a1 def% is useful for chiori.

xilonen-gorou-zhongli-chiori.desc: Xilonen Monogeo with Chiori, Gorou, Zhongli. Chiori and Xilonen have to burst every rotation and build the appropriate ER, or else cooldowns brick. Gorou skips Q when unavailable. Includes an adjustable random chance for stone stele to break on cast (0 by default)

mona-kazuha-ganyu-ayaka.desc: Ayaka Ganyu Freeze with Kazuha Mona

ayato-nahida-beidou-kuki.desc: Ayato Nahida Beidou Kuki. ~20s Rot. Thundery Fury Ayato with Beidou in 2 target. Hakushin competitive om Nahida. 50% Perfect counter chance.

xiangling-ayato-fischl-nahida.desc: Xiangling Burgeon with Fischl Ayato Nahida

nahida-xiangling-bennett-ganyu.desc: Melt Ganyu with Nahida Bennett Xiangling

cyno-fischl-nahida-zhongli.desc: 4TF Cyno Aggravate with Fischl Nahida Zhongli, 6N2EN3D N2E, 26s rotation

freminet-furina-fischl-bennett.desc: Freminet Furina Fischl Bennett. ~20s Rot. Physical Freminet with Bennett. MH>=PF Freminet. Fischl alternate skill and burst in bennett burst. All but the final Shattering Pressure are buffed. C6 Bennett is -3K DPS.

clorinde-furina-nahida-kirara.desc: Clorinde Furina Nahida Kirara. 20s rot. Nahida directly eats up Kirara's particles. Kirara's Fav also helps Furina's ER. Kirara's shield covers most of Clorinde's field time. Clorinde Q when available at the end.

bennett-chevreuse-fischl-xinyan.desc: Xinyan Chevreuse Fischl Bennett. ~16s Rot. On-field Bennett and burst support Xinyan generate energy for burst DPS Chevreuse nukes. Fischl just before Chevreuse in Bennett Q for more Overcharged Balls. Phys and Pyro Xinyan are comparable. Xinyan bursts as available.

navia-zhongli-furina-bennett.desc: Navia Zhongli Furina Bennett. 20-21s rot. Use 3rd Navia E if available. BROKEN zhongli pillar. Feed fav particles twice into navia. Everyone gets healed by bennett while triggering 2 second fav procs for navia's high ER.

kaveh-raiden-fischl-xianyun.desc: Kaveh Fischl Raiden Xianyun. ~24s Rot. Kaveh-Raiden Quicken Plunge. Kaveh spends plunges in the first half of the rotation, Raiden on-fields in the second. Quicken lingers until the last N3 of Raiden's burst. Kaveh skills off cooldown to meet ER needs. Kaveh C6 introduces Swirl issues. 50% Collisions.

lisa-nahida-furina-xianyun.desc: Lisa Nahida Furina Xianyun. ~22s Rot. Lisa Hyperbloom Plunge. Lisa uses hold skill after all plunges are spent for ER.

faruzan-bennett-fischl-lynette.desc: Onfield Main DPS Faruzan with adaptive rotation to accomodate fischl, bennett and lynette's different cooldown times.

faruzan-wanderer-bennett-venti.desc: Wanderer Faruzan Bennett Venti. The rotation does not buff Venti's Burst with Bennett to maximise buff uptime on Wanderer.  It dynamically adjusts based on the state of Wanderer's A4

neuvillette-xiangling-kazuha-diona.desc: Neuv Xiangling Kazuha Diona. Nothing impressive. Not optimized. diona's shield isn't reliable you know. its weak but better than nothing. You can try 4NO on diona in the config.

razor-chevreuse-yaemiko-bennett.desc: Razor Chevreuse Yae Bennett. ~20s Rot. Pyro Infused Razor deals slightly more Pyro DMG; Yae after Chevreuse, before Bennett. Razor monopolizes Bennett field time. Self-Overloads not implemented.

kazuha-nahida-furina-kuki.desc: Kazuha Nahida Furina Kuki. ~18s Rot. (TF) Kazuha Hyperbloom in 2 Target. Kuki optimally bursts every rotation. Nahida bursts nearly every rotation. VV is close to even with Sac Sword. 70% Collisions.

wriothesley-shenhe-furina-bennett.desc: Wrio Shenhe Furina Bennett. 20s rot. N3CJ spam. Wrio Q every other rot. Shenhe field time can be put before bennett with ~3k less than this.

lyney-amber-lynette-bennett.desc: Lyney Amber Lynette Bennett. ~16s Rot. Lyney pulls rabbits and cats from hats, but IR marrs the stars in combat. The twins take a Fantastic Voyage, while Amber cheers her peers from storage.

fischl-xiao-faruzan-bennett.desc: Xiao with Fischl, Bennett and C6 Collision, 50% Collision rate

wriothesley-yunjin-shenhe-xilonen.desc: Wrio Shenhe YunJin Xilonen. ~17s rot, w/o using Xilonen Q. 5[N3CJ]. 4Husk on YunJin is huge -15% team DPS drop from 4AP.

yoimiya-emilie-kazuha-bennett.desc: Yoimiya Emilie Kazuha Bennett. 19s rot. Alternating Emilie and Kazuha Q, using on Bennett Q. Bennett can hold 4DM.

charlotte-xiangling-furina-bennett.desc: charlotte  enables most of pyronado to melt against freezable enemy and battery the team via fav. the team dps drop heavily if the enemy isn't freezable. n1c charlotte for most cryo app until stamina runs out, then n3d. 20s rotation.

raiden-lisa-xiangling-chevreuse.desc: Raiden Xiangling Lisa Chev. 20s rot. Lisa w/o using hold E. but there is time to use it if you want to, Lisa provides DEF Shred and TTDS.

neuvillette-xiangling-fischl-diona.desc: Neuv Xiangling Fischl Diona Overvape. 4CA 27s rot. Simply [Diona (Q)E > XL (Q)E > Fischl Oz > Neuv] twice. You can try 4NO on Diona in the config.

hutao-kazuha-bennett-xiangling.desc: Hu Tao does 8 N2CJ. Xiangling and Kazuha burst every other rotation. Team eventually runs into a stamina issue, at the 4th rotation, which isn't simmed.

nahida-xingqiu-kuki.desc: Nahida, Xingqiu, Kuki hyperbloom core, with a Xingqiu N1 Ed N2 in the middle of Nahida's field time in order to proc Favonius twice per rotation while also benefitting from Xingqiu's C4.

neuvillette-fischl-kazuha-layla.desc: Neuv Fischl Kazuha Layla. 4CA 30s rot. 3 Stacks of Neuv A1. Layla's shield covering C0 Neuv field time. mostly hydro swirl. 9-15f Random swap delay.

lisa-zhongli-xingqiu-nahida.desc: Lisa Hyperbloom with Nahida Xingqiu Zhongli

kuki-xingqiu-yelan-collei.desc: Kuki Hyperbloom with Driver Yelan, Xingqiu and Collei

furina-raiden-mika-eula.desc: Eula combo utilises Mika's ATK Speed buff

sucrose-xingqiu-raiden-collei.desc: 25s Sucrose hyperbloom with on-field Raiden at the end of the rotation.

zhongli-chiori-bennett-fischl.desc: ~16s rotation; bennett and chiori just quickswap between each other. comfy team with zhongli shield.

yaemiko-nahida-lisa-fischl.desc: Yae Fishcl Aggravate with Nahida and Lisa

raiden-fischl-sucrose-collei.desc: Raiden aggravate with Sucrose+Collei. Note Sucrose infusion depends on positioning.

yoimiya-fischl-chevreuse-thoma.desc: Yoimiya Fischl Chevreuse Thoma. 18s rot. Yoimiya burst every other rot, if not available do some NAs to make it 18s rot.

xianyun-furina-xiangling-bennett.desc: Xianyun Furina Xiangling Bennett. ~20s Rot. VV Xianyun on field shreds RES continously while Furina and XL get a few vapes in. 50% Collisions.

itto-gorou-fischl-chiori.desc: Itto Chiori Gorou with Fischl. Fischl alternates between skill and burst.

nilou-xingqiu-collei-yaoyao.desc: Onfield Yaoyao Nilou Bloom with Xingqiu. High ER reqs for everyone, Favonius on Collei and Yaoyao strongly encouraged.

wriothesley-shenhe-xilonen-bennett.desc: Wrio Shenhe Xilonen Bennett. 20s rot. 5[N3CJ] N4 (Q/C) Shenhe Q every rot.

cyno-yelan-furina-mika.desc: Cyno Yelan Furina Mika. ~22s Rot. Physical Cyno N3CD spam, skilling off CD. ATK Substats strongly preferred by Crescent Pike. 2E Yelan.

mualani-mona-zhongli-xiangling.desc: Mualani Mona Zhongli Xiangling. 20s rot. Q if available + 3[3-stacked bite]. Mona C1 is beneficial. Xiangling Q every rot. Mona uses her E at the rotation downtime. 4AP is crucial (more than 10% DPS increase).

ningguang-zhongli-bennett-chiori.desc: Ningguang Zhongli Bennett Chiori. APL. Ningguang on Field.

keqing-nahida-lisa-fischl.desc: Keqing FIschl Aggravate with Lisa and Nahida

ganyu-furina-kazuha-charlotte.desc: Ganyu Furina Kazuha Charlotte. ~21s Rot. On-field Freeze DPS Ganyu in two target does 2 Es per rotation. Assumes freezable enemies and high ability to headshot.

freminet-chiori-fischl-zhongli.desc: Freminet Fischl Chiori Zhongli. ~18s Rot. Physical Freminet Double Geo with 60% Phys shred. No burst Chiori. Freminet bursts every rotation.

razor-furina-yelan-mika.desc: Razor Furina Yelan Mika. ~20s Rot. Superconduct and Mika's C6 cover the duration of Razor's field time. Razor Atk > Phys Goblet. Mika Clam > SoDP > NO.

cyno-xingqiu-yaoyao-nahida.desc: Cyno with Xingqiu Yaoyao and Nahida
